prs.title: test(serve): Split Hosted Harness Session tests
prs.body:
## What this PR does Splits the 50,579-line Hosted Harness Session test suite into 33 independently runnable files organized around text turns, lifecycle, wake dispatch, approvals, recovery, and related routes. The original entry keeps the core text-turn and event-stream cases and is now 2,140 lines. The largest file is 3,590 lines. The suites share the existing Harness, Store, model, and wake fixtures and preserve all 905 expanded cases from the original suite. The Monitor wake approval fixtures now start the idle timer after the test has seeded the monitor and reached its approval wait. Recovery cases wait for both durable turn settlement and an idle attachment before deleting the session. The design docs and existing test references point reviewers to the relevant suites. [English design](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/test/split-hosted-harness-session/docs/design/2026-11-24-hosted-harness-session-test-split.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/test/split-hosted-harness-session/docs/design/2026-11-24-hosted-harness-session-test-split.zh-CN.md) The Hook owner parking case that landed on main in #18218 now lives with the other command-step approval cases. The child question and approval coverage from #18224 lives in the approval and approval-parking suites. The split monitor wake approval suite also preserves the close requirement covered by #18233. It waits for the resumed turn to release the session’s active slot before closing. ## Why it's needed The monolithic suite made it hard to locate a failure and run a single behavior in isolation. The split gives reviewers smaller suites they can select by filename and lets Vitest schedule independent suites in separate workers. Parallel execution also exposed two timing assumptions in the Monitor fixtures, one during journal setup and one during teardown. ## Reviewer Test Plan Verify that the family still collects and exercises the original cases, including parameterized variants and the existing #13328 regression. In the Monitor wake tests, verify that the advertised flag allows a parked approval to resume through passive load, that the approval stays resident without the flag, and that a recovered turn settles and releases its active slot before cleanup. ### How to verify 1. From `packages/cli`, run `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session --maxWorkers=5 --coverage.enabled=false`. The full family should report 911 passing cases across 34 files, including the existing #13328 regression, the Hook owner case from #18218, and the child approval coverage from #18224. 2. For the timing changes, run `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.wake-approval-parking.test.ts src/serve/hosted-harness-session.suspension.test.ts --maxWorkers=5 --coverage.enabled=false`. The 11 wake-approval and 18 suspension cases should pass. 3. From the repository root, run `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck`. Local evidence on the tested parent `31e4e272d7` matched all 591 test definitions and seven module mocks by syntax tree, and all 905 expanded case names after normalizing one random writer UUID. The initial full run passed 903 of 906 cases and exposed three timing failures in the Monitor wake approval suite. After the fixture changes, a five-file rerun passed all 184 cases, including the three failures and the neighboring suspension and takeover suites. Taking the latest result for each file gives 906 of 906 passing cases in the Hosted Harness Session family. The repository build, typecheck, and ESLint and Prettier checks for the changed files also passed. After merging main at `5272afbc2f`, syntax-tree comparison matched all 592 test definitions against the current monolith. The approval-parking and wake-approval-parking suites passed all 33 cases on macOS, including the moved Hook owner case. The repository build and typecheck passed on the merge. A subsequent full run on macOS with Node 22 passed all 907 cases on `acd4b3d77e`. After syncing main at `ea5b0467ca`, syntax-tree comparison matched all 595 test definitions, including the child approval coverage. All 77 cases in the approval, approval-parking, and wake-approval-parking suites passed on macOS with Node 22, including the four cases from #18224. The repository build and typecheck also passed. After syncing main at `cefe53688b`, all 911 cases across 34 Hosted Harness Session test files passed on macOS with Node 22.22.3. The repository build and typecheck passed, as did ESLint and Prettier for the affected test. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS arm64, Node.js v26.12.1, pnpm 11.24.0, Vitest 3.2.7. The route tests use controlled Store and Broker fixtures. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: Shared mock initialization and per-file isolation must preserve suite behavior. The fixture installs mocks before route imports, route tests use isolated temporary roots, and the two cases that exercise the crash latch still run in order. - Not validated / out of scope: The local evidence covers macOS CLI route tests. Windows, Linux, and live Hosted/MySQL integration are outside this verification. - Breaking changes / migration notes: N/A. The diff is limited to CLI tests, fixtures, and test documentation. ## Linked Issues N/A
中文说明 ## What this PR does 把原来 50,579 行的 Hosted Harness Session 测试拆成 33 个可独立运行的文件，按文本 Turn、生命周期、唤醒派发、审批、恢复和相关路由组织。原入口保留核心文本 Turn 和事件流用例，缩短到 2,140 行。最长的文件是 3,590 行。各套件共用原有的 Harness、Store、模型和唤醒 fixture，并保留原套件展开后的全部 905 个用例。 Monitor 唤醒审批的 fixture 现在先写入 Monitor 测试数据并进入审批等待，再启动 idle 计时器。恢复用例会等待 Turn 持久结算且 attachment 空闲，再删除会话。设计说明和现有的测试引用也已指向相关套件。[English design](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/test/split-hosted-harness-session/docs/design/2026-11-24-hosted-harness-session-test-split.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/test/split-hosted-harness-session/docs/design/2026-11-24-hosted-harness-session-test-split.zh-CN.md) #18218 合入 main 时新增的 Hook owner 暂停用例也已移到命令步骤审批套件。#18224 新增的子会话问答和审批用例已放入审批和审批暂停套件。拆分后的 Monitor 唤醒审批套件也保留了 #18233 覆盖的关闭条件，等待恢复后的 Turn 释放会话的活跃槽位，再关闭会话。 ## Why it's needed 原来的大文件难以定位失败，也不便单独运行某一类行为。拆分后，审阅者可以按文件名选择更小的套件，Vitest 也可以把独立套件分配给不同 worker。并行执行还暴露了 Monitor fixture 的两处时序假设，分别发生在 journal 准备和测试清理阶段。 ## Reviewer Test Plan 确认这一组测试仍能收集并执行原有用例，包括参数化变体和已有的 #13328 回归用例。在 Monitor 唤醒测试中，确认声明能力时，已暂停的审批可经被动加载恢复。未声明能力时，审批仍留在常驻会话中。确认恢复的 Turn 在清理前完成结算并释放活跃槽位。 ### How to verify 1. 在 `packages/cli` 运行 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session --maxWorkers=5 --coverage.enabled=false`。预期 34 个文件共 911 个用例通过，其中包含已有的 #13328 回归用例、#18218 新增的 Hook owner 用例和 #18224 新增的子会话审批用例。 2. 针对时序调整，运行 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.wake-approval-parking.test.ts src/serve/hosted-harness-session.suspension.test.ts --maxWorkers=5 --coverage.enabled=false`。预期 11 个唤醒审批用例和 18 个挂起用例通过。 3. 在仓库根目录运行 `npm run build` 和 `npm run typecheck`。 以 `31e4e272d7` 为基线的本地验证通过语法树对比确认 591 条测试定义和 7 个模块 mock 一致，将一处随机 writer UUID 归一化后，展开的 905 个用例名称也全部一致。首轮全量通过 903 个用例，共 906 个，并在 Monitor 唤醒审批套件中暴露了 3 个时序失败。调整 fixture 后，5 个文件定向复测的 184 个用例全通过，覆盖原先失败的 3 个用例及相邻的挂起和接管套件。按每个文件的最新结果汇总，Hosted Harness Session 这一组的 906 个用例全部通过。仓库构建、类型检查，以及受影响文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查也通过。 合入 main 的 `5272afbc2f` 后，语法树对比确认拆分后的 592 条测试定义与当前原文件一致。审批暂停和唤醒审批套件在 macOS 上共 33 个用例通过，其中包括迁移后的 Hook owner 用例。合并后的仓库构建和类型检查也通过。 随后在 macOS 上使用 Node 22 全量运行 `acd4b3d77e` 的 907 个用例，全部通过。同步 main 的 `ea5b0467ca` 后，语法树对比确认 595 条测试定义全部一致，包括子会话审批用例。审批、审批暂停和唤醒审批套件在 macOS + Node 22 上共 77 个用例通过，其中包括 #18224 新增的 4 个用例。仓库构建和类型检查也通过。 同步 main 的 `cefe53688b` 后，在 macOS 上使用 Node 22.22.3 运行 Hosted Harness Session 的 34 个测试文件，911 个用例全部通过。仓库构建和类型检查通过，受影响测试文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查也通过。 ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A ### Tested on | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已验证 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未验证 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未验证 | ### Environment (optional) macOS arm64、Node.js v26.12.1、pnpm 11.24.0、Vitest 3.2.7。路由测试使用受控的 Store 和 Broker fixture。 ## Risk & Scope - 主要风险或取舍：共享 mock 的初始化顺序和文件间隔离需要保留套件原有行为。fixture 在导入路由模块前安装 mock，路由测试使用隔离的临时目录，验证崩溃锁存的两个用例仍按原顺序执行。 - 未验证或不在范围内：本地验证覆盖 macOS CLI 路由测试。Windows、Linux 及真实 Hosted/MySQL 集成未纳入本次验证。 - 破坏性变更或迁移说明：N/A。变更范围限于 CLI 测试、fixture 和测试文档。 ## prs.title: feat(managed-agent): park Hooks and MCP Session approval waits
prs.body:
> **Draft.** This holds slice S5 (Hooks) of Stage 4 in #18149 and the plan for S6b (the Harness side of MCP). The two land together as one PR, and both are now implemented. Do not merge before S6a (#18234) lands. As for the earlier stages, the real-process MySQL 8.4 cases belong to slice 3 of the parent design (acceptance and measurement), which gates turning the switch on, not this merge.
>
> This branch also carries #18231, merged in because the public-children Shell plus Hooks test builds on that PR's fixture. Until #18231 lands, its documentation and tests also appear in this diff; once it lands, merging `main` drops them. If this PR lands first, #18231 can be closed.

## What this PR does

This lets a tool approval wait on a Hooks Session park and resume, as designed in §4.5 of the Action parking coverage design, for a Session whose Hooks run on a config-scoped Hook owner (the owner an active extension set names).

- **Shape terms.** The Session-shape terms that park eligibility and every cold-recovery entry share now admit a Hooks Session when its Hook owner is config-scoped. Any other Hook owner refuses with a new typed reason, `hooks_activation_owner`, at capture and in the shared shape terms. A Session with both Hooks and MCP runs its Hooks on the MCP owner, so S6b below decides it.
- **Hook evidence in the continuation.** For each call, the saved continuation records the PreToolUse and PermissionRequest occurrences that completed before the wait, each with its result's digest. The reader accepts such a plan only for a config-scoped owner or, with S6b, the durable MCP owner its Hooks borrow. Two new capture refusals keep the waits it cannot prove resident: `hook_unsettled` (an occurrence has a record but no settled result) and `hooks_memory_batch` (a memory-only plan names no Runtime session, so it cannot name the Hook owner).
- **Read back, never rerun.** On resume, the batch first checks that the journal still holds exactly the Hook results the plan recorded, and declines otherwise. It then skips deciding its Hook inputs again: the saved calls already carry the inputs their Hooks left, and it reads back each PreToolUse ask and PermissionRequest allow from the saved results. PostToolUse after an Allow is a new occurrence and runs once.
- **Takeover.** A Hooks Session's saved native batch is resumed only by an explicit takeover load, like an extension command step. Any other load leaves the Turn's calls unanswered, because answering them would destroy the continuation (the R9-1 hazard), and a bare load answers 409.

The refusal key `hooks` disappears from the `parkRefusals` counts: those waits now count as `hooks_activation_owner`, `hooks_memory_batch` or `hook_unsettled`.

This PR also implements S6b, the Harness side of MCP parking (§4.6, "S6b detail"), so an approval wait on an MCP Session parks and resumes on the same durable owner:

- **Owner term.** One helper serves capture, the shared shape terms and the resume backstop. An MCP Session's batch is accepted on the durable `mcp-*` owner or a config-scoped one, and Hooks that borrow the MCP broker run on that owner and are accepted with it. An owner that fell back to an activation-scoped Hook owner refuses as `mcp_activation_owner`.
- **Catalog pin without a new field.** Capture and the reader admit MCP calls. Each saved MCP input already names its server, revisions and connection generation, and the tool's model name digests them. On resume, each MCP call is derived again from the reloaded catalog and must equal the saved input apart from its grant, or recovery declines. The execution loop renews the stale grant before the prepare, as the live path does, so the call runs once.
- **Eligibility.** A park refuses as `mcp_not_parkable` whenever the suspension would drain the MCP owner instead of parking it, using the same predicate the suspension applies. A drained owner would come back under a new connection generation, with different tool names. The park-only term that kept an MCP Session's command step resident is removed.
- **Takeover.** An MCP Session's saved native batch is resumed only by an explicit takeover load, as for a Hooks Session.
- **Pre-start checks,** confirmed by tests before implementing: across a parked suspension the durable MCP owner and its connection survive, and the next Turn sees identical tool declarations; a revalidating discover returns the whole catalog unchanged.

The `parkRefusals` key `mcp` disappears too: those waits now count as `mcp_activation_owner` or `mcp_not_parkable`.

## Why it's needed — and why it ships with S6b

Most real Sessions with waits carry Hooks, and until now every Hooks wait stayed resident.

Implementing S5 showed that it reaches almost no real wait on its own, which the design did not anticipate:

- A config-scoped Hook owner only comes from an extension set, and extension management runs only on the Shell profiles and the MCP profile.
- On a Shell profile the producer already refuses an ordinary native batch as `shell_profile` (S8a). The exception is public-children Sessions, which #18231 shows already capture Shell before dispatch.
- The MCP profile requires at least one MCP server, so its Sessions refuse as `mcp` until S6.
- Files-profile Hooks always run on an activation-scoped owner, which S5 refuses by design.

So S5 alone parks only public-children Shell batches whose extensions bring Hooks, and MCP-profile Sessions whose active extensions bring Hooks but no MCP servers. The real target is the MCP-profile Session with both Hooks and MCP, which is also what the proxy data in #18149 shows for every observed wait. That needs S6, and S6 must widen S5's owner term anyway, because there the Hook owner is the MCP owner. We therefore deliver S5 and S6b as one PR. S6a, the control-plane reclamation guard, ships separately first.

## S6b: what is left

- S6a (#18234), the reclamation guard, must land first.
- The real-process "park → new Harness generation → decide" cases on MySQL 8.4 belong to slice 3 of the parent design, with the parent §7 measurements; they gate turning the switch on.
- Shapes that follow from the shared terms but are not tested here: a wake-started Turn on an MCP Session, an extension command step on an MCP Session, and a Harness-level `mcp_activation_owner` refusal at capture (the shape terms and the resume backstop are unit-tested).
- The takeover guard's MCP term is not pinned by a failing test. The MCP profile has no file history, so these tests cannot reach the answer pass it protects. The shape that can is an MCP Session on a profile with file history, such as a public-children Shell Session whose extension brings MCP. Phase 1 never suspends those, so only crash recovery reaches it.
- To verify: that the MCP configuration cannot change during a park. By reading the code, the management route refuses while a Turn is active.
- The pin's limit, pinned by a test: a server that reports `tools/list_changed` during the park, or a dead connection, changes the tool names, and recovery declines. The parked Turn ends instead of continuing.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A two-call native batch on an extension's config-scoped Hook owner (MCP profile, extension set with Hooks and no MCP servers) parks after one idle period. Before the wait, PreToolUse rewrites the first call's input, and PermissionRequest allows the second call with a rewrite of its own, so only the first call asks. Expected:
  - The park hands back the owner's mount once and releases no row under the owner's id.
  - A bare load answers 409 `turn_unsettled` and writes nothing to the journal.
  - The passive load that decision delivery sends resumes the Turn. After Allow, no PreToolUse or PermissionRequest runs again, and each call runs once with the input its Hooks left. Each call's PostToolUse runs once on the same owner.
- The same wait, when its Harness dies in it and a new generation takes it over through a drive load, ends the same way.
- A Session-definition Hook catalog (activation-scoped owner) counts its wait once as `hooks_activation_owner` and stays resident.
- A saved Hooks plan declines on a Session without Hooks, when an occurrence has no settled result, and when a recorded result digest no longer matches.
- The shared shape terms admit only a config-scoped Hook owner, and name MCP before the Hook owner.
- A public-children Shell approval whose extension brings Hooks parks on the config-scoped owner, and also survives its Harness dying in the wait. PreToolUse rewrites the command before the wait. After the Allow, neither PreToolUse nor PermissionRequest runs again, the saved reservation is re-prepared once and runs the rewritten command once, and one PostToolUse fires on the same owner.
- On an MCP Session whose Broker parks MCP owners, a `write_file` approval, an MCP tool approval, and an MCP tool approval with a Session-definition Hook catalog each complete after the Allow, both after a park and after the Harness dies in the wait. A parked one answers a bare load with 409 and writes nothing, and no new MCP connection is configured after the park. The MCP call runs once under its saved runtime call ID, with a grant issued after the resume. The Hooks run on the durable MCP owner and are not rerun.
- When the Broker would drain the owner, the wait counts once as `mcp_not_parkable` and stays resident.
- When the catalog changed during the park, recovery declines, and nothing is prepared or executed.

The earlier "still to verify" item, that the resumed run fired no PostToolUse for the outer `skill` call, was a test artifact: that test's model stub never ran the driver's tool-Hook completion. The tests here run it, and every resumed call's PostToolUse fires once.

Locally on macOS:

- The cli typecheck is clean.
- The new and neighbouring park tests pass: three new Harness tests three times in a row, three new resume-decline tests, the Action parking unit tests, and the S1 and S7 park tests.
- In full runs, the tool-turn and continuation files pass (742 cases, after fixing a vacuous-truth bug the run found).
- The Harness Session file passes 905 of 909:
  - Two monitor-wake approval tests fail in the same way on unmodified `main`.
  - My activation-owner test was hardened against a reverted idle-suspension stamp.
  - One mode-change test passes when run alone; it still needs a full-file comparison against baseline.

Locally on Linux, for the public-children Shell plus Hooks test:

- Both cases pass, and both fail when capture refuses a Hooks Session again or when the resumed batch decides its Hooks again.
- The idle-suspension group passes 68 of 68 on this branch, with #18231 merged in, and the cli typecheck is clean.

Locally on Linux, for S6b:

- The eight new Harness cases pass. They fail when capture refuses MCP again, when the restored MCP call is not marked as MCP, when `mcp_not_parkable` is dropped, or when a Hook owner equal to the MCP owner is refused.
- The Action parking, continuation, tool-turn, MCP session and worker MCP runtime files pass in full (7, 81, 657, 86 and 48 tests), and so does the whole Harness Session file (933 of 933). The cli typecheck is clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — Harness park eligibility and recovery; no user-visible change while `action-parking.enabled` is off.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit and Harness integration tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the takeover now reads a saved continuation on every load of a Hooks Session with an unsettled Turn. Before S5 nothing wrote one for a native Hooks batch, so older journals are unaffected. A restored extension command step on a Hooks Session also reads its Hook decisions back instead of deciding them again. With S6b, a parked MCP Turn whose server changed its tools, or whose connection died, during the park ends recovery-blocked instead of continuing; that is the fail-safe direction.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real-process MySQL 8.4 cases (parent design slice 3), and the items under "S6b: what is left".
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; behind `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled`, default off. The `parkRefusals` keys `hooks` and `mcp` are replaced as described above.

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149 (Stage 4). Design: `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` and `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`, §4.5–§4.6. Depends on S6a (#18234). Includes #18231, merged into this branch. Related: #18218, #18186.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

> **草稿。** 本 PR 包含 #18149 阶段 4 的 S5（Hooks）切片，以及 S6b（MCP 的 Harness 侧）的计划。两者合成一个 PR 上线，现在都已实现。在 S6a（#18234）合入之前，请勿合入。与之前各阶段一样，MySQL 8.4 真实进程用例归父设计的切片 3（验收与测量），它是打开开关的前提，而不是本 PR 合入的前提。
>
> 本分支还合入了 #18231，因为 public children Shell 加 Hooks 的用例基于那个 PR 的 fixture。在 #18231 合入之前，它的文档和测试也会出现在本 PR 的 diff 里；它合入之后，把 `main` 合进来，这部分就会从 diff 中消失。如果本 PR 先合入，可以直接关闭 #18231。

## 本 PR 做了什么

按覆盖面设计 §4.5，让 Hooks Session 上的工具审批等待可以停靠并恢复，前提是它的 Hooks 跑在配置作用域的 Hook owner 上（即启用中的 extension 集合所命名的 owner）。

- **形态条件。** 停靠资格和所有冷恢复入口共用的 Session 形态条件，现在在 Hook owner 是配置作用域时接受 Hooks Session。其他 Hook owner 在捕获时和共享形态条件中都以新的带类型原因 `hooks_activation_owner` 拒绝。同时带 Hooks 和 MCP 的 Session 在 MCP owner 上运行 Hook，因此由下文的 S6b 决定。
- **continuation 中的 Hook 证据。** 保存的 continuation 为每个调用记录等待前已完成的 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 发生，以及各自结果的摘要。读取端只在配置作用域的 owner 上接受这种计划；有了 S6b，也接受其 Hook 所借用的持久 MCP owner。新增的两个捕获拒绝原因让无法证明的等待保持常驻：`hook_unsettled`（某个发生有记录但没有已结算的结果）和 `hooks_memory_batch`（纯 memory 计划不记录 Runtime session，因此无法记下 Hook owner）。
- **只读回，不重跑。** 恢复时，批次先核对日志里的 Hook 结果是否与计划记录的完全一致，不一致就拒绝恢复。之后不再重新决定 Hook 输入：保存的调用本来就带着 Hooks 修改后的输入，PreToolUse 的 ask 和 PermissionRequest 的 allow 都从保存的结果中读回。Allow 之后的 PostToolUse 是新的发生，运行一次。
- **接管。** Hooks Session 保存的原生批次只能由显式接管加载恢复，和 extension command step 一样。其他加载不会去回答这个 Turn 的调用，因为回答会毁掉 continuation（R9-1 那类问题）；裸加载返回 409。

`parkRefusals` 中的 `hooks` 键随之消失：这些等待现在计在 `hooks_activation_owner`、`hooks_memory_batch` 或 `hook_unsettled` 下。

本 PR 还实现了 S6b，即 MCP 停靠的 Harness 一侧（§4.6 的"S6b 细节"），让 MCP Session 上的审批等待可以停靠，并在同一个持久 owner 上恢复：

- **owner 条件。** 捕获、共享形态条件和恢复时的兜底检查共用一个辅助函数。MCP Session 的批次在持久的 `mcp-*` owner 或配置作用域 owner 上被接受；借用 MCP broker 的 Hook 运行在这个 owner 上，也随之被接受。退回到 activation 作用域 Hook owner 的 owner 以 `mcp_activation_owner` 拒绝。
- **无需新字段的目录 pin。** 捕获和读取端都接纳 MCP 调用。每个保存的 MCP 输入本来就写明了服务器、各项修订和连接代次，工具在 model 中的名字也是对它们做摘要得到的。恢复时，每个 MCP 调用都用重新加载后的目录再推导一次，除 grant 外必须与保存的输入相等，否则拒绝恢复。执行循环会在 prepare 之前续签过期的 grant，与线上路径相同，所以这个调用只执行一次。
- **资格。** 只要挂起会排空而不是停靠 MCP owner，停靠就以 `mcp_not_parkable` 拒绝，判断用的是挂起本身使用的那个条件。被排空的 owner 会以新的连接代次回来，工具名随之改变。让 MCP Session 上的 command step 保持常驻的停靠专属条件已删除。
- **接管。** 与 Hooks Session 一样，MCP Session 保存的原生批次只能由显式接管加载恢复。
- **开工前检查**，在实现前由测试确认：经过一次停靠式挂起，持久 MCP owner 及其连接都被保留，下一个 Turn 看到的工具声明完全相同；revalidate 的 discover 返回的整个目录不变。

`parkRefusals` 中的 `mcp` 键也随之消失：这些等待现在计在 `mcp_activation_owner` 或 `mcp_not_parkable` 下。

## 为什么需要，以及为什么和 S6b 一起上线

大多数真实的等待都来自带 Hooks 的 Session，而此前所有 Hooks 等待都保持常驻。

实现 S5 时发现，它单独上线几乎覆盖不到真实的等待，这一点设计没有预料到：

- 配置作用域的 Hook owner 只来自 extension 集合，而 extension 管理只在 Shell profile 和 MCP profile 上运行。
- 在 Shell profile 上，生产者本来就会把普通原生批次以 `shell_profile` 拒绝（属于 S8a）。例外是 public children Session，#18231 表明它们已经能捕获派发前的 Shell。
- MCP profile 要求至少一个 MCP server，所以它的 Session 在 S6 之前以 `mcp` 拒绝。
- Files profile 上的 Hooks 总是跑在 activation 作用域的 owner 上，S5 按设计拒绝它。

因此 S5 单独只能停靠两种情况：extension 带 Hooks 的 public children Shell 批次，以及启用中的 extension 带 Hooks 但没有 MCP server 的 MCP profile Session。真正的目标是同时带 Hooks 和 MCP 的 MCP profile Session，这也是 #18149 代理数据中每一次观测到的等待的形态。这需要 S6，而且 S6 无论如何都要放宽 S5 的 owner 条件，因为那里 Hook owner 就是 MCP owner。所以 S5 和 S6b 合成一个 PR 交付。S6a（控制面回收守卫）单独先上线。

## S6b：还剩什么

- 回收守卫 S6a（#18234）必须先合入。
- "停靠 → 新一代 Harness → 决定"的 MySQL 8.4 真实进程用例，与父设计 §7 的测量一起归父设计的切片 3；它们是打开开关的前提。
- 随共享条件一起放开、但这里没有测试的形态：MCP Session 上由 wake 启动的 Turn、MCP Session 上的 extension command step，以及在捕获环节触发 `mcp_activation_owner` 的 Harness 级用例（形态条件和恢复兜底检查有单元测试）。
- 接管守卫中关于 MCP 的条件没有会失败的测试固定。MCP profile 没有 file history，所以这些测试走不到它保护的那条回答流程。能走到的形态是 profile 带 file history 的 MCP Session，例如 extension 带 MCP 的 public children Shell Session。Phase 1 从不挂起这类 Session，只有崩溃恢复会走到。
- 待验证：停靠期间 MCP 配置无法改变。读代码可知，Turn 活跃时管理路由会拒绝。
- pin 的边界（已有测试固定）：停靠期间服务器发出 `tools/list_changed`，或者连接已死，工具名都会改变，恢复会被拒绝。停靠的 Turn 会结束，而不是继续。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在 extension 的配置作用域 Hook owner 上（MCP profile，extension 集合带 Hooks、没有 MCP server），一个两调用的原生批次经过一个空闲周期后停靠。等待之前，PreToolUse 改写第一个调用的输入，PermissionRequest 放行第二个调用并改写它的输入，所以只有第一个调用需要审批。预期：
  - 停靠时交还该 owner 的 mount 一次，不释放这个 owner id 下的任何行。
  - 裸加载返回 409 `turn_unsettled`，不向日志写任何东西。
  - 决定投递发出的被动加载恢复这个 Turn。Allow 之后，PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 都不再运行；每个调用以 Hooks 留下的输入各运行一次；每个调用的 PostToolUse 在同一个 owner 上各运行一次。
- 同一个等待，如果 Harness 在等待中死亡、新一代通过 drive 加载接管，结果完全相同。
- Session 定义自带的 Hook catalog（activation 作用域 owner）：等待以 `hooks_activation_owner` 计数一次，并保持常驻。
- 保存的 Hooks 计划在以下情况拒绝恢复：Session 没有 Hooks；某个发生没有已结算的结果；记录的结果摘要不再匹配。
- 共享形态条件只接受配置作用域的 Hook owner，并且把 MCP 排在 Hook owner 之前判断。
- extension 带 Hooks 的 public children Shell 审批在配置作用域的 owner 上停靠，并且在 Harness 于等待中死亡后同样能恢复。等待前，PreToolUse 改写了命令。Allow 之后，PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 都不再运行，保存的 reservation 只重新 prepare 一次，并且只执行一次改写后的命令，同一个 owner 上触发一次 PostToolUse。
- 在 Broker 会停靠 MCP owner 的 MCP Session 上，`write_file` 审批、MCP 工具审批，以及带 Session 定义 Hook 目录的 MCP 工具审批，在停靠之后和 Harness 于等待中死亡之后，都能在 Allow 后完成。停靠中的等待对裸加载返回 409，且不写入任何内容；停靠之后没有配置新的 MCP 连接。MCP 调用以保存的 runtime 调用 ID 只执行一次，使用恢复之后签发的 grant。Hook 运行在持久 MCP owner 上，不会重跑。
- Broker 会排空 owner 时，等待计一次 `mcp_not_parkable` 并保持常驻。
- 停靠期间目录发生变化时，恢复被拒绝，不会 prepare 或执行任何调用。

之前"还要验证"的一项（恢复后的运行没有为外层 `skill` 调用触发 PostToolUse）是测试本身造成的：那个测试的 model 替身从不运行驱动里补全工具 Hook 的那一步。这里的测试会运行它，每个恢复的调用的 PostToolUse 都触发了一次。

本地（macOS）：

- cli 的 typecheck 没有错误。
- 新增的和相邻的停靠测试都通过：三个新 Harness 测试连跑三次都通过；三个新的恢复拒绝测试；Action parking 单元测试；S1 和 S7 的停靠测试。
- 完整运行时，tool-turn 和 continuation 两个文件全部通过（742 个用例，此前修掉了这次运行发现的一个空数组恒真 bug）。
- Harness Session 文件 909 个通过 905 个：
  - 两个 monitor wake 审批测试在未修改的 `main` 上同样失败。
  - 我自己的 activation owner 测试已改为不受被撤回的 idle 挂起 stamp 影响。
  - 一个改审批模式的测试单独运行能通过，还需要和基线做一次完整文件的对比。

本地（Linux），针对 public children Shell 加 Hooks 的用例：

- 两个用例都通过；当捕获重新拒绝 Hooks Session，或恢复的批次重新判定 Hook 时，两个用例都会失败。
- 合入 #18231 后，本分支的 idle-suspension 测试组 68 个全部通过，cli 的 typecheck 没有错误。

本地（Linux），针对 S6b：

- 新增的 8 个 Harness 用例都通过。当捕获重新拒绝 MCP、恢复出的 MCP 调用没有标记为 MCP、去掉 `mcp_not_parkable`，或者拒绝等于 MCP owner 的 Hook owner 时，这些用例会失败。
- Action parking、continuation、tool-turn、MCP session 和 worker MCP runtime 五个测试文件完整通过（分别为 7、81、657、86、48 个测试），整个 Harness Session 文件也通过（933 个全部通过）。cli 的 typecheck 没有错误。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：只改 Harness 的停靠资格和恢复；`action-parking.enabled` 关闭时没有用户可见的变化。

### 环境

只运行了单元测试和 Harness 集成测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：带未结算 Turn 的 Hooks Session，现在每次加载时接管都会读取一次保存的 continuation。S5 之前不会为带 Hooks 的原生批次写 continuation，所以旧日志不受影响。Hooks Session 上恢复的 extension command step 也改为读回 Hook 决定，而不是重新决定。有了 S6b，如果停靠期间服务器改变了工具，或者连接已死，停靠的 MCP Turn 会以 recovery blocked 结束，而不是继续；这是安全的失败方向。
- 未验证 / 范围外：MySQL 8.4 真实进程用例（父设计切片 3），以及"S6b：还剩什么"中列出的各项。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；在默认关闭的 `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled` 之后。`parkRefusals` 的 `hooks` 和 `mcp` 键按上文所述被替换。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149（阶段 4）。设计：`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md` 与 `docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`，§4.5–§4.6。依赖 S6a（#18234）。已合入 #18231。相关：#18218、#18186。

</details>

prs.title: fix(hooks): apply PermissionRequest updatedPermissions rules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A PermissionRequest hook that allows a tool call can now also return `updatedPermissions`, and Qwen applies them. Each entry of type `addRules` adds permission rules the same way an "Always allow" choice does, so later matching calls are decided by the rule instead of asking again. This works in the terminal UI and in ACP sessions.

An entry follows the shared hooks contract: `rules` is a list of `{ toolName, ruleContent }`, each becoming the rule `toolName(ruleContent)` (or just `toolName`); `behavior` is `allow`, `deny` or `ask`; `destination` says where the rule goes. `session` keeps the rule in memory for the session. `projectSettings` and `localSettings` write it to the project settings, which is also where "Always allow" for the project writes. `userSettings` writes it to the user settings. Tool names follow the same rules as `permissions` settings, so `Bash` and `run_shell_command` both work.

Entries are applied only when the merged decision is `allow` and that allow actually decides the call. A deny, or an allow that still needs a person's confirmation, leaves the rules alone. Other entry types (`setMode`, `replaceRules`, `removeRules`, the directory entries) and malformed entries are skipped and noted in the debug log. If writing one rule to a settings file fails, that rule is skipped and the rest still apply. The hooks guide documents the field with an example.

## Why it's needed

The hooks guide listed `updatedPermissions` as a PermissionRequest output, and outputs from several hooks were already merged into one list, but nothing read that list. A hook written to approve a command once and remember the approval ("allow `npm test`, and don't ask again") silently lost the second half, so the hook ran, and in a hook-less setup the prompt appeared, for every later call. This is item A2 of #18217.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Add a user-level PermissionRequest hook on `run_shell_command` that returns `{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PermissionRequest", "decision": {"behavior": "allow", "updatedPermissions": [{"type": "addRules", "rules": [{"toolName": "Bash", "ruleContent": "touch marker.txt"}], "behavior": "allow", "destination": "projectSettings"}]}}}` and counts its calls. In the terminal UI with the default approval mode, ask Qwen to run `touch marker.txt` twice, one call after the other.

- Expected: the hook runs once, the project's `.qwen/settings.json` gains `permissions.allow: ["Bash(touch marker.txt)"]`, and the second call runs without the hook or a prompt.
- With `"destination": "session"`, the hook also runs once and no settings file is written; with `"userSettings"`, the rule lands in `~/.qwen/settings.json`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive TUI in a private tmux server, isolated HOME, Token Plan `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`:

- Before (released 0.27.4): the hook ran 2 times and no settings file was written.
- After (this branch): `projectSettings` → the hook ran once and the project settings contained `"allow": ["Bash(touch marker.txt)"]`; `session` → once, nothing written; `userSettings` → once, the user settings contained the rule.

New unit tests cover the entry translation (session rules for each behavior, the three persisted destinations, skipped entries, a failed write), the hook result carrying the updates only for an allow, and the scheduler and ACP paths applying them. With the fix reverted, the scheduler, hook-result and ACP tests fail.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22, the bundled CLI (`node dist/cli.js`) in the interactive TUI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a hook can now persist rules to the project or user settings. Hooks already decide the call itself, and project hooks run only after approval or folder trust; while AUTO mode strips dangerous allow rules, such a rule from a hook is held back the same way as one from "Always allow".
- Not validated / out of scope: only `addRules` is applied. `setMode`, `replaceRules`, `removeRules`, `addDirectories` and `removeDirectories` are skipped. Qwen does not yet fill `permission_suggestions` in the hook input, so a hook cannot echo a suggestion back; that is a follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Hooks that already returned `updatedPermissions` start having them applied, which is what the guide described.

## Linked Issues

Part of #18217 (item A2).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

允许工具调用的 PermissionRequest hook 现在还可以返回 `updatedPermissions`，Qwen 会应用它们。每个 `addRules` 类型的条目都会像用户选择“始终允许”那样添加权限规则，之后匹配的调用直接由规则决定，不再询问。终端 UI 和 ACP 会话都支持。

条目格式遵循共享的 hooks 契约：`rules` 是一组 `{ toolName, ruleContent }`，每一项变成规则 `toolName(ruleContent)`（没有 `ruleContent` 时就是 `toolName`）；`behavior` 是 `allow`、`deny` 或 `ask`；`destination` 决定规则写到哪里。`session` 只在本会话的内存里保留。`projectSettings` 和 `localSettings` 写入项目设置，也就是“始终允许（项目）”写入的位置。`userSettings` 写入用户设置。工具名的规则和 `permissions` 设置相同，`Bash` 和 `run_shell_command` 都可以用。

只有当合并后的决定是 `allow`，并且这个 allow 真正决定了这次调用时，条目才会被应用。deny，或者仍需要人确认的 allow，都不会改动规则。其它条目类型（`setMode`、`replaceRules`、`removeRules` 和目录相关条目）以及格式不对的条目会被跳过，并记录到 debug 日志。某条规则写入设置文件失败时只跳过这一条，其余照常应用。hooks 指南补充了这个字段的说明和示例。

## 为什么需要

hooks 指南把 `updatedPermissions` 列为 PermissionRequest 的输出，多个 hook 的输出也已经合并成一个列表，但没有任何地方读取它。一个想“这次放行并记住”的 hook（“允许 `npm test`，以后别再问”），后半部分会被静默丢掉，于是之后每次调用 hook 都要再跑一次；没有 hook 兜底时则会再次弹出确认。这是 #18217 的 A2 项。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

添加一个用户级的 `run_shell_command` PermissionRequest hook，让它返回 `{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PermissionRequest", "decision": {"behavior": "allow", "updatedPermissions": [{"type": "addRules", "rules": [{"toolName": "Bash", "ruleContent": "touch marker.txt"}], "behavior": "allow", "destination": "projectSettings"}]}}}`，并记录调用次数。在终端 UI 中以默认审批模式让 Qwen 先后两次运行 `touch marker.txt`。

- 预期：hook 只运行一次，项目的 `.qwen/settings.json` 新增 `permissions.allow: ["Bash(touch marker.txt)"]`，第二次调用不经过 hook 也不弹确认就直接运行。
- 改用 `"destination": "session"` 时，hook 同样只运行一次，不写任何设置文件；改用 `"userSettings"` 时，规则写入 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。

### 证据（修改前后）

在私有 tmux server 中运行交互式 TUI，使用隔离的 HOME 和 Token Plan 的 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731`：

- 修改前（已发布的 0.27.4）：hook 运行了 2 次，没有写入任何设置文件。
- 修改后（本分支）：`projectSettings` → hook 运行 1 次，项目设置里有 `"allow": ["Bash(touch marker.txt)"]`；`session` → 1 次，不写文件；`userSettings` → 1 次，用户设置里有这条规则。

新增的单元测试覆盖了条目转换（三种 behavior 的会话规则、三种持久化 destination、被跳过的条目、写入失败）、hook 结果只在 allow 时携带这些更新，以及调度器和 ACP 两条路径确实应用了它们。撤掉修复后，调度器、hook 结果和 ACP 的测试都会失败。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node 22，在交互式 TUI 中运行打包后的 CLI（`node dist/cli.js`）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：hook 现在可以把规则持久化到项目或用户设置。hook 本来就能决定这次调用，项目 hook 也只有在批准或文件夹信任之后才会运行；AUTO 模式会剥离危险的 allow 规则，hook 添加的这类规则同样会被暂扣，和“始终允许”添加的一样。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：只应用 `addRules`。`setMode`、`replaceRules`、`removeRules`、`addDirectories` 和 `removeDirectories` 会被跳过。Qwen 目前还没有在 hook 输入里填写 `permission_suggestions`，所以 hook 还无法把建议原样返回，这一项作为后续工作。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。已经在返回 `updatedPermissions` 的 hook 会开始生效，这正是指南描述的行为。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18217（A2 项）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): keep the main failure reporter filing without its PAT
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the workflow that records a red `main` survive a missing reporting credential: the bot PAT becomes optional, and when it is absent the job files with the workflow token instead of dying on an unauthenticated CLI. The identity that existing filings are searched under is chosen together with the token, so a recurring failure comments on the aggregate it already owns rather than opening a duplicate every time.

Also stops the daemon session test fixtures from spinning the provider's reconnect loop. A fixture stream that returns the moment it has delivered its events leaves the provider re-subscribing once per millisecond for the entire window a case spends waiting between assertions. Those fixtures now stay alive until the provider aborts them, which is what the shared idle-stream fixtures already did. The continuation-recovery cleanup also attaches a handler to the rejection it raises after unmounting, so it no longer escapes as an unhandled error.

## Why it's needed

`main` looked catastrophically red, but the failures were not one broken change — they were four independent things, and the loudest one was the messenger itself.

The failure reporter authenticated every call with a bot PAT the repository does not carry, so the CLI refused to start and the job exited 1. Ten consecutive reporter runs failed this way, which means ten real `main` failures were never recorded anywhere. A workflow whose whole purpose is to make a red `main` visible was the least reliable job on the branch.

Behind those reports, the unit-test lane failed ~94–97 cases in the daemon session provider suite, always starting from whichever case first hit the loaded machine, with everything after it asserting against a provider that never established state. The runs are not flaky in the usual sense: they are deterministic once the host is busy. The failing run logged 63,094 stream-end lines against 6,278 in a healthy run of the same commit range, and the burst concentrates in a handful of cases that configure a 1 ms reconnect delay — one case spent 58 s and 17,600 re-subscriptions inside a single `await wait(50)`. Neither the suite nor the provider changed in the commit range where this started; the fixture pattern is long-standing and only becomes fatal when the shared runner is loaded (the failing runs sat at load ~110 on 64 CPUs, the healthy one at ~12). Nine unhandled rejections from a cleanup path made the Linux lane red on their own account as well.

The remaining red on `main` is not code and is not addressed here: the E2E lanes all fail with `401 API-key is blocked` and need a working model key, and three bot workflows fail because their credentials are absent (`CI_DEV_BOT_PAT`, `QWEN_CODE_BOT_TOKEN` / `CI_BOT_PAT`). One patrol run failed on runner networking. Those need someone with repository settings access.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

For the reporter, run the workflow's meta-test suite. It executes the real writer script against a stubbed CLI, so it covers the new credential branch end to end: with no PAT the job must still create the filing, must warn that the PAT is unconfigured, and must have used the workflow token; a second occurrence authored by the fallback identity must be commented on rather than re-filed; and with the PAT present the job must still write as the reporting bot and never touch the workflow token. Confirm the token and the lookup identity are chosen in the same branch — a fallback filing searched under the bot's login would certify a false miss and duplicate on every recurrence.

For the fixtures, run the daemon session provider suite and watch the stream-end traffic rather than only the pass count. Every case should still pass, and the cases that assert reconnection survives a server-initiated close must still observe the session handle preserved — the fix keeps the reconnect semantics and only removes the idle spinning. Locally the three server-initiated-close cases went from 43, 39 and 35 re-subscriptions each to zero, and the file's total stream-end lines dropped from 195 to 68 with an unchanged 545 passing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible change. Reporter suite: 189 passed. Daemon session provider suite: 545 passed both before and after locally (the failure only manifests on a loaded Linux runner); the re-subscription counts above are the measured difference. The hosted-session close race that also appeared in these runs was fixed independently by #18233 while this was in flight, so it is deliberately not duplicated here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. The local dependency tree predates the current lockfile, so the SDK runtime bundles were regenerated with esbuild to let the two suites load; no repository build or lint gate was run locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: when the reporting PAT is absent, filings are authored by `github-actions[bot]` instead of the reporting bot. That is a different author from any pre-existing aggregate, so the first fallback filing opens a new issue rather than adopting the bot's older one. This is deliberate — searching under the wrong identity is what would duplicate on every run — and it self-heals once the PAT is restored.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local Windows or Linux run, and no repository-wide build, typecheck or lint. The blocked E2E model key and the missing bot credentials are repository settings, not code, and are untouched here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Restoring `CI_DEV_BOT_PAT` returns the reporter to its previous identity with no further change.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让记录 `main` 失败的那条 workflow 在缺少上报凭据时仍然能落单：bot PAT 变为可选，缺失时改用 workflow token 提交，而不是让未认证的 CLI 直接把 job 打挂。查找已有 issue 时使用的身份与 token 在同一处分支里一起决定，因此同一故障复发时会评论到它自己已有的汇总 issue，而不是每次都新建一个。

同时让 daemon session 的测试 fixture 不再把 provider 的重连循环空转起来。一个投递完事件就立刻结束的 fixture 流，会让 provider 在用例等待断言的整个窗口里每毫秒重新订阅一次。这些 fixture 现在会一直存活到 provider 主动 abort，与已有的空闲流 fixture 行为一致。continuation recovery 的清理逻辑也给自己在 unmount 之后抛出的 rejection 挂上了处理函数，不再逃逸成 unhandled error。

## 为什么需要

`main` 看起来红得离谱，但这些失败并不是同一个坏改动，而是四件互相独立的事，其中最吵的一件恰恰是报信者本身。

失败上报 workflow 的每次调用都用一个仓库里并不存在的 bot PAT 认证，于是 CLI 拒绝启动、job 退出 1。连续十次上报都是这样失败的，也就是说十次真实的 `main` 失败根本没有被记录到任何地方。一条存在的意义就是让红 `main` 可见的 workflow，反而成了分支上最不可靠的 job。

在这些上报背后，单测 lane 在 daemon session provider 套件里挂掉约 94–97 个用例，起点总是最先撞上高负载机器的那个用例，之后所有用例都在断言一个从未建立起状态的 provider。这些 run 不是通常意义上的 flaky：机器一忙就是确定性失败。失败 run 打了 63,094 行 stream-end 日志，同一 commit 区间的健康 run 只有 6,278 行，而爆发集中在少数几个配置了 1 ms 重连延迟的用例上——其中一个用例在单次 `await wait(50)` 里花了 58 秒、重订阅 17,600 次。这套测试和 provider 在问题开始的 commit 区间里都没有改动；这个 fixture 写法长期存在，只是在共享 runner 高负载时才致命（失败 run 在 64 核上 load 约 110，健康 run 约 12）。清理路径产生的 9 个 unhandled rejection 也足以单独把 Linux lane 判红。

`main` 上剩下的红不是代码问题，本 PR 不处理：E2E 各 lane 全部 `401 API-key is blocked`，需要换可用的模型 key；另有三条 bot workflow 因凭据缺失而失败（`CI_DEV_BOT_PAT`、`QWEN_CODE_BOT_TOKEN` / `CI_BOT_PAT`）。还有一次 patrol 失败是 runner 网络问题。这些需要有仓库设置权限的人处理。

## 评审验证方式

上报部分跑该 workflow 的 meta 测试套件。它会用 stub CLI 执行真实的 writer 脚本，因此端到端覆盖了新的凭据分支：没有 PAT 时 job 仍必须建单、必须给出 PAT 未配置的 warning、且必须用的是 workflow token；由回退身份写下的第二次 occurrence 必须被评论而不是重新建单；有 PAT 时 job 仍必须以 reporting bot 身份写入、且绝不使用 workflow token。请确认 token 与查找身份是在同一个分支里选定的——用 bot 的 login 去找回退身份写下的单，会认定 miss 并在每次复发时重复建单。

fixture 部分跑 daemon session provider 套件，除了通过数更要看 stream-end 流量。所有用例应仍然通过，且断言「服务端主动关闭后仍继续重连」的用例必须仍观察到 session handle 被保留——本次修改保留重连语义，只去掉空转。本地三个服务端关闭用例的重订阅次数分别从 43、39、35 降到 0，整个文件的 stream-end 行数从 195 降到 68，545 个用例通过数不变。

## 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 无用户可见变化。上报套件 189 通过。daemon session provider 套件本地修改前后均为 545 通过（该失败只在高负载 Linux runner 上显现）；上面的重订阅次数是实测差异。这批 run 里同时出现的 hosted-session 关闭竞态，在本 PR 进行中已由 #18233 独立修掉，因此这里刻意不重复。

## 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows、Linux 未测。

## 环境

仅单测。本地依赖树早于当前 lockfile，因此用 esbuild 重新生成了 SDK 运行时产物以便这两个套件加载；本地未跑仓库级 build 或 lint 门禁。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 取舍：缺少上报 PAT 时，单据作者是 `github-actions[bot]` 而不是 reporting bot。这与任何已有汇总 issue 的作者不同，所以第一次回退落单会新建 issue，而不是接管 bot 早先那个。这是刻意为之——用错身份查找才是导致每次重复建单的原因——PAT 恢复后会自行收敛。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：未做本地 Windows、Linux 运行，也未跑仓库级 build、typecheck、lint。被封的 E2E 模型 key 与缺失的 bot 凭据属于仓库设置而非代码，这里不动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。恢复 `CI_DEV_BOT_PAT` 即可让上报回到原身份，无需其他改动。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): add tiered sandbox execution for PR reviews
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change brings the tiered, trust-aware sandbox execution model recently established for PR verification (#18181) to the code-execution phases of PR review, while keeping existing review sandbox modes backward-compatible.

- Introduces trust classification and mandatory high-risk escalation for PR reviews, separating local and trusted collaborator changes on ordinary source files from external fork PRs, unknown trust metadata, missing file lists, and high-risk supply-chain, CI, agent configuration, build/sandbox tooling, executable, symlink, submodule, or binary changes (including renames from high-risk paths).
- Extends the review sandbox policy with a new tiered mode alongside the existing off, auto, and required modes, plus operator-only backend selection and emergency hardware-isolation override controls that are blocked from repository environment files and workspace settings.
- Hardens the lightweight container tier with least-privilege capability dropping, no-new-privileges, a bounded PID ceiling, and post-termination verification that reports whether a timed-out container actually stopped.
- Adds a fail-closed backend selection and prerequisite-planning layer covering shared-kernel containers as well as Linux KVM microVMs, macOS Apple Silicon sandboxed microVMs, and cloud disposable sandboxes with explicit non-default isolated templates, ensuring hardware-isolated runs never silently downgrade to shared-kernel containers or host execution.
- Closes host-execution bypasses on the interactive and scripted terminal driving subcommands so they refuse fail-closed before touching tmux whenever containment or hardware isolation is required, and records structured execution-boundary metadata across review execution reports while propagating author association from PR metadata with zero extra GitHub API calls.

## Why it's needed

PR review runs untrusted repository commands during install, build, test, mutation probing, baseline reruns, and terminal driving. Previously, review containment treated every PR identically with an unhardened single container tier, lacked verifiable container teardown after timeouts, left terminal-driving probes ungated on the host even when sandboxing was required, and did not disclose the trust classification, execution class, backend, escalations, or teardown status in execution reports. Aligning review execution with the tiered fail-closed boundary established in #18181 prevents untrusted or high-risk PRs from silently executing on a shared kernel or on the host.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm that existing off, auto, and required review sandbox behaviors remain backward-compatible for local and containerized runs, and that tiered ranks stricter than required when combined with operator settings.
- Confirm that repository environment files cannot set or weaken any of the review sandbox policy, image, backend, or hardware-isolation override variables.
- Confirm that every containerized review command includes least-privilege capability dropping, no-new-privileges, and a PID limit, and that post-timeout cleanup verifies whether the container is actually gone or still running.
- Confirm that under tiered mode, a same-repository collaborator PR touching ordinary source files is eligible for a hardened container, whereas an external fork PR, an unknown-trust PR, a PR with missing file metadata, or a collaborator PR touching dependency manifests, lockfiles, patches, workflows, agent config, scripts, executables, symlinks, or submodules resolves to hardware isolation and refuses fail-closed even when Docker is running.
- Confirm that under required, tiered, or the operator hardware-isolation override, the host tmux driving and TUI capture review subcommands refuse before invoking tmux or creating capture artifacts, and that build/test, mutation probe, baseline delta, and drive reports include structured execution-boundary metadata reflecting the real backend used (reporting direct rather than container under auto mode when a local checkout cannot be mounted).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CLI execution-boundary, configuration schema, and design documentation changes; no TUI layout changes).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS Apple Silicon environment with Node 24, full workspace build, full TypeScript typecheck (including integration test typecheck), ESLint, Prettier, and targeted Vitest unit and real-git/tmux integration suites for the review execution commands.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Under tiered mode, any hardware-isolated review currently refuses fail-closed rather than running in a shared-kernel container until the Phase 2 inline guest execution transport is attached; operators on existing off, auto, or required modes are unaffected unless they explicitly opt into tiered mode or the hardware-isolation override.
- Not validated / out of scope: CI workflow changes and workflow meta-test updates, live guest RPC command streaming for Firecracker/vfkit/cloud sandboxes (Phase 2), and native Windows/Linux execution (covered by CI).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No breaking changes for existing off, auto, or required configurations; reports gain an optional structured execution-boundary object.
- Design documentation (synchronized bilingual pair): [English](docs/design/2026-11-24-review-tiered-sandbox.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-review-tiered-sandbox.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #18181.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本次改动参考近期 PR 验证落地的多层微虚机隔离方案（#18181），将分信任等级、fail-closed 的沙箱执行模型引入 PR 评审的代码执行阶段，同时保持既有评审沙箱模式完全向后兼容。

- 为 PR 评审引入信任分级与高风险强制升级机制：将本地评审和受信协作者对普通源码的修改，与外部 fork PR、信任信息未知、变更文件缺失以及触及依赖清单/lockfile/补丁、CI 工作流、Agent 配置、构建与沙箱脚本、可执行文件、符号链接、子模块或二进制文件（含从高风险路径重命名）的变更严格区隔。
- 在既有 off、auto、required 三档评审沙箱策略基础上新增 tiered 分档模式，并补充仅限操作者生效的后端选择与应急硬件隔离开关，全部阻断来自仓库环境变量文件与工作区配置的覆盖。
- 对轻量容器档进行安全硬化，统一附加最小权限 capability 移除、禁止提权与 PID 上限，并将超时后的容器清理升级为可核验销毁状态，避免静默遗留仍在运行的容器。
- 建立 fail-closed 的分层后端选路与前提规划层，覆盖共享内核容器以及 Linux KVM 微虚机、macOS Apple Silicon 受限微虚机与要求显式非默认隔离模板的云端一次性沙箱，确保需要硬件隔离的任务绝不静默降级为共享内核容器或宿主机执行。
- 封堵交互式与脚本化终端驱动评审子命令的宿主机执行旁路，在要求隔离或硬件隔离时于调用 tmux 前直接 fail-closed 拒绝；为各评审执行报告附带结构化执行边界元数据，并在不增加额外 GitHub API 请求的前提下透传 PR 作者关联信息。

## 为什么需要这个改动

PR 评审会在依赖安装、构建、测试、变异探针、基线重跑和终端驱动等多个阶段执行被评审仓库代码。此前评审沙箱对所有 PR 一视同仁地使用未硬化的单层容器，超时清理不校验容器是否真正退出，终端驱动类探针在要求沙箱隔离时仍直接在宿主机运行，且执行报告中缺少信任级别、执行档位、实际后端、升级触发原因与清理状态的结构化披露。向 #18181 的分层 fail-closed 边界对齐后，可以避免不可信或高风险 PR 静默落入共享内核容器或宿主机环境。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

- 确认既有 off、auto、required 策略在本地与容器场景下完全向后兼容，且 tiered 在与操作者配置合并时严格度高于 required。
- 确认仓库环境变量文件无法注入或放宽任何评审沙箱策略、镜像、后端或硬件隔离强制开关变量。
- 确认所有容器化评审命令均附加最小权限 capability 移除、禁止提权与 PID 限制，且超时清理后会核验容器是否真实消失或停止。
- 确认在 tiered 模式下，同仓协作者仅修改普通源码时允许走硬化容器；而外部 fork PR、未知信任 PR、缺失变更文件列表的 PR，或协作者触及依赖清单、lockfile、补丁、工作流、Agent 配置、脚本、可执行文件、符号链接或子模块时，均归类为硬件隔离，即便本机 Docker 可用也会 fail-closed 拒绝而不降级。
- 确认在 required、tiered 或操作者硬件隔离强制开关生效时，宿主机 tmux 驱动与 TUI 截屏评审子命令会在触发 tmux 或落盘产物前直接拒绝，且构建测试、变异探针、基线对比和终端驱动报告均包含如实反映实际后端的结构化执行边界元数据（例如 auto 模式下本地不可挂载目录如实标记为 direct 而非 container）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（属于 CLI 执行边界、配置 schema 与设计文档改动，无 TUI 界面布局变化）。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

本地 macOS Apple Silicon + Node 24，执行全仓构建、全仓 TypeScript 类型检查（含集成测试类型检查）、ESLint、Prettier 以及评审执行相关 Vitest 单元测试与真实 git/tmux 集成测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：在 Phase 2 实时 guest 执行传输接入前，tiered 模式下被归类为硬件隔离的评审会严格 fail-closed 拒绝，而不会降级到共享内核容器；仍使用 off、auto、required 的用户除非显式开启 tiered 或硬件隔离强制开关，否则不受影响。
- 未验证 / 不在本次范围：CI workflow 切换与对应 workflow meta-tests 更新、Firecracker/vfkit/云端沙箱的实时 guest 命令流桥接（属于 Phase 2），以及 Windows/Linux 原生运行（由 CI 覆盖）。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：对既有 off、auto、required 配置无破坏性变更；执行报告新增可选的结构化执行边界字段。
- 双语设计文档（内容完整同步）：[English](docs/design/2026-11-24-review-tiered-sandbox.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-review-tiered-sandbox.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #18181。

</details>

prs.title: perf(web-shell): scope library CSS with native @scope and remove :has() subtree wildcards
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Switches embedded Web Shell library stylesheets from prepending a large universal-descendant selector prefix onto every selector branch to wrapping component rules in native CSS `@scope` blocks, simplifies pre-scoped root and preflight rules inside the scope to `:scope`, hoists global declarative at-rules (`@charset`, `@import`, `@font-face`, `@property`, and `@keyframes`, including nested `@keyframes`) outside `@scope`, and preserves root-element class matching by emitting a zero-specificity `:where(:scope)` compound branch alongside each descendant selector without using universal `*` rules.

Replaces four Tailwind `group-has-*` utilities in shared UI primitives that previously compiled to descendant-wildcard `:has(...) *` selectors with attribute-based group selectors or direct-child selectors, preventing Blink from generating whole-subtree style invalidation sets across the host document.

Adds build-artifact regression checks covering both the main and transcript bundles as well as the lazy terminal stylesheet chunk to guarantee that all component rules stay inside `@scope`, global declarative at-rules stay at the top level, legacy universal `:where(...)` scoping prefixes do not return, and `:has(...) *` descendant wildcards do not regress.

## Why it's needed

In embedded host applications where the composer glow is already disabled and layout containment is already active, selecting all text and deleting it in the composer still caused a noticeable 360–400 ms stall made up of three consecutive ~120–135 ms style recalculations. Chrome DevTools `SelectorStats` and Blink invalidation traces showed two compounding causes: first, prepending a `:where(... *)` prefix containing descendant `*` onto every rule broke Blink's ancestor Bloom filter (`fastReject = 0`), double-scoped preflight universal and pseudo-element rules (`*`, `::before`, `::after`, `::backdrop`, `::-webkit-scrollbar`), and inflated the injected stylesheet by over 1 MB; second, `group-has-*` rules compiled to `:is(:where(.group/...):has(...) *)`, triggering whole-subtree invalidations all the way up to the host application root whenever the composer selection layer or content mutated. Switching to native `@scope` and eliminating `:has(...) *` selectors cuts the injected stylesheet size by ~1.15 MB (~31.7%) and reduces the style-recalculation cost by ~45× even when the host page still carries broad `div:has(...)` rules (and to sub-millisecond when those host rules are absent).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open an embedded Web Shell session with existing conversation messages, type text into the composer, press `Cmd+A` (or `Ctrl+A`) and `Backspace`, and confirm the input clears immediately without a perceptible freeze or multi-hundred-millisecond main-thread stall in DevTools Performance traces.
2. Confirm host-page styling outside the Web Shell root (headings, buttons, paragraphs, utility classes) remains completely unaffected by Web Shell styles, while Web Shell root classes (light/dark theme tokens, empty-chat layout, portal popovers, Shadow DOM surfaces, KaTeX math fonts and borders, and CSS keyframe animations) continue to render identically.
3. Verify visual layout for the four updated UI primitives: horizontal field descriptions remain balanced, disabled-field checkboxes dim properly, alerts with leading icons place titles in the second grid column, and default-size alert dialogs with media icons align titles in the second grid column on desktop viewports.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- **Before (live embedded host session & 1,500-node reproduction with host `div:has(...)` rule)**: Three consecutive `UpdateLayoutTree` recalculations on `Cmd+A` + `Backspace` totaling **360–410 ms** (118–207 ms per pass, 1,256–1,431 elements invalidated per pass); main bundle injected CSS size **3,632.9 KB**.
- **After (built native `@scope` bundle on the same 1,500-node reproduction)**: `UpdateLayoutTree` drops to **8.14 ms** total even with the host `div:has(...)` rule present (`4.21 ms` + `3.90 ms` + `0.03 ms`), and **0.13 ms** total (`0.05 ms` + `0.06 ms` + `0.03 ms`, 1 element per pass) without the host `div:has(...)` rule; main bundle injected CSS size drops to **2,479.7 KB (-1,153 KB / -31.7%)**.
- Verified in both Chromium and WebKit across Light DOM, Portal root, and Shadow DOM (`adoptedStyleSheets`) for host isolation, root-element classes, dark theme tokens, KaTeX fonts/borders, 54 keyframe animations (including reduced-motion media-nested keyframes), 88 `@property` registrations, and all four updated UI primitives; build artifact, Shadow DOM, and boot tests pass (78/78).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local workspace build, Vitest unit/artifact tests, and headless Playwright Chromium + WebKit verification on macOS; initial profiling captured via CDP on a live embedded host session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Embedded library CSS now relies on native CSS `@scope` (Chrome/Edge 118+, Safari 17.4+, Firefox 146+). Older browsers without `@scope` support would ignore the scoped stylesheet block.
- Not validated / out of scope: Host-side stylesheets (such as bare `div:has(...)` rules owned by embedding hosts) are outside this repository; standalone app styling is unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None for supported browsers; embedded hosts continue to import the package as before without API or markup changes.
- Design documentation: [English](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-native-at-scope.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-native-at-scope.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将嵌入态 Web Shell 库产物的 CSS 隔离方式从「在每条选择器分支前拼接冗长的含通配符后代前缀」切换为原生 CSS `@scope` 块包裹，将块内已带根作用域的预置规则简化为 `:scope`，将全局声明式 at-rule（`@charset`、`@import`、`@font-face`、`@property` 以及含嵌套在内的 `@keyframes`）提升至 `@scope` 外部顶层，同时通过为非 `:scope` 开头的选择器补充零权重的 `:where(:scope)` 复合分支来保证作用域根元素自身类名与后代元素均能正常命中且不引入通配符 `*`。

将 4 个共享 UI 原语中会编译为 `:has(...) *` 后代通配符的 Tailwind `group-has-*` 类名替换为基于属性的选择器或直接子代选择器，避免 Blink 在宿主文档中生成整棵子树的样式失效集。

补充了覆盖主入口产物、纯记录产物以及懒加载终端样式块的构建产物回归测试，确保所有组件样式规则均位于 `@scope` 内、全局声明式 at-rule 位于顶层、不再回退到旧的通用 `:where(...)` 前缀，且不再出现 `:has(...) *` 选择器。

## 为什么需要这个改动

在已经关闭输入框光晕动画并启用布局隔离的嵌入态宿主环境中，于输入框输入文本后全选删除仍会出现持续约 360–400 ms 的明显卡顿，表现为连续 3 轮约 120–135 ms 的样式重算。通过 Chrome DevTools `SelectorStats` 与 Blink 失效追踪定位到两个叠加原因：其一，向所有规则前置包含后代 `*` 的 `:where(... *)` 前缀会破坏 Blink 祖先 Bloom 过滤器（`fastReject = 0`），对预置通用与伪元素规则（`*`、`::before`、`::after`、`::backdrop`、`::-webkit-scrollbar`）造成双重包裹，并使内联样式表膨胀超过 1 MB；其二，`group-has-*` 编译生成的 `:is(:where(.group/...):has(...) *)` 会在输入框选区层或内容变更时触发一路冒泡到宿主应用根节点的整棵子树样式失效。改用原生 `@scope` 并消除 `:has(...) *` 选择器后，内联 CSS 体积减少约 1.15 MB（约 31.7%），即使宿主页仍保留泛匹配 `div:has(...)` 规则也能将样式重算耗时降低约 45 倍（宿主移除该规则后可降至 1 ms 以内）。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在嵌入态宿主会话中打开已有消息的对话，在输入框中输入文本后执行 `Cmd+A`（或 `Ctrl+A`）加 `Backspace` 全选删除，确认文本立刻清空且无肉眼可感知的卡顿，在 DevTools Performance 面板中不再出现连续百毫秒级的主线程样式重算阻塞。
2. 确认 Web Shell 根节点之外的宿主页面样式（标题、按钮、段落、工具类等）不受 Web Shell 样式污染，同时 Web Shell 根节点上的类名（亮/暗主题变量、空会话布局、Portal 浮层、Shadow DOM 表面、KaTeX 数学公式字体与边框以及关键帧动画）显示与改动前完全一致。
3. 核对 4 个改动的 UI 原语视觉表现：横向表单字段描述保持均衡换行、禁用字段内的复选框正常降透明度、带前导图标的提示框标题位于网格第二列、桌面视口下带媒体图标的默认尺寸确认弹窗标题位于网格第二列。

### 证据（改前与改后）

- **改前（真实嵌入态宿主会话及带宿主 `div:has(...)` 规则的 1,500 节点复现场景）**：`Cmd+A` + `Backspace` 连续触发 3 轮 `UpdateLayoutTree`，总耗时 **360–410 ms**（单次 118–207 ms，每次标脏 1,256–1,431 个元素）；主包内联 CSS 体积为 **3,632.9 KB**。
- **改后（同 1,500 节点复现场景下使用新构建的原生 `@scope` 产物）**：即使仍保留宿主 `div:has(...)` 规则，`UpdateLayoutTree` 总耗时降至 **8.14 ms**（`4.21 ms` + `3.90 ms` + `0.03 ms`）；移除宿主 `div:has(...)` 规则后进一步降至 **0.13 ms**（`0.05 ms` + `0.06 ms` + `0.03 ms`，每次仅重算 1 个元素）；主包内联 CSS 体积降至 **2,479.7 KB（减少 1,153 KB / -31.7%）**。
- 已在 Chromium 与 WebKit 双引擎下验证 Light DOM、Portal 根节点与 Shadow DOM（`adoptedStyleSheets`）的宿主隔离、根元素类名、暗色主题变量、KaTeX 字体与边框、54 组关键帧动画（含媒体查询嵌套关键帧）、88 组 `@property` 注册及 4 个 UI 原语计算样式；构建产物、Shadow DOM 与启动守卫单测全部通过（78/78）。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 测试环境（可选）

macOS 本地完整工作区构建、Vitest 单测与构建产物校验，以及无头 Playwright Chromium + WebKit 运行时验证；初始问题通过 CDP 连接真实嵌入态宿主会话抓包定位。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：嵌入态库产物样式现在依赖原生 CSS `@scope`（Chrome/Edge 118+、Safari 17.4+、Firefox 146+），不支持 `@scope` 的旧版浏览器会忽略被包裹的样式块。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：宿主页面自身样式表（例如嵌入宿主里的裸 `div:has(...)` 规则）不在本仓库范围内；独立应用模式样式未改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：在受支持的浏览器上无破坏性变更，嵌入宿主无需修改集成 API 或 DOM 结构。
- 设计文档：[English](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-native-at-scope.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-native-at-scope.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): add executable hardware microVM round orchestrator and token-revoked model proxy
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR completes the executable host-side orchestration layer for hardware-isolated `/verify-pr` rounds on top of the tiered microVM building blocks merged in #18181. It connects per-round bearer token issuance and revocation, host-side model proxy enforcement, bounded artifact collection, hardware backend execution, unconditional teardown, and fail-closed publication checking into one end-to-end host runner and CLI workflow.

On the model proxy side, the host proxy now compares bearer tokens in constant time, enforces per-round token revocation against a host-held single-link regular state file (failing closed when the record is missing, symlinked, multi-linked, oversized, malformed, or not explicitly active), requires an explicit finite request budget whenever a hardware round enables it, and supports listening on a private Unix domain socket with strict permissions, optional VMM UID/GID ownership, and clean socket unlinking on termination signals.

On the runner side, the host orchestrator validates the host context digest and trust classification before launching any process, ensures launcher and vault directories never overlap or nest, prevents the per-round working disk from aliasing the golden source rootfs, starts the per-round model proxy and bounded collector, spawns local microVM backends (or delegates to a cloud provider driver) with fast failure on spawn errors or early worker exit, unconditionally tears down the model proxy, owned Unix socket, worker process, working disk, and token state before checking source rootfs digest immutability, writes the host execution record and boundary attestation only after a clean teardown, and invokes the publication gate. It also binds the actual launch configuration to validated golden inputs and the host head, rejects additional writable disks and shared-inode storage, preserves supervisor/process-group recovery when a worker PID file is unavailable, and refuses a clean teardown or boundary whenever a worker, helper, or proxy socket cannot be cleaned up. A new CLI subcommand exposes this flow from a host configuration file while locking live PID verification and publication checking on.

## Why it's needed

PR #18181 introduced the design, trust classification, bounded collector, lifecycle reaper, backend planners, and fail-closed publication gate, but running an actual hardware-isolated round still required gluing those pieces together manually and lacked per-round model proxy revocation, request budgeting, and private Unix-socket transport. Providing an audited, fail-closed host orchestrator and hardened model proxy eliminates manual lifecycle gaps (such as leaked processes, lingering sockets, stale bearer tokens, or mutated golden images) while keeping legacy container, manual VM, and waived `/verify-pr` flows unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the unit test suites covering the model proxy, VM runner orchestrator, bounded collector, lifecycle reaper, publication checker, and prepare step; verify all cases pass with zero failures and no leftover processes or sockets.
2. Confirm model proxy security invariants: valid bearer requests succeed up to the configured budget, excess requests receive HTTP 429, revoking or corrupting/replacing the host token state file immediately rejects subsequent requests with HTTP 403, and terminating a Unix-socket proxy removes its socket path cleanly.
3. Confirm orchestrator end-to-end and fail-closed behavior: a complete local microVM round (both TCP and Unix-socket model proxy modes) collects report and PNG evidence, reaps the worker, deletes the working disk, revokes the token, writes the execution record and boundary attestation, and passes the publication gate; conversely, contradictory trust classification, source rootfs mutation, working disk aliasing the golden rootfs, failed reap or provider disk deletion, missing binary, or early worker exit all fail closed without writing a boundary attestation.
4. For abnormal launch paths, verify quick spawn failure, recovery of a real Firecracker worker when its PID file is unavailable, rejection of extra writable disks and shared-inode aliases, and preservation/refusal of supervisors that fail their identity checks.
5. Optionally run the CLI runner against a local sandboxed Apple Virtualization microVM on macOS ARM64 or a jailed Firecracker microVM on Linux KVM, verifying both a clean complete round (exit code 0, zero live VMM processes afterward) and a truncated guest output round (exit code 1, blocked publication, zero live VMM processes afterward).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI host verification tooling; verified via unit suites and real microVM runs on both macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64 KVM).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

- macOS Apple Silicon (sandboxed Apple Virtualization microVM via CLI runner + local unit test suites: 322 passed, 5 skipped across all six verification script suites).
- Linux ARM64 KVM host (jailed Firecracker 1.18.0 end-to-end CLI runs covering complete, truncated, authority-file-forged, missing launcher, unavailable worker PID file, and live-guest scenarios; the real worker was recovered and reaped after PID-file loss, with zero residual VMM processes after teardown).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Teardown ordering and process monitoring must handle both normal completion and abrupt VMM crashes without hanging or leaving per-round directories non-empty; the orchestrator therefore closes the model proxy and its owned Unix socket before running the ownership reaper and treats early worker exit as a fast failure after a brief collector drain grace window.
- Not validated / out of scope: Generic delivery of ephemeral proxy coordinates into the guest, guest-to-host model transport, and real model inference inside a guest remain future work. The host proxy used a local upstream, not a model key inside a VM. This follow-up did not repeat Apple Virtualization from the saved fixtures. Cloud provider API drivers (such as live Aliyun ECS or Agent Sandbox SDK adapters), `.github/workflows/` CI wiring, `/verify-pr` skill prompt updates, and Windows hosts are intentionally out of scope for this slice.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. All existing model proxy flags, container rounds, manual VM rounds, and waived rounds remain backward compatible, and `packages/`, `.github/`, `.qwen/skills/`, and `/review` are untouched.

## Linked Issues

Follows up #18181.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 在 #18181 合入的分层 microVM 基础组件之上，补齐了硬件隔离 `/verify-pr` 轮次的可执行宿主机编排层，将每轮临时 bearer token 签发与吊销、宿主机模型代理策略校验、有界产物收集、硬件后端拉起、无条件清理销毁以及 fail-closed 发布门串接为完整的宿主机编排器与 CLI 执行入口。

在模型代理侧，宿主机代理现在采用恒定时间比较 bearer token，按单链接常规文件的 fail-closed 语义实时检查宿主机 token 状态文件（文件缺失、软链、多硬链、超大、JSON 非法或未显式处于未吊销状态均立即拒绝），启用每轮模型代理时要求显式有限请求配额上限（超额返回 429），并支持监听私有 Unix 域套接字（0600 权限、可选 VMM UID/GID 属主以及收到终止信号时自动清理套接字文件）。

在运行编排侧，宿主机编排器在拉起任何进程前先校验宿主机上下文摘要与信任分级、禁止 launcher 与 vault 目录重叠或嵌套、阻止每轮工作盘指向黄金源镜像，随后启动每轮模型代理与有界收集器并拉起本地 microVM 后端（或调用云端 provider 驱动）；针对命令不存在或 worker 早退具备快速失败机制，无需死等超时；在 `finally` 中无条件先关闭模型代理及其创建的 Unix 套接字，再回收 worker 进程、删除工作盘与套接字目录、吊销 token 状态并校验黄金源镜像摘要未被篡改；仅在清理完全成功时落盘执行记录与边界声明并执行发布门检查。同时绑定实际启动配置、黄金镜像输入与宿主 head，拒绝额外可写磁盘和共享 inode 工作盘，在 PID 文件不可用时保留 supervisor/进程组恢复路径；任一 worker、helper 或代理套接字不能清理时都不会接受 destroyed 与边界声明。新增的 CLI 子命令支持通过宿主机配置文件驱动整轮执行，同时强制锁定实时 PID 校验与发布门检查不可被配置绕过。

## 为什么需要它

#18181 完成了分层隔离设计、信任分级、有界收集器、生命周期清理器、后端启动计划生成器与发布门，但真正执行一轮硬件隔离验证仍需要手工胶水拼接，且模型代理尚缺少每轮即时吊销、配额限制与私有 Unix 套接字传输。提供经过多轮对抗审计的 fail-closed 宿主机编排器与加固模型代理后，可消除进程泄漏、残留套接字、过期 token 继续转发或误改黄金镜像等生命周期风险，同时保持既有容器、手工 VM 与豁免流程 100% 兼容。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 运行模型代理、VM 运行编排器、有界收集器、生命周期清理器、发布门检查器与准备脚本的全部 6 套单元测试，确认全部通过且无残留进程或套接字。
2. 确认模型代理安全不变量：合法 bearer 请求在配额内正常转发，超额返回 HTTP 429，吊销、删除、替换或损坏宿主机 token 状态文件后立即返回 HTTP 403，终止 Unix 套接字模式代理后自动移除套接字文件。
3. 确认编排器端到端与 fail-closed 行为：完整的本地 microVM 轮次（同时覆盖 TCP 与 Unix 套接字模型代理模式）能收集报告与 PNG 证据、回收 worker、删除工作盘、吊销 token、写入执行记录与边界声明并通过发布门；而信任分级自相矛盾、黄金源镜像被篡改、工作盘与黄金镜像同路径、清理或云盘删除失败、启动命令缺失或 worker 早退均会 fail-closed 且不写入边界声明。
4. 对异常启动路径，验证缺失启动器快速失败、真实 Firecracker PID 文件丢失后的 worker 找回与回收、额外可写磁盘/共享 inode 拒绝，以及身份不匹配 supervisor 的保留与阻断发布。
5. 可选在 macOS ARM64 上以沙箱化 Apple Virtualization microVM 或在 Linux KVM 上以 jailer + Firecracker microVM 运行 CLI 编排器，验证正常完成轮次（退出码 0 且事后零残留 VMM 进程）与输出截断轮次（退出码 1、发布门阻断且事后零残留 VMM 进程）。

### 证据（改前与改后）

N/A（非 UI 的宿主机验证基础设施改动；已在 macOS ARM64 与 Linux ARM64 KVM 真机及单元测试中完成验证）。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### 环境（可选）

- macOS Apple Silicon（沙箱化 Apple Virtualization microVM 真实 CLI 编排测试 + 本地 6 套验证脚本单元测试：322 通过，5 跳过）。
- Linux ARM64 KVM 宿主机（jailer + Firecracker 1.18.0 真机 CLI 复测：正常通过、输出截断、伪造权威文件、缺失启动器、worker PID 文件丢失、guest 保持存活；真实 worker 被找回并逐 PID 回收，结束后零残留 VMM 进程）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：销毁顺序与进程监控需兼顾正常完成与 VMM 异常崩溃，既不能导致每轮套接字目录清理报非空，也不能在 worker 早退时干等收集器超时；因此编排器在 `finally` 中优先关闭模型代理并移除其自有套接字，再执行所有权清理，并在 worker 早退经短暂收尾宽限后快速失败。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：向通用 guest 注入每轮临时模型代理信息、guest 到宿主机的模型传输、以及在 guest 内进行真实模型推理仍是后续工作。宿主代理使用本地上游验证，未将真实模型密钥送入 VM。本次跟进未从已保存夹具复跑 Apple Virtualization。真实云端 provider API 驱动（阿里云 ECS / Agent Sandbox SDK 适配器）、`.github/workflows/` CI 接入、`/verify-pr` skill 提示词更新以及 Windows 宿主机均不在本切片范围内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。所有既有模型代理参数以及容器、手工 VM、豁免 `/verify-pr` 流程均保持完全向后兼容，且未改动 `packages/`、`.github/`、`.qwen/skills/` 或 `/review`。

## 关联 Issue

跟进 #18181。

</details>

Stack: **[#15657](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15657) → [#15658](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658) → [#15659](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15659)**. This is **B**, based on A (`split/13902-agent-identity`, `3294001f39040a668fcbad20045b64e03dc1b6e6`); base branch: `split/13902-agent-identity`. C (`split/13902-teammate-activity`) depends on B. Split from #13902 at source commit `6ed7884c381dfe1c59bd975d6cf61dbb41ef441c`; candidate B: `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`. Review B against A to isolate the coordination change.

## What this PR does

Connects an ACP-hosted leader to Team reports, roster membership and teammate approvals. Reports and join/exit notices enter the existing peer notification path with canonical teammate identity, survive recording and replay, and receive teammate attribution in the Web Shell. Pending reports participate in work holds, reversible close, queue overflow and shutdown flushing.

Teammate approvals reach the host independently of the leader's permission queue. Session scope, request UUIDs, binding epochs, ownership checks and retirement on manager replacement or teammate exit keep approval lifetime tied to the owning session. B includes producer, persistence, bridge, SDK/UI consumers and their tests. It consumes A's shared identity contract without depending on subagent runtime behavior. Tool activity and inter-agent message display arrive in C.

## Why it's needed

Without a leader sink, ACP-hosted teammate reports remain unread and teammate approval events have no consumer. The leader and its client need a delivery path that carries attribution, preserves undrained reports and exposes teammate approval requests.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. At candidate `435e4f949eca7232c2b48d3a259f5083cb788b8a`, run `npm run build` from the repository root, then run the package-local commands below serially. Each Vitest command runs from the stated package directory.
2. Deliver a teammate report and roster join/exit, then reload the transcript. Confirm canonical attribution, peer semantics and turn-marker correlation. Exercise reversible close, pending-report holds, overflow, repeat flush and shutdown with undrained reports.
3. Leave a teammate approval unanswered while the leader requests its own tool approval. Confirm the leader request remains visible. Exercise host answer/failure, standalone policy, session ownership, manager rebinding, teammate exit and cancellation; evaluate the inherited feedback below separately.
