prs.title: feat(cli): retain and restore worktree snapshots across workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR implements P6 U4/U5: count-based retention for held chats and owner-scoped reconstruction of their retained worktrees on reopen. Every active, trusted, non-internal primary and secondary workspace is handled independently, using its own settings, storage, Git root, bridge and runtime-generation checks rather than falling back to the primary workspace. The limit applies to eligible chats; live and pinned chats are preserved separately. Setting `worktree.maxRetained` to zero disables automatic sweeping, not an explicit restore of an already retained snapshot.

Retention preserves the chat, transcript, sidecar and exact snapshot pair across removal, archive and unarchive. Restore is available only when the owner's registered workspace and the selected archive agree. It reconstructs a fresh managed checkout, then verifies actual file bytes, deletions, owner-executable bits, HEAD, branch state and the exclusive owner marker before completing the session binding and normal load. A named branch is attached only while it still points at the captured commit; a moved ref is left untouched and the checkout is restored detached.

Snapshot extraction now preserves captured modes on reused HEAD files, including `0755` on Linux. Catalog lifecycle fields are also refreshed from the current sidecar: an older live summary or a reused metadata cache cannot resurrect an old archive key or make a successfully restored chat look removed again. Existing protected cleanup checks, including drift, pending Git operations, ownership and snapshot validation, remain in force.

The new daemon/API and Session Overview flow is capability-gated and consumes the same owner-scoped state as retention. It is separate from `worktree-reset`, which is an ownership-changing replacement workflow.

## Why it's needed

The earlier lifecycle could snapshot and preserve worktrees, but it did not provide an applied per-workspace retention sweep and a production, owner-proven way to reopen them. Capturing state without a reliable restoration and projection path leaves users with stale or inaccessible data; simply deleting old checkouts would risk losing dirty work.

A single daemon can own many workspaces. Primary-only cleanup would leave secondary workspaces behind, while guessing ownership from a name or path prefix could remove or replace another workspace's checkout. Orphan archives therefore remain preserved rather than being adopted automatically.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Register two Git workspaces in one daemon, with a primary root and a distinct secondary root, and give each an independent retention limit. Create sessions containing dirty tracked text, executable tracked files, untracked binary data and a tracked deletion. Hold live and pinned sessions out of the eligible set. Confirm each root keeps its configured newest eligible chats, removes only older eligible checkouts after capturing a snapshot, and leaves the chat/transcript/sidecar intelligible. Shared/unknown roots, inaccessible settings or pin state and unknown ownership must preserve instead of deleting.
2. Archive and unarchive the retained chats. Confirm each snapshot tar/JSON pair follows the same owner into its corresponding archive or active directory, without filename/prefix-based adoption. Ask the other runtime to restore a target and confirm it is rejected without creating a checkout or changing the removal binding.
3. In Session Overview, choose All workspaces and restore each retained target. Confirm the request carries that workspace's registered `cwd`, no caller-supplied target/archive path is needed, and normal navigation succeeds. Inspect the reconstructed Git checkout: the tracked bytes, untracked bytes, executable mode and captured HEAD must match; deleted files stay absent; and the owner marker matches the session. The archive must remain readable rather than being silently consumed.
4. Exercise the named-ref case: restore while the ref still resolves to the captured commit and verify attachment; advance that ref separately and verify the restored checkout is detached without resetting the ref.
5. Re-create a retained removal, corrupt its selected tar and activate Restore snapshot. Confirm a visible error and no replacement owner marker. The current sidecar key, JSON header and the archive itself must remain intact, so another fallback or cleanup does not turn partial failure into apparent success.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These are real operation states from the isolated primary/secondary run, not a claim that the panel's visual theme changed. The first frame is captured after both workspace catalogs have loaded and their valid restore actions are visible. The second frame shows both targets reopened. The third frame is the observed error after deliberately corrupting the newly retained tar; its persistent binding and other recovery evidence are checked on disk.

![Both workspaces with valid retained snapshot restore actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/before-restore.png)

![Successful restoration for both the primary and secondary workspaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/after-restore.png)

![Visible failure after corrupting the current retained archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/corrupt-archive-failure.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested with real Git, tar, filesystem, HTTP, and Chromium |

### Environment (optional)

Linux with Node 26. The isolated integration run starts a real daemon with independent primary and secondary runtime homes, settings, storage and Git repositories, using a mock model provider. Browser actions use the built Web Shell in real Chromium with a temporary profile. The run does not use real model credentials or restart the user's existing daemon.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retention is destructive to checkout placement and depends on correct runtime ownership, generation and sidecar ordering. This PR deliberately preserves on ambiguous or unreadable state, rechecks ownership immediately before removal, and verifies reconstruction before publishing a normal binding. Metadata availability and restoration are evaluated against the current sidecar rather than a stale live projection or cached sidecar snapshot. A precision tradeoff is that malformed or inaccessible data can remain unrecovered and require manual attention instead of being guessed into a different workspace.
- Preserve-on-unproven-ownership is intentionally global across the attestation map. An unreadable root, environment or settings entry pauses automatic sweeping rather than treating a possibly shared or corrupted root as unsupported. An early partial checkout that lacks its exclusive marker likewise remains untouched for manual recovery. Only a partial checkout that has the matching owner, target and bytes may use binding-only completion. These availability tradeoffs are documented in both languages.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS, Windows, the complete CI matrix and Java verification were not run locally. External model calls are not exercised by the mock-provider integration run. P7 custom roots, TTLs, orphan-expiry, a global aggregate quota, arbitrary user-selected snapshot paths and changes to ownership-changing reset semantics remain out of scope. No byte-for-byte global transaction is claimed across Git objects, archive/header writes, external process crashes or concurrent raw filesystem edits.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no intended breaking change. Active worktree summaries retain their previous shape, with snapshot state optional. Ordinary archive/unarchive continues to preserve existing content and bindings. The restoration surface is capability-gated. Existing hidden-index, pending-operation and ownership guards are not weakened.
- Design documents: [English](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.zh-CN.md). Decisions, constraints, validation and follow-up limits are synchronized in both versions.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17237 (P6 U4/U5). This does not claim completion of later P7 scope or close the parent issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

本 PR 实现 P6 的 U4/U5：对保留会话执行按数量的 worktree 清扫，并在重新打开会话时按已验证 owner 从快照恢复 checkout。每个 active、trusted、非 internal 的 primary 和 secondary workspace 都独立处理，使用自己的 settings、storage、Git 根、bridge 与 runtime generation 检查，而不是回退到 primary。配额只针对 deletion-eligible 会话，live 与 pinned 会话单独保护。`worktree.maxRetained` 为 0 时关闭自动清扫，但不会禁用对已保留快照的显式恢复。

清扫会保留 chat、transcript、sidecar 与精确配对的快照，并在移除、归档和取消归档之间维持其归属。恢复只有在注册 workspace owner 与所选归档一致时才允许：先重建全新的托管 checkout，再校验真实文件字节、删除项、属主可执行位、HEAD、分支状态和互斥 owner marker，最后完成会话绑定并正常加载。命名分支仅在仍指向捕获提交时连接；ref 已前进则恢复为 detached，绝不重置该 ref。

快照解包现在会对复用的 HEAD 文件恢复捕获的 mode，包含 Linux 下的 `0755`。catalog 生命周期字段也会读取当前 sidecar，旧 live 摘要或被复用的元数据缓存不能再复活旧 archive key，也不能让已经成功恢复的会话再次显示为已移除。既有的保护式清理检查，包括内容漂移、暂停中的 Git 操作、ownership 和快照校验，均继续生效。

新的 daemon/API 与 Session Overview 流程通过 capability 开关启用，消费与清扫相同的 owner-scoped 状态。它与会改变 ownership 的 `worktree-reset` 替换流程分开，不复用语义。

## 为什么需要

此前生命周期已能捕获并保留 worktree，但尚无应用到实际生产的、按 workspace 隔离的保留清扫，也没有可靠的按 owner 恢复流程。仅能保存状态却无法可靠恢复和投影，会让用户面对陈旧或不可达的数据；直接删除旧 checkout 又可能丢失未提交的工作。

一个 daemon 可以拥有很多 workspace。只清扫 primary 会遗漏 secondary，而按文件名或路径前缀猜测 ownership 可能删除或替换其它 workspace 的 checkout。本 PR 因此保留 orphan 归档，不自动把它们提升为某个会话。

## 审查者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在同一个 daemon 注册两个 Git workspace，一个有 primary 根，一个有独立的 secondary 根，并给各自设置独立保留上限。创建包含 dirty tracked 文本、可执行 tracked 文件、未跟踪二进制数据及 tracked 删除的会话，并将 live/pinned 会话置于 eligible 集合之外。确认每个根均按自己的设置保留最新的合规会话，仅在完成快照后移除较老的 eligible checkout，并保留其 chat/transcript/sidecar。共享或不明根、不可读设置或 pin 状态、未知 ownership 均必须保留而不是删除。
2. 归档再取消归档这些会话。确认 tar/JSON 快照对跟随同一 owner 进入对应 archive 或 active 目录，不按文件名或前缀重新认养。从另一个 runtime 请求恢复该目标，确认请求被拒绝，不创建 checkout，也不改变 removal binding。
3. 在 Session Overview 选择 All workspaces，分别恢复两个保留目标。确认请求携带各 workspace 已注册的 `cwd`，不需要调用方提供目标目录或归档路径，正常导航成功。检查重建后的 Git checkout：tracked 字节、未跟踪字节、可执行位和捕获 HEAD 均相同，删除文件保持不存在，owner marker 与会话相符。归档仍须可读，不能静默被消费。
4. 验证命名分支情形：ref 仍指向捕获提交时可以连接；另将 ref 前进后，确认恢复为 detached 且不重置该 ref。
5. 再产生一次保留移除，故意损坏其当前选择的 tar，然后点击 Restore snapshot。确认出现可见错误且没有替代 owner marker。当前 sidecar key、JSON 头部和归档本身均保留，不会靠别的回退或清理把部分失败伪装成成功。

### 前后证据

以下均为隔离 primary/secondary 运行中的真实操作状态，并不表示面板视觉主题被重新设计。第一张图在两个 workspace 的目录都加载完成、有效恢复按钮均可见时截取。第二张图展示两个目标均已重新打开。第三张图是故意损坏新保留 tar 后实际观察到的错误；其持久化绑定及恢复相关证据均在磁盘上进一步校验。

![两个 workspace 都具备有效的快照恢复操作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/before-restore.png)

![primary 与 secondary workspace 均成功恢复](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/after-restore.png)

![损坏当前保留归档后的可见错误](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-worktree-manager/u45-retention-restore-2026-11-21/corrupt-archive-failure.png)

### 已验证平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已使用真实 Git、tar、文件系统、HTTP 与 Chromium 验证 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux，Node 26。隔离集成运行启动真实 daemon，赋予 primary 和 secondary 各自独立的 runtime HOME、settings、storage 与 Git 仓库，模型提供方使用 mock。浏览器操作通过构建后的 Web Shell，在带临时 profile 的真实 Chromium 中进行。运行不读取真实模型凭据，也不重启用户原有 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：保留清扫会改变 checkout 的落盘位置，依赖正确的 runtime ownership、generation 和 sidecar 写入顺序。本 PR 在状态不明或不可读时保留，在删除前再次复核 ownership，并在发布正常绑定前验证重建结果。元数据可用性及其恢复状态以当前 sidecar 为依据，而不是旧 live 投影或缓存中的快照。代价是损坏或不可读的数据可能保持不可恢复，需要人工处理，而不是被猜测认领到另一个 workspace。
- 归属证明未完成时，整个归属图按保守策略暂停自动清扫。root、环境或设置不可读时，不把可能共享或已损坏的根当作「不适用清扫」。若在 owner marker 创建前就失败形成部分 checkout，也不会把它直接认养或覆盖，而是保留给人工恢复。只有 owner、目标与内容都严格匹配的 partial 才允许 binding-only 收尾。相应的可恢复性取舍已在中英设计文档中明确。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS、Windows、完整 CI 矩阵与 Java 验证没有在本地执行；使用 mock 模型提供方的集成验证不覆盖真实外部模型调用。P7 自定义根、TTL、孤儿归档过期、全局聚合配额、任意用户选择的归档路径及改变 ownership 的 reset 语义都不在本范围内。不声明覆盖 Git 对象库、归档/头部写入、外部进程崩溃或原始并发文件操作的逐字节全局事务保证。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无预期破坏性变更。活跃 worktree 摘要保持原有形状，快照状态为可选。普通 archive/unarchive 继续保留已有内容和绑定。恢复能力通过 capability 启用。既有隐藏索引位、暂停 Git 操作和 ownership 守卫不被削弱。
- 设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/wenshao/qwen-code/blob/f37158005a/docs/design/2026-11-21-web-shell-worktree-retention-restore.zh-CN.md)。两份文档的决策、约束、验证和后续范围保持同步。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #17237 的 P6 U4/U5。本 PR 不表示完成后续 P7 范围，也不关闭父 issue。

</details>

## Follow-up verification (f67c90bb6a)

A follow-up run on f67c90bb6a used a real isolated daemon, distinct primary and secondary workspaces, an isolated dummy provider and Chromium. Retained secondary data was restored through the real UI: the deleted parent directory stayed absent, while force-added ignored files, binary data, deleted paths, symlink targets, HEAD/branch state and the session owner marker matched the original. The worktree-restore operation completed once with no subsequent ordinary session load. The hydrated client kept its replay and artifacts, and its final detach returned 204 with no remaining live-session diagnostics. A real Git removal gate also held shutdown until the actual filesystem work finished; after restart, the retained pair and binding restored correctly. A deliberately corrupted archive produced a visible failure without deleting the sole recovery binding or manufacturing a replacement owner.

These results supplement the isolated local verification rather than claiming that GitHub CI or the new review has completed.

## 跟进验证（f67c90bb6a）

本次在 f67c90bb6a 上使用隔离的真实 daemon、独立的 primary/secondary workspace、dummy provider 和 Chromium 完成操作。secondary 被保留的 worktree 通过真实界面完成恢复：删除的文件及其空父目录不再存在，force-added ignored 文件、二进制数据、删除项、symlink target、HEAD/branch 和 owner marker 都与原内容一致。worktree-restore 只调用一次，后续的普通 load 没有发生；已水合的 client 保留 replay 和 artifacts，最后一次 detach 返回 204，诊断中没有残留活跃注册。真实阻塞 Git remove 时，daemon 等它结束后才退出，重启后仍能按快照绑定恢复。人为损坏归档时明确报错，不制造替代 owner，也不删除唯一恢复绑定。

这些截图是隔离运行中的真实记录，说明上述操作和文件字节已经复查；不表示 GitHub CI 或最新评审已经结束。

![Restore snapshot for retained worktrees](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/f67c90bb6a/browser-02-retained-overview.png)

![Restored secondary workspace with its original conversation replay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/f67c90bb6a/browser-03-restored-secondary.png)

## Follow-up verification (4934d25d4e)

A historical removal was constructed from real retained snapshots and owner records produced by the actual daemon. After the daemon stopped normally, only the worktreeRemoved property was omitted, with retention disabled to prevent an automatic repair before preview. Running the newly built bundle with isolated HOME/runtime, two registered workspaces, a loopback dummy provider and real Chromium showed that the read-only catalog exposed restoration while preserving the original sidecar byte-for-byte. Browser restoration recreated the checkout and retained the original replay and artifacts, performed one restore without a later ordinary load, and detached with HTTP 204. A secondary record also completed actual HTTP archive/unarchive: the sidecar and exact snapshot pair moved to the matching archive locations, their SHA-256 values stayed unchanged, and the original secondary replay restored with one client and no attach registrations. The harness process exited zero and the dummy provider made no upstream calls.

The five affected CLI test files passed 298 tests, and repository lint, build, typecheck and bundling passed. These are local results and do not replace GitHub CI or an independent review.

## 历史绑定跟进验证（4934d25d4e）

在独立 HOME/runtime、真正 daemon、两个注册工作空间、dummy provider 和 Chromium 中完成复核。先由实际 retention 生成快照和 owner 记录，正常停止 daemon 后仅省略 worktreeRemoved 属性构造历史窗口，并禁止后台自动补回。在缺失字段的原始记录上，目录预览可以展示恢复入口，且只读查询前后 sidecar 字节完全一致。真实浏览器恢复 checkout 后保留原始 replay 与 artifacts，只调用一次 restore，没有后续普通 load，最后一次 detach 返回 204。secondary 还经过真实 HTTP archive/unarchive：sidecar 和精确归档对随状态搬移，tar 和 metadata 的 SHA-256 均保持不变，随后仍以原 secondary workspace 恢复历史，只有一个 client，attachCount 为 0。测试进程正常退出，dummy provider 没有对外部上游的请求。

相关 5 个 CLI 测试文件共 298 项通过，仓库 lint、build、typecheck、bundle 均通过。这些是本地验证结果，不替代 GitHub CI 或独立评审结论。

![A historical missing-binding record exposes Restore snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/4934d25d4e9a0fe8e69274ed05f321cefe8705f6/browser-02-retainedPrimary-retained-overview.png)

![The secondary historical session restores its original conversation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets-pr18009/pr18009/4934d25d4e9a0fe8e69274ed05f321cefe8705f6/browser-03-retainedSecondary-restored.png)

prs.title: fix(cli): gate Agent Team tools on host support
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Legacy Agent Team tools and team-specific `agent` arguments are now advertised only when the host explicitly supports teammate reports and approvals, the experiment is enabled, and the existing shell sandbox permits them. Ink and non-interactive text, JSON, and stream-json retain team support. ACP and OpenTUI keep the ordinary `agent` tool and withhold the team tools and arguments. Hosted Agents continue to use their own team admission rules.

Adds an ACP regression test that inspects the tool schema sent to the model. The bilingual Managed Multi-Agent API design records this gate as the first M4 slice and sets out the remaining work on execution identity, task trees, team rosters, and targeted intervention. [Legacy host gate design (简体中文)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-agent-team-host-gate.zh-CN.md) · [Overall design (English)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-23-managed-multi-agent-public-api.md) · [Overall design (简体中文)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-23-managed-multi-agent-public-api.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

The experiment flag could expose team tools in ACP sessions that had no report sink or approval listener. The model could start teammates whose reports stayed unread, and their tool approval requests could remain pending until a stall timeout. Registering tools according to host support prevents those sessions from offering operations they cannot handle.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Build the bundle and run the ACP regression below. It enables `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1`, supplies `qwen.agentTeam: true` as client metadata, and explicitly requests visibility for all seven team tools. The model request should retain the ordinary `agent` tool while omitting all seven team tools and the `name`, `plan_mode_required`, and `read_only` arguments.
2. With the same local model fixture and the experiment enabled, check that text headless and direct stream-json still advertise all seven team tools and three team-specific arguments. Disable the experiment in text headless and confirm the ordinary `agent` tool remains available.
3. Run the Ink scenario below and confirm teammate reports still reach the leader. The focused CLI tests also cover non-interactive approvals, preservation of SDK stream-json initialization options, and the separate Hosted admission rules.

```bash
npm run build && npm run bundle
CI=1 QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --root ./integration-tests cli/acp-integration.test.ts --retry=0 -t 'withholds Agent Team tools'
CI=1 QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --root ./integration-tests interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts --retry=0 -t 'a teammate report that starts'
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Recorded macOS loopback probe results for actual model requests. The ordinary `agent` tool appeared in every row.

| Model request | Before (installed qwen 0.27.3) | After (built bundle) |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| ACP, experiment on and client metadata supplied | 7 tools / 3 arguments | 0 tools / 0 arguments |
| Text headless, experiment on | 7 tools / 3 arguments | 7 tools / 3 arguments |
| Text headless, experiment off | 0 tools / 0 arguments | 0 tools / 0 arguments |
| Direct stream-json, experiment on | 7 tools / 3 arguments | 7 tools / 3 arguments |

The focused runs passed 1,133 core tests and 882 CLI tests, with one existing CLI skip. The ACP regression and Ink teammate-report scenario passed against the built bundle. `npm run build`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint and Prettier checks, and `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npm run typecheck` passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 22.18.0, installed qwen 0.27.3 for the baseline, and a locally built CLI bundle for the candidate. A deterministic OpenAI-compatible loopback server captured model requests.

## Risk & Scope

- A host that already handles reports and approvals must explicitly declare support to retain experimental Legacy team tools. ACP will need verified report and approval wiring before it can opt in. [ACP follow-up](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658)
- ACP load/resume and OpenTUI startup were inspected in source. Runtime checks covered ACP session creation and prompting. Native OpenTUI, live Hosted, a real model provider, Windows, and Linux were outside the runtime validation. The Managed Public API milestones in the overall design are planned work.
- Existing experiment settings and shell sandbox rules still apply. The visibility change affects Legacy hosts that omit support. There are no public API, settings, or storage migrations.

## Linked Issues

Refs QwenLM/qwen-code#13785

---


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

Legacy Agent Team 工具和 `agent` 的团队专用参数现在仅在宿主显式支持队友报告和审批、实验功能开启且现有 Shell 沙箱允许时向模型声明。Ink 和非交互的文本、JSON、stream-json 模式保留团队能力。ACP 和 OpenTUI 继续提供普通 `agent` 工具，并省略团队工具和参数。Hosted Agents 继续使用独立的团队准入规则。

新增 ACP 回归测试，直接检查发给模型的工具 schema。Managed Multi-Agent API 总体设计提供中英文两版，将此门禁定位为 M4 的第一个交付切片，并说明执行身份、任务树、团队名册和定向干预的后续工作。[Legacy 门禁设计（简体中文）](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-agent-team-host-gate.zh-CN.md) · [总体设计（English）](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-23-managed-multi-agent-public-api.md) · [总体设计（简体中文）](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/14e5c76be4481ab51bf6c42887bd3c044d796459/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-23-managed-multi-agent-public-api.zh-CN.md)

## Why it's needed

实验开关此前可以在缺少报告接收回调或审批监听器的 ACP 会话中暴露团队工具。模型可以启动队友，但报告可能一直未读，工具审批也可能持续等待直至停滞超时。按宿主的支持能力注册工具，可防止这些会话向模型提供无法处理的操作。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 构建 bundle，再运行下面的 ACP 回归测试。用例设置 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1`，在客户端元数据中传入 `qwen.agentTeam: true`，并显式要求显示全部 7 个团队工具。模型请求应保留普通 `agent` 工具，同时省略全部 7 个团队工具及 `name`、`plan_mode_required`、`read_only` 参数。

3. 运行下面的 Ink 场景，确认队友报告仍能送达 leader。针对性 CLI 测试还覆盖非交互审批、SDK stream-json 初始化选项的保留，以及 Hosted 的独立准入规则。

```bash
npm run build && npm run bundle
CI=1 QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --root ./integration-tests cli/acp-integration.test.ts --retry=0 -t 'withholds Agent Team tools'
CI=1 QWEN_E2E_RENDERER=ink QWEN_SANDBOX=false ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --root ./integration-tests interactive/tui-agent-loop-parity.test.ts --retry=0 -t 'a teammate report that starts'
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

以下数据来自 macOS 回环探针记录的实际模型请求。每行都保留了普通 `agent` 工具。

| Model request | Before (installed qwen 0.27.3) | After (built bundle) |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| ACP，实验功能开启并提供客户端元数据 | 7 个工具 / 3 个参数 | 0 个工具 / 0 个参数 |
| 文本 headless，实验功能开启 | 7 个工具 / 3 个参数 | 7 个工具 / 3 个参数 |
| 文本 headless，实验功能关闭 | 0 个工具 / 0 个参数 | 0 个工具 / 0 个参数 |
| 直连 stream-json，实验功能开启 | 7 个工具 / 3 个参数 | 7 个工具 / 3 个参数 |

针对性测试共通过 1,133 项 core 测试和 882 项 CLI 测试，另有 1 个原有的 CLI 跳过用例。ACP 回归和 Ink 队友报告场景均在构建后的 bundle 上通过。`npm run build`、`npm run bundle`、针对性 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查，以及 `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npm run typecheck` 均通过。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64、Node.js 22.18.0。基线使用已安装的 qwen 0.27.3，验证改动使用本地构建的 CLI bundle。确定性的 OpenAI 兼容回环服务记录了模型请求。

## Risk & Scope

- 已能处理队友报告和审批的宿主，需要显式声明支持才会保留实验性的 Legacy 团队工具。ACP 需先验证报告和审批链路，才能声明支持。[ACP 后续工作](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15658)

- 现有实验设置与 Shell 沙箱规则继续生效。工具可见性的变化影响未声明支持的 Legacy 宿主。本次无需迁移公共 API、配置或存储数据。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): support session-required Skills menus
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds opt-in support for hosts whose Skills catalog requires a session. Opening the Skills menu prepares the composer's session through the existing creation flow, reads that session's commands, and retains the draft. Custom menus can request the same preparation through the composer API. The first prompt reuses the prepared session.

This is a Draft PR for session-required menus only. First initialization latency remains unresolved: opening the menu can still wait for session preparation. This does not establish worker-ready catalog availability or complete first-open performance work.

## Why it's needed

A fresh composer has no session from which to read session-scoped Skills. Creating one independently for a menu risks diverging from the first prompt's lifecycle, while assigning a session without migrating the draft can discard the user's input. This change shares preparation with prompt submission and uses the existing draft-assignment mechanism.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable session-required Skills for a host with a session-scoped catalog. From a fresh composer, type a slash query and open the menu. Confirm that preparation creates no prompt and the menu uses the resulting session's commands.
2. Keep editing text and attachments during preparation. Select a Skill and send; confirm that the draft is retained and the prepared session is reused.
3. Navigate away while preparation is pending, and separately try sending while preparation is pending. Confirm that stale menu results do not populate another composer and that a concurrent prompt retains its session ownership.
4. Leave the option disabled. Confirm that the existing workspace catalog and custom-footer behavior remain available.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: hosts with session-only catalogs could not populate a fresh composer's Skills menu through the workspace catalog; assigning a newly prepared session could also clear the draft.

After: first-menu session preparation, menu display, and draft retention were confirmed in an integration environment before extraction onto this main-based branch. That verification does not establish performance improvement or validate this new base. No screenshots, environment identifiers, or logs are included.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested on this branch |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested on this branch |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested on this branch |

### Environment (optional)

Prior integration verification only. No local tests, builds, lint, type checks, or dependency installation were run for this extraction.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: opening the menu can allocate a session and incur initialization latency. Preparation overlapping navigation or Send requires careful ownership and draft handling.
- Not validated / out of scope: first initialization latency, catalog preparation before session creation, worker readiness, server-side resource initialization, and automated validation on the new base. Repeated command reads during the session identity transition are not optimized here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the option defaults to disabled; the new composer method is optional. Existing hosts need no migration.

Design: [English](docs/design/web-shell/session-backed-skills.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/session-backed-skills.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 Skills 目录必须依赖会话的宿主新增可选支持。打开 Skills 菜单时，通过现有创建流程准备输入框所属会话，读取该会话的命令，并保留草稿。自定义菜单可以通过输入框 API 请求相同的准备过程。首条消息复用已准备的会话。

这是仅针对会话依赖型菜单的 Draft PR。首次初始化延迟尚未解决：打开菜单仍可能等待会话准备完成。本变更不代表 Worker READY 时目录已可用，也不代表首开性能工作已完成。

## 为什么需要

新输入框尚无可用于读取会话级 Skills 的会话。为菜单独立创建会话可能偏离首条消息的生命周期，而分配会话时不迁移草稿可能丢弃用户输入。本变更与消息提交共享准备过程，并复用现有草稿分配机制。

## 评审者验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 对提供会话级目录的宿主启用会话依赖型 Skills。在新输入框中输入 slash 查询并打开菜单，确认准备过程不提交消息，且菜单使用所创建会话的命令。
2. 准备过程中继续编辑文本和附件，随后选择 Skill 并发送，确认草稿保留且复用已准备会话。
3. 分别验证准备过程中导航离开，以及准备过程中发送消息。确认旧菜单结果不会写入另一输入框，且并发消息保留其会话归属。
4. 不启用该选项，确认原有工作区目录与自定义页脚行为仍可用。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：仅提供会话目录的宿主无法通过工作区目录填充新输入框的 Skills 菜单；分配刚准备的会话还可能清空草稿。

改动后：首次菜单的会话准备、菜单展示及草稿保留，已在提取到此次 main 基线之前的集成环境中确认。该验证不证明性能改善，也不代表新基线已验证。不附带截图、环境标识或日志。

### 验证平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未在此分支验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在此分支验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在此分支验证 |

### 环境（可选）

仅有此前的集成验证。本次提取未运行本地测试、构建、lint、类型检查或依赖安装。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：打开菜单会分配会话并可能产生初始化延迟。准备与导航或发送重叠时，需要正确处理会话归属和草稿。
- 未验证或不在范围内：首次初始化延迟、会话创建前准备目录、Worker 就绪语义、服务端资源初始化，以及新基线上的自动化验证。本次也未优化会话身份切换期间重复的命令读取。
- 破坏性变更与迁移：选项默认关闭，新增输入框方法为可选，现有宿主无需迁移。

设计：[English](docs/design/web-shell/session-backed-skills.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/web-shell/session-backed-skills.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

无。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): enable per-workspace management from sidebar menu and hover overview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change turns every locally trusted workspace in the Web Shell left sidebar into a directly manageable entry point instead of restricting management controls to the primary workspace and keeping hover details read-only. Every locally trusted non-SSH workspace now exposes its own capability-gated management menu entries for MCP servers, Skills, Extensions, Channels, and Settings, while untrusted local workspaces gain a one-click Trust action directly inside the sidebar menu when the daemon supports granting trust.

In the workspace hover details popover, manageable overview rows for MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Context, and Hooks become interactive rows with trailing chevrons and workspace-scoped accessible names so clicking any facet closes the popover cleanly without pulling focus back to the sidebar and jumps straight to that workspace's management surface. Selecting MCP, Skills, or Extensions opens the unified Plugins view on the matching tab targeted to the clicked workspace (also resolving an existing issue where opening MCP from the workspace menu could fall through to the session overview). Selecting Channels or Settings targets that workspace with a workspace switcher in the scope bar, selecting Context opens that workspace's instruction files dialog, and selecting Hooks opens a dedicated workspace hooks dialog showing configured hooks and hash-bound project-hook approval controls.

## Why it's needed

Previously, users managing multiple local workspaces from the Web Shell sidebar saw live health counts in the hover popover that could not be clicked, had no management entries at all in secondary workspace overflow menus, and had to leave the sidebar for the full Workspaces overview table just to trust an untrusted directory. Because the daemon already exposes workspace-scoped routes for MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Settings, Memory, Hooks, and Trust grants, wiring the sidebar controls and management panels to the clicked workspace removes this asymmetry while keeping strict workspace isolation and graceful degradation for older daemons.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell against a multi-workspace daemon with at least one primary trusted workspace, one secondary trusted workspace, and (optionally) one untrusted local workspace.
2. Open the overflow menu on a secondary trusted workspace: confirm the Manage group appears with MCP, Skills (when supported), Extensions, Channels (when supported), and Settings alongside live counts, whereas previously no Manage entries were shown.
3. Click Settings from that secondary workspace menu: confirm Settings opens with the Workspace scope bar showing a workspace switcher pre-selected to that secondary workspace, and confirm editing a workspace-scoped setting or extra directory targets that workspace without altering global UI preferences for other sessions.
4. Hover over the same secondary workspace row to open its details popover: confirm manageable facet rows (MCP, Skills, Extensions, Channels, Context, and Hooks when enabled) render as interactive rows with trailing chevrons and distinct workspace-scoped accessible names, while unsupported facets remain plain read-only rows.
5. Click the MCP row inside the hover popover: confirm the popover closes immediately without stealing focus back to the sidebar row and opens the Plugins panel on the MCP tab already scoped to that secondary workspace.
6. Click Extensions from a secondary workspace and confirm the Extensions tab exposes the workspace switcher and routes activation changes to that secondary workspace; click Context to open that workspace's instruction files dialog; click Hooks to inspect configured hooks and approve/reject pending project hooks.
7. Open the overflow menu on an untrusted local workspace (on a daemon advertising trust grant): confirm management entries stay hidden and a Trust workspace action appears, disables while the runtime rebuilds, and transitions to trusted controls once capabilities refresh.

### Evidence (Before & After)

All screenshots below were captured against the live local daemon (`127.0.0.1:4170`, 24 workspaces) targeting the same secondary trusted workspace (`qwen-code-doc`) with uniform blur/home state before interaction.

#### Secondary workspace overflow menu (Before vs After)

| Before (secondary menu had no Manage group) | After (secondary menu exposes Manage group with live counts) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: secondary workspace overflow menu without Manage entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-secondary-menu.png) | ![After: secondary workspace overflow menu with Manage entries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-menu.png) |

#### Workspace hover overview popover (Before vs After)

| Before (overview facets were read-only divs) | After (manageable facets are interactive buttons with chevrons) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: hover overview popover with read-only facet rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/before-hover-overview-readonly.png) | ![After: hover overview popover with interactive facet rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-hover-overview-interactive.png) |

#### Direct secondary-workspace navigation (After)

| Clicking MCP from hover popover opens Plugins → MCP scoped to `qwen-code-doc` | Clicking Settings from secondary menu opens Settings scoped to `qwen-code-doc` |
| --- | --- |
| ![After: Plugins MCP tab scoped to secondary workspace qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-plugins-mcp.png) | ![After: Settings panel with workspace switcher scoped to secondary workspace qwen-code-doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/web-shell-workspace-sidebar-management/after-secondary-settings.png) |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux x86_64, Node v26.12.1 (`NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` for jsdom vitest suites), Vite dev server proxying local `qwen serve` daemon on port 4170, Chromium headless shell via CDP for Before/After UI verification.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Allowing management panels to target secondary workspaces requires careful isolation so editing workspace-scoped settings, directories, or memory files never leaks into the active session's workspace or global UI preferences, and removing or revoking trust on a targeted workspace must cleanly fall back to the primary workspace or close workspace-scoped dialogs.
- Verification scope and limits: Full monorepo `npm run build && npm run typecheck` has completed successfully on the merged tree in this frozen-lockfile worktree with its own `node_modules`; cross-host remote workspaces, SSH workspaces, Managed workspaces, and primary-workspace rename persistence remain out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None; older daemons without split skills runtime, channel management, or trust grant capabilities degrade gracefully by omitting unsupported secondary actions or rendering read-only hover rows.

## 本 PR 做了什么

本次改动将 Web Shell 左侧栏中的每一个本地受信任工作区都升级为可直接管理的入口，不再局限于主工作区，也不再把悬停概览保持为纯只读展示。所有本地受信任的非 SSH 工作区现在都在侧栏 `⋮` 菜单中提供按能力门控的「管理」分组（MCP、技能、扩展、频道、设置）；当守护进程支持信任授权时，未受信任的本地工作区也会在侧栏菜单中直接提供一键「信任工作区」操作。

## 为什么需要这个改动

此前在多工作区模式下，用户悬停左侧栏工作区虽然能看到 MCP、技能、扩展、频道、上下文等实时计数，却无法直接点击跳转；次级工作区的 `⋮` 菜单完全缺失管理入口；想要信任一个未受信任目录时也必须跳到全页工作区总览表。由于守护进程已经具备完善的工作区级路由，将侧栏菜单、悬停浮层与各管理页面按目标工作区打通，既能消除主次工作区的体验割裂，又能在老版本守护进程上保持严格的作用域隔离和优雅降级。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 在包含主工作区、至少一个受信任次级工作区（以及可选的未受信任本地工作区）的多工作区守护进程下打开 Web Shell。
2. 打开受信任次级工作区的 `⋮` 菜单：确认出现「管理」分组，包含 MCP、技能（能力就绪时）、扩展、频道（能力就绪时）和设置及实时计数，而改动前没有任何管理项。
3. 从该次级工作区菜单点击「设置」：确认进入设置页且工作区作用域栏展示工作区切换器并默认选中该次级工作区；修改工作区级设置或额外目录不会误改其他会话的全局界面偏好。
4. 悬停同一受信任次级工作区行打开详情浮层：确认可管理状态行（MCP、技能、扩展、频道、上下文，以及开启时的 Hooks）均渲染为带右侧箭头的按钮且 `aria-label` 包含工作区名称；不支持的状态项保持纯只读行。
5. 直接点击悬停浮层中的 MCP 行：确认浮层立即关闭且不抢夺焦点，并跳转到插件管理页的 MCP 标签页且工作区切换器自动选中该次级工作区。
6. 从次级工作区点击「扩展」，确认扩展标签页同样展示工作区切换器并将启停操作路由至该工作区；点击「上下文」确认加载该工作区的指令文件；点击「Hooks」确认展示该工作区的 Hooks 列表及待审批项目 Hook 控制。
7. 打开未受信任本地工作区的 `⋮` 菜单（守护进程支持信任授权时）：确认隐藏管理项并展示「信任工作区」，点击后在运行时重建期间呈禁用态，重建完成后自动切换为受信任菜单。

### 验证证据（改动前后对比）

以下截图均在连接本机真实守护进程（`127.0.0.1:4170`，24 个工作区）的 Chromium 环境中针对同一个受信任次级工作区（`qwen-code-doc`）采集，交互前保持统一的焦点与首页背景状态。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): bind Managed provider to SessionChatController (slice 3b)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change adds the React binding layer that connects an existing Managed Agent session, its incremental transcript stream, its pending approval and question requests, and its turn-cancellation lifecycle to the backend-neutral chat controller introduced in slice 3a. The new binding stays completely decoupled from daemon runtime modules and remains inert in production pages until the page switch in slice 3c.

To keep transport admission distinct from authoritative settlement without inventing new backend routes or wire fields, the existing Managed action response path and turn-cancellation lifecycle now expose optional in-process observation callbacks for durable admission and terminal operation status while preserving existing promise resolution and error contracts for all current callers. This change also closes the two non-blocking follow-up items from #18117: expiry-only deadline updates no longer rebuild pending request rendering identity or reset an in-progress user answer while per-read expiry filtering stays enforced, and replayed settlements against an already-terminal operation no longer re-enter the early-settlement buffer while another dispatch is in flight.

## Why it's needed

Slice 3a delivered the pure Managed controller core with injected test doubles, which was not yet connected to the real Managed provider, session subscription, pending action polling, or cancellation recovery lifecycle. Connecting those layers directly revealed that the high-level action response method previously hid durable operation admission and terminal status behind a void promise, making it impossible to distinguish accepted-and-unsettled from accepted-and-failed honestly. Exposing the existing operation evidence at the client boundary lets the binding satisfy the shared intent contract without changing any server APIs or regressing existing Managed page behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Verify that an existing Managed session without a loaded matching summary yields no controller rather than fabricating an empty session or falling back to a daemon backend, and that once loaded a single controller instance persists across ordinary summary, transcript, history, and pending-action updates while recreating only when the provider, client identity, or session changes.
- Verify that owner switches and unmounts abort active subscriptions and discard late operation or turn callbacks so they cannot affect a newly selected session.
- Verify prompt submission end to end: disabled send capability and locally invalid attachments or oversized question payloads are rejected before any network request is dispatched, non-retryable non-auth 4xx failures map to rejected admission, transient 5xx or ambiguous responses map to unknown admission, valid admissions bind turn completion events (including events arriving before the transport promise resolves), and attachments are encoded into the expected request payload.
- Verify approval and structured question handling over a real Java provider instance with mocked HTTP: option identifiers, free text, revisions, and idempotency keys reach the wire intact; accepted admission resolves before operation polling settles; late terminal failure or recovery blocking transitions the tracked operation without being misclassified as a rejected admission; and a provider that resolves without observation callbacks is treated as unknown rather than accepted.
- Verify pending projection caching and settlement guards: updating only an action's expiry deadline preserves request and raw input identity and keeps a user's selected options and typed text intact across parent re-renders while advancing the clock still expires the action; replaying a terminal operation settlement while another dispatch is in flight does not pollute the new attempt.
- Local verification passed: 13 focused and regression test suites (700 tests) in the web-shell package passed, both web-shell TypeScript configurations passed, ESLint passed with zero warnings across all changed files, and repository-wide build and typecheck exited cleanly.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (additive binding hook and provider observation seam only; no production page has been switched yet, so there is no user-visible UI change in this slice).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Vitest (jsdom + mocked HTTP against the real Java Managed provider implementation), TypeScript, ESLint, and repository workspace build. No live Java Managed Agent server or live model calls were used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Adding optional in-process observer callbacks slightly widens the provider command options surface, traded off against honestly separating durable admission from terminal operation settlement without inventing new network routes or misusing void promise resolution as completion proof.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live Java Managed Agent server execution, live model traffic, switching the Managed sessions page onto the shared chat surface, visual before/after parity checks, shared question card updates for optional or text-disabled questions, prompt persistence across page reload with ambiguous acknowledgement, and restoring locally admitted operations after a full owner rebuild.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Existing callers that omit the optional observer callbacks retain identical return values, error codes, and retry behavior.

Design documents (English & Chinese synchronized): [English](docs/design/2026-11-24-managed-chat-controller-binding.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-managed-chat-controller-binding.zh-CN.md) (linked from the slice 3a design documents [English](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.zh-CN.md)).

## Linked Issues

Part of #17460; builds on #18117.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本次变更新增了 React 绑定层，将既有 Managed Agent 会话、增量转录事件流、待处理审批与提问列表以及回合取消生命周期，接入切片 3a 引入的后端中立聊天控制器。新绑定完全不依赖 daemon 运行时模块，且在切片 3c 页面切换之前不会接入生产页面。

为了在不新增后端路由或协议字段的前提下严格区分传输准入与权威结算，既有 Managed 动作响应路径与回合取消生命周期新增了可选的进程内观察回调，用于分别上报持久化准入和终态操作状态，同时为所有现有调用方完整保留原有的 Promise 返回与错误契约。本次变更同时收口了 #18117 评审留档的两项非阻塞事项：仅期限变化时不再重建待动作渲染身份或清空用户正在进行的作答，同时保留每次读取时的实时过期过滤；针对已终态操作的重放结算在存在并发派发时不再重新进入早到结算缓冲。

## 为什么需要这个改动

切片 3a 交付了使用注入依赖测试的纯 Managed 控制器核心，尚未接入真实 Managed provider、会话事件订阅、待处理动作轮询与取消恢复生命周期。直接对接这些真实层时发现，原有高层动作响应方法将持久化操作准入与终态结果隐藏在无返回值的 Promise 之后，导致调用方无法诚实区分“已准入但未结算”与“已准入后失败”。在客户端边界暴露已有的操作证据，使绑定层能够在不修改任何服务端 API、不回退现有 Managed 页面行为的前提下满足共享意图契约。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方式

- 验证尚未拿到匹配摘要的 Managed 会话不会构造空会话或回退到 daemon 后端，而是返回空值；拿到摘要后，在普通的摘要、转录、历史与待动作更新中保持同一个控制器实例，仅当 provider、客户端身份或会话变化时才重建。
- 验证切换归属或卸载组件时会中止活跃订阅并丢弃迟到的操作或回合回调，不会污染新选中的会话。
- 验证端到端提示提交：禁止发送能力以及本地校验失败的附件或超限提问载荷会在任何网络请求发出前被拒绝；不可重试的非认证 4xx 映射为明确拒绝；临时 5xx 或不确定响应映射为未知准入；合法准入能正确绑定回合终态事件（含早于传输 Promise 解析到达的事件），并将附件按预期格式编码进请求体。
- 验证通过真实 Java provider 实例配合模拟 HTTP 处理审批与结构化提问：选项标识、自由文本、修订号与幂等键完整抵达请求体；持久化准入先于后续轮询终态解析；后续终态失败或恢复阻塞会正确驱动被追踪操作而不被误判为拒绝准入；不提供观察回调的 provider 仅返回成功时会被归类为未知而非已准入。
- 验证待动作投影缓存与结算守卫：仅更新动作过期时间时保持请求与原始输入对象身份稳定，且真实父级重渲染不会清空用户已选项和已输入文本，推进时钟仍即时过滤已过期动作；并发派发在飞时重放已终态操作结算不会污染新尝试。
- 本地验证结果：web-shell 包内 13 个聚焦与回归测试文件（共 700 项测试）全部通过，web-shell 两套 TypeScript 配置全部通过，全部变更文件 ESLint 零告警通过，全仓 build 与 typecheck 均正常退出。

### 前后对比证据

N/A（仅为增量绑定 hook 与 provider 观察边界，尚未切换任何生产页面，本次切片无用户可见 UI 变更）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 运行环境（可选）

本地 Vitest（jsdom 配合针对真实 Java Managed provider 实现的模拟 HTTP）、TypeScript、ESLint 与全仓工作区构建。未使用真实 Java Managed Agent 服务或真实模型调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：新增可选进程内观察回调略微扩大了 provider 命令选项接口面，换取在不发明新网络路由、不将无返回值 Promise 误当作完成证据的前提下，诚实区分持久化准入与操作终态结算。
- 未验证／超出范围：真实 Java Managed Agent 服务端执行、真实模型流量、将 Managed 会话页面切换到共享聊天界面、浏览器级视觉前后对比门禁、共享提问卡片对可选题与禁用自由文本的支持、确认缺失时跨页面刷新的提示词幂等持久化，以及完整归属重建后的本地已准入操作恢复。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。未传入可选观察回调的现有调用方保持完全一致的返回值、错误码与重试行为。

双语设计文档（中英文同步）：[English](docs/design/2026-11-24-managed-chat-controller-binding.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-24-managed-chat-controller-binding.zh-CN.md)（已从切片 3a 设计文档建立双向链接：[English](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-chat-controller.zh-CN.md)）。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #17460 的一部分；基于 #18117 继续推进。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): avoid false managed artifact previews
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Avoids false `Preview` labels for managed and non-previewable artifacts, while preserving real workspace previews, live published artifact pages, and published web-preview snapshots. The host-ownership flag is now shared with split panes and artifact-panel providers.

## Why it's needed

The previous implementation used a storage deny-list and only threaded host ownership through the main chat provider. Published non-snapshot artifacts could promise a preview the built-in panel cannot render, and split panes could show a different label from the main chat.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Check workspace-rendered artifacts: they remain previewable.
2. Check managed artifacts with and without host ownership.
3. Check published web-preview snapshots and live published artifact pages versus non-previewable published artifacts.
4. Open the same managed artifact in main chat and split view with host ownership enabled.
5. Run the focused helper/DOM tests and lint.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: published non-snapshot artifacts passed the deny-list and split panes received a customization object without `hostOwnsArtifactPreview`; no DOM test proved the user-visible managed-card label.
- After: previewability mirrors the panel's allow-list plus the known live published artifact shape, managed previews require host ownership, app-level customization is shared across providers, and the DOM suite proves managed cards switch from Open to Preview only when the host opts in.
- Focused helper test: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/artifacts/TurnOutputs.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — 37 passed.
- Focused DOM test: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/web-shell exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/artifacts/TurnOutputs.dom.test.tsx --coverage.enabled=false` — 24 passed.
- ESLint passed for App, customization, TurnOutputs, and its tests.

### Tested on

| OS | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 11 | ✅ Focused Vitest and ESLint passed |

## Risk & Scope

Medium risk. Changes are limited to artifact-card labeling, customization propagation, documentation comments, and regression coverage. Artifact open routing remains controlled by the existing host callbacks; hosts must only opt in when they also claim artifact opens.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16637

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

修复托管和已发布非预览工件被错误标记为 `Preview` 的问题，并让主聊天、分屏和 ArtifactPanel 共享 host artifact ownership 配置；同时保留 workspace、实时发布页和 web preview snapshot 的正确预览标签，并增加真实 DOM 回归测试。

</details>

## AI Disclosure

This PR was prepared with AI assistance. The author reviewed previewability rules, cross-surface propagation, focused tests, and lint output.

prs.title: perf(web-shell): Skip redundant root scope guards
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Avoid adding a second CSS scope guard when a selector already starts with the complete Web Shell or portal root boundary. Keep the same matching elements, specificity, and declaration order, while retaining the existing guard for all other selectors.

## Why it's needed

Broad reset and scrollbar selectors were checking the root boundary twice. This added style recalculation work during session switching and delayed the history request. Removing the redundant checks reduced median click-to-visible history from 1,308 ms to 815 ms in the staging comparison below.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Switch between two existing sessions in the same workspace using A→B→A with `historyPageSize=200`. History should still follow the existing clear, load, and attach flow, and the send control should become available for the loaded target session.
2. Check transcript styling, scrollbar styling, and portaled controls. Web Shell and portal styles should retain their boundaries and precedence over plain host styles.
3. Check the component and standalone transcript build artifacts. Selectors that already begin with the complete root boundary should contain it once; ordinary selectors should retain their existing isolation guard. Reset and KaTeX rule order should stay unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Alternating baseline/candidate/baseline/candidate batches, four completed switches per batch, give eight samples per variant. Each batch contains two A→B→A cycles. Both variants use the same existing sessions, a 200-item history page, and the existing switching flow.

| Median latency | Baseline | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Click → history request | 636.50 ms | 301.15 ms |
| Loading cleared → history visible | 163.30 ms | 75.70 ms |
| Click → history visible | 1308.35 ms | 815.25 ms |
| Click → send available | 1308.45 ms | 815.25 ms |

The browser comparison uses the same deployed-version bundle with passive timing marks and only 31 redundant guards removed in the candidate. The source patch is separately validated by a full build, typecheck, and 60 focused tests. See the [detailed timing report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18223#issuecomment-7122436867). Network latency also varied, so the entire end-to-end difference is not attributed to CSS.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chrome session-switch comparison; full build/typecheck; 60 focused tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

A local embedded host connected to the same staging backend for both variants. No prompts were submitted. Browser profiling was disabled during the measured batches.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: CSS isolation and cascade must remain equivalent. The optimization requires an exact normalized first-node match to the complete root boundary; ordinary and partially scoped selectors retain the original guard.
- Not validated / out of scope: Other browsers, arbitrary session sizes, and production rollout. The history page remains 200 in the experiment, and the clear/load/attach flow is unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

当选择器已经以完整的 Web Shell 或浮层根边界开头时，避免再次添加 CSS 作用域条件。保持匹配元素、优先级和声明顺序不变，其它选择器继续保留原有隔离条件。

## 为什么需要

通用重置和滚动条选择器重复检查了根边界，增加会话切换时的样式重算工作，延后了历史请求。下述预发对照中，去掉重复检查后，点击到历史可见的中位数从 1,308 ms 降至 815 ms。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在同一工作区的两个已有会话之间按 A→B→A 切换，保持 `historyPageSize=200`。历史仍应经过原有的清空、加载和接管流程，发送控件应在目标会话加载后恢复可用。
2. 检查历史、滚动条和 Portal 控件的样式。Web Shell 和浮层样式应保留原隔离边界及相对普通宿主样式的优先级。
3. 检查组件和独立 transcript 构建产物。已经以完整根边界开头的选择器只应包含一次边界，其它选择器仍保留原隔离条件；重置样式和 KaTeX 规则顺序不变。

### 改动前后证据

按原版、候选、原版、候选四批交替测量，每批完成四次切换，两种版本各八个样本。每批包含两轮 A→B→A。两种版本使用同一对已有会话、200 条历史分页和现有切换流程。

| 耗时中位数 | 原版 | 候选 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 点击→历史请求发出 | 636.50 ms | 301.15 ms |
| loading 清除→历史可见 | 163.30 ms | 75.70 ms |
| 点击→历史可见 | 1308.35 ms | 815.25 ms |
| 点击→可发送 | 1308.45 ms | 815.25 ms |

浏览器对照使用同一已部署版本制品，加入被动计时标记，候选仅移除 31 个重复条件。正式源码补丁另外通过全仓构建、类型检查和 60 项定向测试。参见[完整分段计时报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/18223#issuecomment-7122436867)。网络耗时也有波动，因此不会把全部端到端差值归因于 CSS。

### 已测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chrome 会话切换对照、全仓构建及类型检查、60 项定向测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

本地嵌入式宿主连接同一预发后端，两组环境一致。没有发送 prompt。正式测量批次未开启浏览器性能录制。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：必须保持 CSS 隔离和级联等价。只有首 AST 节点规范化后精确等于完整根边界时才优化，其它普通选择器和部分限定范围的选择器仍保留原条件。
- 未验证或范围外：其它浏览器、任意会话大小和生产发布。实验保持历史分页为 200，清空、加载和接管流程不变。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): execute extensions on external Workspace workers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Allows explicitly configured external Workspace Workers to execute extension Skills, scripts, MCP tools and hooks through the existing Hosted Shell and publication protocols. External placement keeps its provider identity while the Session selects the negotiated execution profile. The boot contract, saved resource handle and recovery checks retain the extension configuration. Public child Agents are reported as degraded and remain deferred.

This is a **Draft**, stacked on #18100. It adds the execution path beyond that PR's Skills admission support.

## Why it's needed

External storage previously remained on files-only or foreground-Shell paths even when the integration needed extension execution. That prevented package activation or script execution from reaching the registered Worker. This change connects those paths while retaining Session ownership, storage registration, approval, package pin and publication checks.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure an external registered Workspace with the complete extension execution prerequisites described in the design, and use paired control-plane and Worker artifacts.
2. Create a Session with an extension containing a Skill, an executable script, an MCP tool and a command hook. Confirm the effective catalog and explicit degradation of child Agents.
3. Approve a script through the normal Action flow, invoke the MCP tool, and inspect durable tool and hook results. Verify a second turn still reads the immutable package.
4. Check that incomplete configuration retains the existing profile restrictions, and that stale ownership, mismatched pins and unfenced shared-Worker retirement remain rejected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The integrated implementation on Linux executed an approved Python Skill script, an MCP tool and automatic command hooks. Persisted hook results included successful execution of the post-tool hook for the approved script. This is prior integration evidence, not a new run of the extracted PR revision. Full CI, real-MySQL concurrency and failure-recovery acceptance remain pending.

Static review found and corrected the missing Shell profile in the OpenAPI creation enums; the client was regenerated from the contract. No local tests, builds, typechecks or lint were run for this extraction.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | Not runtime-tested for this PR |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Prior integrated success path; extracted revision not rerun |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: shared external Worker ownership, publication and retirement cross Java and TypeScript boundaries. `developer-process-group` supports Linux here but does not provide `linux-cgroup` process-tree isolation or drain guarantees.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete CI and failure-recovery coverage, public child Agents, downstream product routing and first-session menu latency. An unresolved execution may still occupy a shared dispatch slot.
- Compatibility: upgrade control-plane and Worker artifacts together. Explicit execution prerequisites are required; existing restricted profiles retain their gates. Clients must accept `agents` in the degraded-component enum.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-workspace-extension-execution/docs/design/2026-11-22-external-workspace-extension-execution.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/external-workspace-extension-execution/docs/design/2026-11-22-external-workspace-extension-execution.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Depends on #18100. Related to #17357 and #16023.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

允许明确配置的外部 Workspace Worker 通过既有 Hosted Shell 和 publication 协议执行扩展 Skills、脚本、MCP 工具及 hooks。外部 placement 保留 provider 身份，Session 使用协商后的执行 profile。boot 契约、持久化资源 handle 与恢复校验保留扩展配置。公开子 Agent 明确标为降级，留待后续。

本 PR 为 **Draft**，基于 #18100；在其 Skills 准入支持之上补齐执行路径。

## 为什么需要

此前即使接入方需要扩展执行，外部存储仍受 files-only 或 foreground-Shell 路径限制，导致包激活或脚本无法到达登记的 Worker。本次连接这些路径，保留 Session 归属、存储注册、审批、包 pin 和 publication 校验。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 按设计文档启用完整扩展执行配置，使用配套的控制面与 Worker 制品。
2. 在外部登记的 Workspace 创建 Session，选择包含 Skill、可执行脚本、MCP 工具和 command hook 的扩展；确认生效目录及子 Agent 的明确降级。
3. 通过正常 Action 流程批准脚本，调用 MCP 工具，并核对持久化工具与 hook 结果；确认第二回合仍能读取不可变的包。
4. 确认配置不完整时保留既有 profile 限制，过期归属、不匹配 pin、未加存储 fence 的共享 Worker 退役仍被拒绝。

### 前后证据

联调实现已在 Linux 上执行获批的 Python Skill 脚本、MCP 工具及自动 command hooks。持久化结果包含获批脚本对应 PostToolUse hook 的成功执行。此为此前联调证据，不是对本次提取版本重新运行的结果。完整 CI、真实 MySQL 并发和故障恢复验收仍待完成。

静态审查发现并修正创建接口 OpenAPI 枚举遗漏 Shell profile 的问题，客户端已根据契约重新生成。本次提取未运行本机测试、构建、类型检查或 lint。

### 平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | 本 PR 未进行运行时测试 |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 此前联调成功路径；提取版本未重跑 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：共享外部 Worker 的归属、publication、退役涉及 Java 与 TypeScript 多层协议。本次使 `developer-process-group` 支持 Linux，但不提供 `linux-cgroup` 的进程树隔离或 drain 保证。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 CI 与故障恢复覆盖、公开子 Agent、下游产品路由和首次会话菜单延迟；未收口的执行仍可能占用共享 dispatch slot。
- 兼容性：控制面与 Worker 制品须配套升级；执行需要显式完整配置，既有限制 profile 保留准入条件；客户端需接受降级组件枚举中的 `agents`。
- 设计文档：见上方英文和中文链接。

## 关联

依赖 #18100，关联 #17357 和 #16023。

</details>

prs.title: feat(skills): add pkgdiet dependency guardrail
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the PkgDiet dependency guardrail skill to Qwen Code as an **opt-in, user-invoked** skill (`/pkgdiet`). When activated, it registers the PkgDiet MCP server and gates npm package installs through explicit security checks before the user confirms each installation.

## Why it's needed

As AI coding agents become more autonomous, there is a risk of them hallucinating malicious packages or installing deprecated, bloated dependencies (like `request` or `moment.js`). This skill provides a user-controlled guardrail using the PkgDiet MCP server.

**This skill is NOT automatic.** It only activates when the user explicitly runs `/pkgdiet` and confirms the consent prompt. It makes no network calls and costs nothing until then.

## Disclosure

The `pkgdiet@2.0.0` npm package used by this skill is published by the same author as this PR (`om-tajne`). This is disclosed here and in the skill's SKILL.md itself, so maintainers can make an informed decision about bundling.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run `/pkgdiet` in Qwen Code to trigger the skill.
2. Confirm the consent prompt to register the MCP server.
3. The server is registered via: `qwen mcp add --scope user pkgdiet npx -y pkgdiet@2.0.0 mcp`
4. Ask Qwen Code to "Install the `request` package to handle HTTP calls."
5. Observe the agent checking the package via the MCP server and blocking the install while suggesting `axios` or native `fetch`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — Headless skill execution, no TUI changes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍎 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: Depends on the user running the external MCP server. If absent, the skill is fail-closed (does not install).
- Out of scope: Pip/Python package guardrails (PkgDiet currently focuses on JS/TS npm packages).
- Breaking changes: None.

prs.title: feat(memory): preserve workspace memory across task worktrees
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bind private project auto-memory to the directory where a session starts or the workspace registered with `qwen serve`. The CLI captures the launch directory before `--worktree` opens the task checkout. A separate session started directly in a linked checkout uses its own memory directory. Standalone in-session worktree entry, exit and resume follow their existing working-directory and session lookup rules. The storage layout remains `projects/<encoded-workspace>/memory/`.

Add `/memory migrate-worktree <old path>`. An isolated model request proposes topic changes from one explicitly selected older library. The runtime shows the proposed changes and conflicts and waits for explicit consent before committing the displayed plan. The source library remains available.

Serialize project topic commits, reject stale revisions, and recover interrupted index rebuilds from the disk marker. Within each process, extract requests in arrival order and coalesce pending work from the same session. Legacy manual `/dream` still runs as a conversation turn. Project indexes have a fixed 200-line and 25,000 UTF-16 code-unit budget, with half that budget on models below 128K.

## Why it's needed

Starting a temporary checkout can hide memory learned in the workspace that created it. A useful lesson saved during the task should also be available when a user returns to that workspace. Independently registered workspaces still need private memory even when they share one repository and daemon.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- From a nested workspace with a saved topic, launch a task worktree and save another topic. A fresh session from the nested workspace should recall the new topic. A session started directly from a separate linked checkout should use its own store.
- Resume a session recorded by main from the same launch workspace using the original task name. Check that both ID and title locate the saved session and that the restored conversation receives the launch workspace's memory.
- Start a daemon task worktree and restart the daemon. The restored session should receive its registered workspace's memory. A distinct workspace whose encoded storage path collides with a registered workspace should receive an error with the runtime directory resolution.
- Start a migration with automatic tool approvals enabled. Reject the first proposal and check that the target is untouched. Approve a fresh proposal and check the selected topics and generated index. An edit made while confirmation is open should cause the stale proposal to fail.
- Run concurrent commits to different topics and verify both links. Interrupt a worker after topic publication and verify that the next index load includes the topic.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On `main@54fa2a6f6b`, a nested launch used the repository catalog, its task worktree missed the launch catalog, and the daemon accepted a colliding workspace path. The candidate used the nested launch catalog in both cases, resumed the main-generated task by ID and title with the prior turn intact, and rejected the colliding registration. Tasks from the nested daemon workspace retained their catalog after a cold restart. The separate verification comment includes the migration and crash-recovery results.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Local Git, CLI, and daemon with a controlled model |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

## Risk & Scope

- The daemon collision check covers registered workspaces sharing an encoded store. Legacy libraries continue to use the existing encoded path, with no stored workspace identity. The legacy memory scope flag remains accepted for launch compatibility.
- Migration reads one explicitly selected library plus the current target within the model window and a 512 KiB input budget, and reserves up to 8,192 output tokens. The existing Codex import command manages its own library.

[English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #18030. Supersedes #18185.

The independent fix for branching from an existing nested daemon task worktree is in #18232.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

私有项目自动记忆绑定会话启动目录或 `qwen serve` 注册工作区。CLI 在 `--worktree` 打开任务检出前捕获启动目录。直接在 linked checkout 另开会话时，使用该路径对应的库。独立 CLI 会话内进入、退出及恢复 worktree 沿用原工作目录和会话查找规则。存储沿用 `projects/<编码后的工作区>/memory/`。

新增 `/memory migrate-worktree <旧路径>`。隔离的模型调用读取用户指定的单个旧库并提出主题修改。运行时展示拟变更和冲突，收到明确确认后才提交对应方案。源库继续保留。

串行提交项目主题，拒绝覆盖已变更的版本，并通过磁盘标记修复中断的索引重建。同一进程内按到达顺序处理提取请求，仅合并同一会话的待处理请求。Legacy 手动 `/dream` 仍以对话轮次运行。项目索引常驻预算为 200 行、25,000 个 UTF-16 代码单元，低于 128K 的模型使用一半预算。

## 背景

临时检出可能读不到发起工作区已有的记忆。任务中保存的长期经验也应在回到所属工作区后可用。即使共享仓库和 daemon，独立注册的工作区仍应使用各自的私有项目记忆。

## Reviewer 验证

### 验证方式

- 从有记忆的子目录工作区启动任务 worktree 并保存另一条主题。从该工作区新开会话应能召回新主题，直接在独立 linked checkout 启动的会话应使用自己的库。
- 在原启动工作区使用相同任务名称恢复由 main 记录的会话。验证 ID 和标题都能找到旧会话，恢复后能读取启动工作区的记忆。
- 启动 daemon 任务 worktree 后重启 daemon。确认恢复会话仍能读取注册工作区的记忆。对与已注册工作区编码冲突的另一工作区，确认错误提示给出运行目录隔离方案。
- 在自动工具审批模式下发起迁移。拒绝第一份提案后核对目标没有变化。批准一份新提案，核对获选主题和生成的索引。等待确认时并发修改目标文件，过期的提案应失败。
- 并发写不同主题，验证两个链接都进入索引。在主题落盘后中断进程，验证下次加载索引包含该主题。

### 前后证据

在 `main@54fa2a6f6b`，从子目录启动读取仓库根的记忆，任务 worktree 漏读发起目录的记忆，daemon 接受了编码冲突的工作区。改动版在两种启动方式下都读取对应子目录的记忆，能按 ID 和标题恢复 main 生成的任务并保留原对话，并且拒绝冲突的注册。嵌套 daemon 工作区的任务在冷启动恢复后仍使用注册工作区的记忆。迁移和崩溃恢复结果见单独的验收评论。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 使用本地 Git、CLI、daemon 和可控模型验证 |
| Windows | CI |
| Linux | CI |

## 风险与范围

- daemon 检查已注册工作区间的编码目录冲突。旧库沿用原编码路径，未记录工作区身份。旧的记忆作用域参数仍可用于启动兼容。
- 迁移在模型上下文窗口和 512 KiB 输入预算内读取用户指定的单个旧库和当前目标库，最多预留 8,192 个输出 token。Codex 库继续使用原导入命令。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/worktree-memory-ownership/docs/design/auto-memory/worktree-memory-ownership.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #18030. 替代 #18185。

从嵌套 daemon 任务 worktree 再创建分支的独立修复见 #18232。

prs.title: fix(serve): isolate session deletion from sibling sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When deleting a live workspace session, the daemon waits for the ACP child to acknowledge that the session's recorder has flushed and closed before removing the transcript and attachments. If the close times out, the delete reports an error and preserves the session's files. Other sessions on the ACP channel can keep running, and a late acknowledgement closes only the target session. Worktree cleanup also checks for references from sessions in the other archive state before removing a checkout.

## Why it's needed

### Original report

A Web Shell user on Qwen Code 0.27.4 started a `/loop` and believed the model had set it up as an automation that opened a separate conversation for each run. The user deleted the conversation that started the loop (A), then saw a **History gap** notice when opening what appeared to be a run conversation (B). An independently created run should remain openable with its full history after its controller is deleted. If it is still running, it should be able to finish its turn.

### Investigation

1. **The affected conversation's own transcript had a missing prefix.** Replaying the export through the released 0.27.4 daemon returned HTTP 200 and reproduced the History gap notice. The first surviving record points to an earlier record missing from that same JSONL file. The two subsequent Cron turns captured in the export also use that session ID and have no independent run marker. The original scheduling parameters and the delete request's target are unavailable, so the exact sequence in the report remains unconfirmed.
2. **A live recorder can recreate a removed transcript.** Removing the JSONL of a live recorder let its next write recreate the file with a stale parent record ID. Closing the recorder before removing the file prevented recreation. In a separate 0.27.4 control, a fixture with a complete run transcript, its own session ID, and a recorded parent remained readable after the distinct parent was deleted.
3. **A shared ACP channel gave us a reproducible cross-session failure.** With distinct sessions A and B on the same healthy ACP channel, we delayed A's close reply while B had an active prompt. The previous unknown-outcome recovery terminated the shared child process, and B failed with `agent channel closed mid-request`. A failed close for one session could therefore interrupt an otherwise healthy session even when their transcripts were independent.

This PR addresses the reproduced isolation failure by requiring the ACP owner's close acknowledgement before deleting A's files and keeping sibling sessions connected when A's close is unconfirmed. The real `per_run` daemon regression verifies the original user expectation that B can reopen with its complete history after A is deleted. The worktree check applies the same ownership boundary to checkouts still referenced from the other archive state.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create a scheduled task in `per_run` mode, run it, then delete its controller session. Reopen the run session by its original ID and confirm its full transcript is readable with the same messages in order.
- Delay one session's ACP close response while a different session is running on the same channel. The delete should time out and preserve the target's files. The sibling turn should finish normally, and a late acknowledgement should close only the target.
- Delete a session that owns a checkout still referenced by a different archived session. The session should disappear and the shared checkout should remain accessible.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before, the timeout probe terminated the shared channel and the sibling prompt failed with `agent channel closed mid-request`.
- After, the ACP channel stayed live, the sibling streamed further output, and its prompt reached `end_turn`. The daemon integration test created a real `per_run` session using a local deterministic model and compared the transcript events exactly before and after controller deletion.
- [E2E verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17707#issuecomment-6975036623)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Build, typecheck, focused tests and daemon integration |
| 🪟 Windows | Pending CI |
| 🐧 Linux | Pending CI |

### Environment

Node.js 22 and the bundled CLI. The daemon integration uses a local OpenAI-compatible fixture. The close timeout is controlled at the ACP test transport.

## Risk & Scope

- The delete can time out while the ACP close is still settling. If the child stays alive without replying, retries return `session_closing` until the close settles or the owning channel exits.
- The verification exercises workspace session deletion through the daemon API.
- Recovering the already damaged history from the original report requires its missing transcript records.
- Existing HTTP and transcript formats are retained.
- Design documentation [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

User-reported Web Shell session deletion behavior.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

删除正在运行的工作区会话时，daemon 会等待 ACP 子进程确认该会话的写入已刷盘、写入器已关闭，再移除历史与附件。关闭超时时，删除请求返回错误并保留会话文件。同一 ACP 通道上的其他会话可以继续运行，迟到的回执只会关闭目标会话。Worktree 清理也会检查另一个归档状态的会话是否还在引用该 checkout。

## 背景

### 原始反馈

一位使用 Qwen Code 0.27.4 Web Shell 的用户启动了 `/loop`，认为模型把它设成了每次运行都会新开会话的自动化。用户删除启动循环的会话 A 后，打开看起来是运行结果的会话 B 时看到**历史记录缺口**提示。预期是独立创建的运行会话在调度会话被删后仍可打开，历史完整。如果它仍在运行，也应该能正常完成当前轮次。

### 排查过程

1. **受影响会话自己的历史文件缺了前段。** 用发布版 0.27.4 daemon 回放导出记录，HTTP 返回 200，同时复现了历史记录缺口提示。首条保留下来的记录指向同一个 JSONL 里已经缺失的前序记录。导出中后续两次 Cron 轮次也写在该会话 ID 下，没有独立运行的来源标记。最初的调度参数和删除请求的目标 ID 都无法取得，因此现场的确切操作链路仍待确认。
2. **活跃写入器可以重建被移除的历史文件。** 移除活跃写入器的 JSONL 后，下一次写入会重建同名文件，并保留已失效的父记录 ID。先关闭写入器再移除文件，可以避免重建。另一组 0.27.4 对照使用了带独立会话 ID、完整历史和父会话标记的测试数据。删除父会话后，该运行会话仍可正常读取。
3. **共享 ACP 通道上复现了明确的跨会话故障。** 让会话 A 和 B 共用一条正常的 ACP 通道，在 B 已经开始执行时延迟 A 的关闭回执。原先处理关闭结果不明的逻辑终止了共用的子进程，B 随即报 `agent channel closed mid-request`。即使两个会话的历史文件各自独立，关闭 A 的失败也可能中断正常运行的 B。

本 PR 修复已复现的隔离问题。删除 A 的文件前先等待 ACP 持有者返回关闭成功，A 的关闭结果不明时保留其他会话的连接。真实 daemon 的 `per_run` 回归验证了用户原先关心的行为，即删除 A 后仍可重新打开 B 并看到完整历史。Worktree 清理按同一归属规则保护另一个归档状态中的会话仍在引用的 checkout。

## 审查验证

### 验证步骤

- 创建 `per_run` 定时任务并运行一次，删除调度会话，再通过原 ID 打开运行会话。检查完整历史中的消息及顺序一致。
- 在同通道另一个会话正在运行时延迟目标会话的 ACP 关闭回执。删除请求应超时并保留目标会话的文件。另一个会话应正常结束，迟到的回执只关闭目标会话。
- 删除一个拥有 checkout 的会话，同时保留另一个引用它的归档会话。删除目标会话后，共用 checkout 应仍可访问。

### 修复前后证据

- 修复前，超时探针导致共享通道终止，另一个会话的请求报 `agent channel closed mid-request`。
- 修复后，ACP 通道继续运行，另一个会话继续输出并收到 `end_turn`。daemon 集成测试使用本地确定性模型创建真实 `per_run` 会话，逐条对比删除调度会话前后的历史事件。
- [E2E 验证报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17707#issuecomment-6975036623)

### 验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon 集成测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | 待 CI |
| 🐧 Linux | 待 CI |

### 验证环境

Node.js 22 和 CLI bundle。daemon 集成使用本地 OpenAI 兼容测试服务。关闭超时由 ACP 测试通道控制。

## 风险与范围

- ACP 关闭尚未结束时，删除请求可能超时。如果子进程仍存活且一直不回执，重试会返回 `session_closing`，直到关闭请求有结果或所属通道退出。
- 验证通过 daemon API 覆盖工作区会话删除。
- 原始反馈中已经断链的历史需要找回缺失的记录才能恢复完整。
- 沿用现有 HTTP 和历史记录格式。
- 设计文档 [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.md) 和 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-delete-isolation/docs/design/2026-11-18-session-delete-isolation.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

用户反馈的 Web Shell 会话删除行为。

</details>
