prs.title: fix(core): count the pending message once after compaction and keep the output floor (#15486)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

After an automatic compaction that runs while a message is still pending, the estimate for the next request now counts that message once, and the output budget no longer drops to one token for a prompt that fits.

- Compaction is given the prompt size without this send's pending content, which is what the compression step already documents. The send path computes the same estimate with and without the pending content and passes both, so the two cancel exactly, including a memory snapshot sent with the message. The compacted count is then the compacted history and its fixed overhead, and the pre-send guard and the output budget each add the pending content once. The compaction trigger still reads the full estimate, pending content included, so compaction starts no later than before. Both branches of the cold accounting, with and without the retained tail from #17141, then leave the pending message out.
- The compression records keep counting the pending message, at both places that write one (the automatic compaction and the deferred hard-tier record). Their snapshot stores that message, and resume seeds its count from the record. The record adds the turn as the request after compaction carries it, which is what resume replays: with the memory snapshot the send attaches (the compacted history no longer holds one), and without a replayed snapshot the request strips when there is no catalog. Without a memory snapshot in play the persisted numbers stay exactly as they are today. The add-back goes into a new record payload only: the count the chat adopts after compaction and the live "compressed" event keep the count without the pending message.
- The 20K overhead pad still shrinks every output budget, but it no longer caps the 4,000-token floor when the estimate already starts from a count. On the first send only an estimated count is padded, so this applies to a positive estimated count, such as a compacted count. Fresh sessions (count 0), whose estimate really misses the instructions and tool definitions, keep today's behaviour, a provider count is not padded and is unchanged, and every budget at or above the floor is unchanged. A recovery send after a truncated reply pads its history walk whatever the count is; there the floor is capped by the count-based estimate, from the provider or from compaction, when that estimate covers the walk. This also covers the continuation after `MAX_TOKENS` on a 32,768-token window that was reported on the issue; usage that really fills the window still gets 1. A recovery send also takes its ceiling from before the first send's window clamp, so a fresh session whose first grant the pad squeezed (320 tokens in an end-to-end run) still gets the floor on its continuation. A comment on the issue suggested keeping this continuation fix separate. It stays here because it is the same floor rule, and without it a small window still gets `max_tokens: 1` on the continuation. The stale-usage case raised there keeps the padded cap and has a test of its own; the existing missing-usage test does not fail when that check is dropped.
- This deliberately relaxes the #5950 invariant (`prompt + max_tokens ≤ window`) for count-based estimates: it now holds against the unpadded estimate rather than the padded one. The design doc records the decision and its residual risk, and the comments on the window clamp in `tokenLimits.ts` say the same. The window clamp has no design doc of its own under `docs/design/`, so there is no separate document to update.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #15486. The pending message, often a large tool result, stayed inside the compacted count and was added again before the next request, and every compaction also left an estimated count padded by 20K. Depending on which check read the estimate, the turn was stopped with "Context is too large to send safely after automatic compression … compression status: COMPRESSED" although compaction had succeeded and the prompt fitted, or the request went out with `max_tokens: 1` and ended with "Model stream ended after a tool result without visible progress". The pad alone does this on small windows: on a 32,768-token window the window minus the pad leaves 12,768 tokens, so any post-compaction estimate above that gets `max_tokens: 1` even once the double count is fixed, and on a 16K window it happens after any compaction.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use an OpenAI-compatible provider, or a local mock, that rejects any request whose prompt plus `max_tokens` exceeds its window, and log the requests it receives.

- Hard-tier compaction with a pending result: set a 64K window and read two large files so that the second read crosses the hard tier. Before: compaction reports success and the turn stops with "Context is too large". After: the request is sent and the turn completes.
- Small window: set a 16K window, build a short session, run `/compress` with restored files turned off (`QWEN_COMPACT_MAX_RECENT_FILES=0`) and ask a follow-up. Before: the follow-up goes out with `max_tokens: 1`. After: it goes out with 4,000 and still fits the window.
- Fresh session: a first message on a 32K window gets the same `max_tokens` before and after.

### Evidence (Before & After)

These runs were made on 2026-10-25, with this branch on `main` at `7afa0bab88`; Before is that `main` and After is this branch, both built locally. The branch has since been rebased onto current `main` without changes to the fix's logic. A rerun on the current head, with a continuation case added, is in a comment below. Current `main` includes the retained tail from #17141, which these runs predate; the unit tests below cover both of its branches. The window scenarios ran against a mock that counts a quarter token per character and rejects any request whose prompt plus `max_tokens` exceeds the window. The last row used a real provider.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 64K window, hard-tier compaction with a 20K-token result pending | Compacted, then stopped: estimate 49,620 against a hard limit of 41,000, "Context is too large … COMPRESSED" | Estimate 29,604; sent with `max_tokens` 4,000; completed |
| 20K window, `/compress`, then a follow-up in the resumed session | `max_tokens: 1` | `max_tokens` 4,000, prompt 16,473; completed |
| 16K window, same | `max_tokens: 1` | `max_tokens` 4,000. The prompt was 12,639, because the resume re-adds about 3K tokens of startup context that the count does not include, so the request overflowed by 639. The existing overflow recovery compacted and the retry completed. |
| 32K window, fresh session | `max_tokens` 1,406 | `max_tokens` 1,406 (unchanged) |
| Compression record counts, 64K auto tier with a pending result | 40,410 → 19,604 | 40,410 → 19,604 (unchanged) |
| Real provider, 262,144-token window, a 93.5K-token file read pending at the auto tier | Count after compaction 120,515; next request `max_tokens: 1` five times; "Model stream ended after a tool result without visible progress" | Count 33,775; `max_tokens` 55,412; completed |

Unit tests, on current `main`: the double count is reproduced end to end through the real compression step, for a pending tool result and pending text on both accounting paths, and to the exact count on both branches of the cold path, with and without a retained tail. Other tests pin the baseline with a memory snapshot, the compaction trigger still reading the full estimate, both compression records counting the message while the adopted count and the live event do not, the floor on a small window after compaction and on recovery sends (including fresh usage on a 32,768-token window, where usage that fills the window still gets 1), and fresh sessions left unchanged. Each decision was also checked by undoing it: 14 hand-written mutants (the record add-back, the adopted count, the gate input, the floor's scope on the first send and on recovery sends, either cold-path branch, the baseline itself) each make at least one of these tests fail. Round one of review added tests for the records with a fresh, a dropped and a stripped memory snapshot on both paths, and for the recovery check with a positive count below the walk and with a count equal to it; five more mutants (each record path back to the raw message, the auto record on the pre-compaction effective count minus the baseline, the check as `>` or `> 0`) each fail one of them. A recovery send's ceiling has tests for a fresh session whose first grant the pad squeezed, with and without a caller's ceiling below the floor; three mutants (back to the first grant, always the request's ceiling, always the escalation ceiling) each fail a test. Round two added tests for the fallback that takes only the effective count, with a memory catalog and at its zero clamp, and for the baseline on a first send with no count; three more mutants (the fallback subtracting the bare message, the fallback without its zero clamp, the send-path baseline keeping the pending content) each fail at least one.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local mock provider for the window scenarios; OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b` (262,144-token endpoints) for the real-provider run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the relaxed #5950 invariant. When a count-based estimate misses some overhead, for example a compacted count whose baseline was itself a fresh walk, or a resume seeded from an estimate, the floor can exceed the room really left. Only a real prompt above the window minus 4,000 tokens is affected, inside a band at most 4,000 tokens wide; the provider then rejects the request as a context overflow, and the existing reactive overflow recovery compacts and retries. Before this change the same case sent `max_tokens: 1`, and the turn ended without output. A recovery send after a truncated reply relaxes the floor only when the count-based estimate covers the history walk; a count that went stale by less than the overhead it carries can still pass, and that send can exceed the window by at most 4,000 tokens. The recovery loop does not compact on that rejection: it rolls the send back and the reply ends with the text written so far, where before the send got a smaller padded floor, often 1 on a small window. After an automatic compaction with a pending message, the "Context compressed (A -> B)" banner and the compression telemetry show both numbers without the pending message, and the ACP session count leaves it out until the next response reports usage. Escalation after a truncated reply stays off where the floor lifts the budget, as today.
- Not validated / out of scope: the mock and real-provider runs predate the current base and #17141's retained tail (covered by unit tests only); dropping the pad for provider-anchored counts (raises budgets above the floor too; a separate decision); the restoration budget after compaction (#15487); sizing the compression request itself (#14953). Windows and Linux are covered by CI only.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Compression records keep their format; their counts differ from today's only when a memory snapshot rides along, and then they match what resume replays.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/15486-post-compaction-count/docs/design/2026-10-25-post-compaction-prompt-count.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/15486-post-compaction-count/docs/design/2026-10-25-post-compaction-prompt-count.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15486

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 这个 PR 做了什么

如果自动压缩运行时还有一条消息没发出去，压缩后下一次请求的估算现在只计算这条消息一次；放得下的 prompt 也不会再被压到只有一个 token 的输出空间。

- 交给压缩的是不含本次待处理内容的 prompt 大小，这本来就是压缩步骤说明里写的含义。发送路径对同一个估算分别算出含与不含待处理内容的两个值并都传入，所以能精确抵消，随消息一起发送的记忆快照也包括在内。这样，压缩后的计数就是压缩后的历史及其固定开销，发送前的检查和输出预算各自只加一次待处理内容。压缩的触发条件仍然读取包含待处理内容的完整估算，所以压缩不会比以前触发得晚。冷路径计数的两个分支（有和没有 #17141 引入的保留尾部）都因此不再包含待处理消息。
- 压缩记录仍然计入这条待处理消息，两处写记录的地方（自动压缩和延后写入的 hard 档记录）都是如此：记录的快照里存着它，恢复会话时又从记录里取起始计数。记录加回的是压缩后那次请求实际携带的这条消息，也就是恢复时回放的内容：包括发送时附上的记忆快照（压缩后的历史里已经没有快照了），不包括没有记忆目录时请求去掉的重放快照。不涉及记忆快照时，持久化的数字和现在完全一样。加回只写进一份新的记录内容：压缩后聊天对象采用的计数和实时的“已压缩”事件，都保持不含待处理消息的计数。
- 20K 的固定开销余量照样会压缩每一个输出预算，但当估算已经从某个计数出发时，它不再压低 4,000 token 的保底。首次发送时只有估算计数才加余量，所以这一条只作用于为正的估算计数，比如压缩后的计数。新会话（计数为 0）的估算确实漏掉了系统指令和工具定义，保持现有行为；provider 计数不加余量，也不变；所有达到或高于保底的输出预算都不变。回复被截断后的恢复重试，无论计数如何都会给历史遍历加余量；在那里，只要基于计数的估算（来自 provider 或来自压缩）覆盖了遍历结果，就用它给保底封顶。这也覆盖了 issue 中报告的 32,768 token 窗口上 `MAX_TOKENS` 之后的续写；用量真的占满窗口时仍然是 1。恢复重试的上限也改为第一次发送按窗口夹之前的上限，所以新会话的第一次发送即使被余量压小（一次端到端运行中是 320），续写也能拿到保底。issue 上有评论建议把这处续写的修复单独拆开。这里没有拆，因为它用的是同一条保底规则；不改它，小窗口上的续写仍会拿到 `max_tokens: 1`。评论中提到的用量过期情况保留带余量的封顶，并有专门的测试；原有的缺失用量测试在去掉这个判断时并不会失败。
- 这有意对基于计数的估算放宽了 #5950 的不变量（`prompt + max_tokens ≤ window`）：它现在针对不带余量的估算成立，而不是带余量的估算。设计文档记录了这个决定及其残余风险，`tokenLimits.ts` 中窗口夹制的注释也写明了同样的内容。窗口夹制在 `docs/design/` 下没有单独的设计文档，所以没有另外的文档需要更新。

### 为什么需要

见 #15486。待处理消息（常常是一个很大的工具结果）留在了压缩后的计数里，下一次请求前又被加了一次；而且每次压缩后得到的估算计数还会再加 20K 余量。取决于哪个检查读到这个估算：要么在压缩已经成功、prompt 也放得下的情况下，回合被拦下并提示 “Context is too large to send safely after automatic compression … compression status: COMPRESSED”；要么请求以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出，最后报 “Model stream ended after a tool result without visible progress”。光是余量就会在小窗口上造成这种情况：在 32,768 token 的窗口上，窗口减去余量只剩 12,768 token，即使修掉了重复计数，任何超过这个数的压缩后估算都会拿到 `max_tokens: 1`；在 16K 窗口上，任何一次压缩之后都会这样。

### 验证方法

使用一个会拒绝 prompt 加 `max_tokens` 超过窗口的 OpenAI 兼容 provider 或本地 mock，并记录它收到的请求。

- 有待处理结果时的 hard 档压缩：窗口设为 64K，读取两个大文件，让第二次读取越过 hard 阈值。修改前：压缩报告成功，回合却以 “Context is too large” 终止。修改后：请求正常发出，回合完成。
- 小窗口：窗口设为 16K，建立一个较短的会话，在关闭文件恢复（`QWEN_COMPACT_MAX_RECENT_FILES=0`）的情况下执行 `/compress`，然后追问。修改前：追问以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出。修改后：以 4,000 发出，并且仍在窗口之内。
- 新会话：32K 窗口上的第一条消息，修改前后的 `max_tokens` 相同。

### 证据（修改前后）

这些运行做于 2026-10-25，当时本分支基于 `main` 的 `7afa0bab88`；修改前是那个 `main`，修改后是本分支，两者都在本地构建。此后本分支 rebase 到了当前的 `main`，修复的逻辑没有变化。在当前 head 上的重跑（另加了一个续写场景）见下方评论。当前的 `main` 包含 #17141 引入的保留尾部，这些运行早于它；下面的单元测试覆盖了它的两个分支。窗口相关场景使用的 mock 按每字符四分之一个 token 计数，并拒绝 prompt 加 `max_tokens` 超过窗口的请求；最后一行使用真实 provider。

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 64K 窗口，hard 档压缩，有一个 20K token 的待处理结果 | 压缩成功后被拦下：估算 49,620，超过 41,000 的 hard 阈值，提示 “Context is too large … COMPRESSED” | 估算 29,604；以 `max_tokens` 4,000 发出；完成 |
| 20K 窗口，`/compress` 后在恢复的会话里追问 | `max_tokens: 1` | `max_tokens` 4,000，prompt 16,473；完成 |
| 16K 窗口，同上 | `max_tokens: 1` | `max_tokens` 4,000。prompt 为 12,639：恢复会话时会重新加入约 3K token 的启动上下文，而计数里没有这部分，所以请求超出窗口 639。现有的溢出恢复做了压缩，重试后完成。 |
| 32K 窗口，新会话 | `max_tokens` 1,406 | `max_tokens` 1,406（不变） |
| 压缩记录里的计数，64K 窗口 auto 档，有待处理结果 | 40,410 → 19,604 | 40,410 → 19,604（不变） |
| 真实 provider，262,144 token 窗口，auto 档时有一个 93.5K token 的文件读取结果待处理 | 压缩后计数 120,515；下一个请求连续 5 次 `max_tokens: 1`；报 “Model stream ended after a tool result without visible progress” | 计数 33,775；`max_tokens` 55,412；完成 |

单元测试（基于当前的 `main`）：通过真实的压缩步骤端到端复现了重复计数，待处理消息为工具结果和纯文本两种情况，两条计数路径都覆盖；冷路径的两个分支（有和没有保留尾部）都精确核对到具体计数。其他测试钉住了：带记忆快照的基线；压缩触发条件仍读取完整估算；两处压缩记录计入待处理消息，而聊天对象采用的计数和实时事件不计入；压缩后小窗口上的保底和恢复重试的保底（包括 32,768 token 窗口上带新鲜用量的情况，用量占满窗口时仍是 1）；以及新会话保持不变。每项决定还通过撤销它来检查：14 个手写变异（记录加回、采用的计数、触发门的输入、首次发送和恢复重试时保底的适用范围、冷路径的任一分支、基线本身）每个都至少让一个测试失败。第一轮评审后又补了测试：两条记录路径上分别覆盖新附的、被压缩删掉后又补发的、以及被请求去掉的记忆快照；恢复重试的判断覆盖计数为正但小于遍历结果、以及两者相等的情况。另外 5 个变异（任一条记录路径改回原始消息；自动压缩的记录改用压缩前的有效计数减基线；判断写成 `>` 或 `> 0`）各自都会让其中一个测试失败。恢复重试的上限也有测试：新会话第一次发送的值被余量压小时，分有和没有低于保底的调用方上限两种情况；3 个变异（改回第一次发送的值、一律用请求自己的上限、一律用提升的上限）各自都会让某个测试失败。第二轮评审后又补了测试：只传有效计数的后备路径在带记忆目录时、以及结果不小于 0 的情况；计数为 0 的首次发送的基线。另外 3 个变异（后备路径只减原始消息；后备路径去掉不小于 0 的限制；发送路径的基线保留待处理内容）各自都至少让一个测试失败。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows、Linux ⚠️ 仅由 CI 覆盖。

### 环境

窗口相关场景使用本地 mock provider；真实 provider 使用 OpenRouter `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`（262,144 token 的端点）。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：放宽后的 #5950 不变量。基于计数的估算漏掉部分开销时，比如压缩后的计数，其基线本身来自新会话的历史遍历；或者恢复时用的是估算值，保底可能超过实际剩余的空间。受影响的只有真实 prompt 超过“窗口 − 4,000 token”的情况，在一个最宽 4,000 token 的区间内；这时 provider 会以上下文溢出拒绝请求，由既有的被动溢出恢复压缩后重试。修改之前，同样的情况会以 `max_tokens: 1` 发出，回合没有任何输出就结束。回复被截断后的恢复重试，只有基于计数的估算覆盖了历史遍历结果时才放宽保底；比所含开销漏得更少的过期计数仍可能通过，这次发送最多超出窗口 4,000 token。恢复循环遇到这种拒绝时不做压缩：它撤销这次发送，回复停在已经写出的内容；而修改之前，这次发送拿到的是更小的带余量保底，在小窗口上常常是 1。带待处理消息的自动压缩之后，“Context compressed (A -> B)” 提示和压缩遥测里的两个数都不再含待处理消息；ACP 的会话计数在下一次回复带回用量之前也不含它。保底抬高输出预算时，截断后的提升仍不会触发，和现在一样。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：mock 和真实 provider 的运行早于当前的基线和 #17141 的保留尾部（只由单元测试覆盖）；对锚定在 provider 计数上的估算直接去掉余量（会连保底以上的预算一起提高，属于单独的决定）；压缩后的文件恢复预算（#15487）；压缩请求本身的大小（#14953）。Windows 和 Linux 只由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。压缩记录的格式不变；只有涉及记忆快照时计数才和现在不同，这时它与恢复时回放的内容一致。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/15486-post-compaction-count/docs/design/2026-10-25-post-compaction-prompt-count.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/yanyukang2003-ux/qwen-code/blob/fix/15486-post-compaction-count/docs/design/2026-10-25-post-compaction-prompt-count.zh-CN.md)

### 关联 Issue

Fixes #15486

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): deliver SubagentStart context to initial prompts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Delivers `SubagentStart.additionalContext` to the initial user prompt for foreground agents, background agents, forks, and cold background resume. Existing `hook_context` interpolation remains available for system prompts. Shared helpers keep the append behavior consistent, and prompt-bound context is capped at the established 10,000-character limit.

## Why it's needed

SubagentStart hooks could execute successfully and return `additionalContext`, yet the initial subagent only received the original task. The context was stored in `hook_context` but was not appended to `task_prompt` on initial launch paths. As a result, hook-provided instructions never reached the model unless a custom system prompt explicitly interpolated them.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused core suites:

```bash
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/tools/agent/agent.test.ts src/agents/background-agent-resume.test.ts
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core run typecheck
```

Confirm coverage of foreground, background, fork, and cold-resume launches. The tests assert that the original task is preserved and followed by exactly two newlines and the hook context. A key-aware fake distinguishes `task_prompt` from `hook_context`. A separate case verifies the 10,000-character cap.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new foreground, background, and cold-resume tests failed because `task_prompt` contained only the original task. The over-cap test also failed because the complete hook context was appended.

After: all 524 tests in the two suites pass. TypeScript typecheck, Prettier, and ESLint pass. Mutation checks also behaved as intended: reading the wrong context key turned the three launch tests red, and removing the shared helpers' `task_prompt` write turned all four path tests red.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

WSL2, Node.js 22.22.3, pnpm 10.26.2 via Corepack. Unit tests and static checks only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: initial subagent prompts now include non-empty hook context. Prompt-bound context is capped at 10,000 characters to avoid unbounded context growth.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full root prepare build did not complete locally because the CLI build was killed with status 137. Hook deny/error semantics and external ACP executors are unchanged. macOS and Windows were not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The change is additive and requires no migration.

## Linked Issues

N/A — no tracking issue was filed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

将 `SubagentStart.additionalContext` 传递到前台代理、后台代理、fork 以及冷后台恢复的初始用户 prompt。现有 `hook_context` 插值仍可用于系统 prompt。共享辅助函数保持各处拼接行为一致，写入 prompt 的上下文采用既有的 10,000 字符上限。

## Why it's needed

SubagentStart 钩子此前可以成功执行并返回 `additionalContext`，但初始子代理仍只收到原始任务。上下文虽保存到 `hook_context`，却没有在初始启动路径中追加到 `task_prompt`。因此，除非自定义系统 prompt 显式插值，否则钩子提供的指令无法到达模型。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

运行针对性的 core 测试套件：

```bash
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run src/tools/agent/agent.test.ts src/agents/background-agent-resume.test.ts
corepack pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core run typecheck
```

确认覆盖前台、后台、fork 和冷恢复启动。测试会验证原始任务保持不变，其后恰好添加两个换行和钩子上下文。可区分键名的测试替身能够区分 `task_prompt` 与 `hook_context`。另一个用例验证 10,000 字符上限。

### Evidence (Before & After)

修复前：新增的前台、后台和冷恢复测试失败，因为 `task_prompt` 只包含原始任务。超上限测试也失败，因为完整钩子上下文被直接追加。

修复后：两个测试套件中的全部 524 个测试通过。TypeScript 类型检查、Prettier 和 ESLint 均通过。变异检查也符合预期：读取错误的上下文键会使三个启动测试失败；删除共享辅助函数对 `task_prompt` 的写入会使全部四个路径测试失败。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |

prs.title: fix(web-shell): show skill names in slash menu and highlight owning extension in details
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extension Skill entries in the slash completion menu and the `/skills <query>` subcommand list now display the short Skill name. Search matches the full qualified name, and selection uses that name in the command. Hovering a Skill entry shows its owning Extension inside the details tooltip, including for Extension Skills without a description. Within the tooltip, the owning Extension has an icon, a muted label, a bordered monospace badge, and a divider when a description follows.

## Why it's needed

Showing the full `extension:skill` prefix inside the slash menu crowds out the Skill name, argument hint, and description when extension names are long. Previously, the hover tooltip also rendered the Extension line with the exact same typography, color, and spacing as the description text, making it hard to distinguish at a glance.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a daemon-backed Web Shell session with an Extension Skill, type `/` to open slash suggestions. Confirm the row shows only the Skill name and selecting it inserts the complete qualified `/extension:skill` command into the composer. Repeat with `/skills <query>` and confirm the Skill subcommand row also shows the short name.
2. Hover over the Extension Skill row. Confirm the hover tooltip displays the wrapping Skill title, a clearly distinct owning Extension badge beneath a muted extension label and icon, and a divider separating it from the description text below.
3. Repeat with a light theme and Chinese locale (`zh-CN`), and also hover an Extension Skill that has no description. Confirm the Extension badge remains visually distinct from the description in both dark and light themes, and that a descriptionless Extension Skill still opens the hover tooltip to reveal its owning Extension without a dangling divider.
4. Hover over a standalone Skill (including one containing a colon such as `analysis:report`) and an ordinary plugin command. Confirm their names remain intact in both the menu and the hover tooltip, with no Extension row shown.
5. Open a new session before sending a first prompt and type `/`. Confirm the workspace Skill catalog displays the same Skill-only row and highlighted Extension tooltip without creating a session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Before (Dark, Live Session) | After (Dark, Live Session) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: slash menu shows extension:skill and tooltip extension blends into description](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/2213c3707ddc97eff3272b3d9ac2001342cd89e4/pr-18227/before-dark-en.png) | ![After: slash menu shows skill name only and tooltip highlights owning extension](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/2213c3707ddc97eff3272b3d9ac2001342cd89e4/pr-18227/after-dark-en.png) |

| After (Dark, New Session Workspace Catalog) | After (Light, Simplified Chinese) |
| --- | --- |
| ![After: workspace catalog skill-only row and highlighted extension tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/2213c3707ddc97eff3272b3d9ac2001342cd89e4/pr-18227/after-workspace-dark-en.png) | ![After: light theme Chinese slash menu and styled extension badge tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/callmeYe/qwen-code/2213c3707ddc97eff3272b3d9ac2001342cd89e4/pr-18227/after-light-zh.png) |

The focused rerun passed 340 editor unit tests, 50 slash-completion unit tests, and 2 Chromium Playwright E2E tests covering a live session, the workspace catalog, and a descriptionless Extension Skill. The browser tests cover dark English and light Simplified Chinese. The original verification also passed the full workspace build, typecheck, ESLint (`--max-warnings 0`), and Prettier checks.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

The original verification used Node.js v26.12.1, pnpm 11.24.0, and Chromium. The focused rerun used Node.js v26.7.0 and Playwright 1.61.1. Browser verification runs the real Web Shell UI against mocked daemon HTTP/SSE responses.

## Risk & Scope

- Extension ownership relies on workspace Skill metadata or live-session Skill membership paired with the plugin command source. The menu shows the qualified name when ownership data is unavailable. If two Extensions expose the same short name, hovering reveals the owner, and keyboard and screen-reader users can encounter identical option labels. Typing the Extension name filters the options by qualified name.
- Not validated / out of scope: Compact composer overlays suppress hover tooltips by design and were not changed to add an inline Extension indicator. The touch/mobile command drawer has no hover interaction and keeps full labels.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

User request; no linked issue.

prs.title: feat(core): run the Ink TUI on the event-bus kernel by default
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Ink TUI now runs the shared agent loop on the event-bus kernel by default. To switch back, set `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` or `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0`. A turn cancelled with Esc on the kernel settles within 10 s: a turn still pending then ends as cancelled and late tool results are dropped. This is the Ink TUI's step 4 of #17045: the `ink` entry of the kernel switch's per-surface default table turns on, next to headless's (#18154). The Ink TUI already runs on the shared loop by default (#17362); this moves that loop from its procedural path onto the kernel. ACP, OpenTUI and subagents keep the procedural path, and no shared-loop default changes. It replaces #17540, closed on 11-18, and carries that PR's review fixes.

The setting's description, the settings reference, the VS Code schema, the Web Shell's Chinese and Russian descriptions and the design docs, the capability ledger included, now say that headless and the Ink TUI default to the kernel. A settings test now pins the shipped definition of the setting, no default and a first toggle that writes `true`, so restoring a `false` default fails it.

### Intended differences

The kernel runs the same rounds and batches as the procedural path; the event-bus design's equivalence suite and the TUI parity suite compare the two. An Ink TUI turn on the kernel differs in these intended ways:

- when a turn is cancelled (Esc), the kernel publishes `loop.cancelled` and gives the turn 10 s to settle; a turn still pending then ends as cancelled with no tool results, and late tool progress and results are dropped, where the procedural path waits for every handler without a cap;
- the debug log marks each round on the kernel (`[EVENT_BUS]`), and `/about` and `/bug` report the loop path as `kernel`.

### How to switch back

Either of these keeps the Ink TUI on the procedural path of the shared loop:

- the setting `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` (this turns the kernel off for every surface);
- the environment variable `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0` (the Ink TUI only), or `=0` (every surface).

`"experimental": { "unifiedAgentLoop": false }` still takes the Ink TUI off the shared loop altogether. The procedural path stays until every surface has had its kernel default for 14 days.

## Why it's needed

#17045 turns the kernel on one surface at a time; the Ink TUI is planned for 12-02, after headless. Every step-4 condition holds:

- the Ink TUI runs on the shared loop by default (#17362), and headless's kernel default merged first (#18154);
- the Ink TUI's step 3 (#17160) and #17145 (cancellation through the bus and the bounded close) merged on 11-13;
- the Linux leg that runs the integration tests, the Ink TUI's included, with both settings on has passed every night from 11-14 to 11-22 except two that #17045 does not count: on 11-17 it failed only in a test unrelated to the loop that failed the same way on main with the switches off, and on 11-23 every leg failed, the forced-off one included, because the CI's model key was rejected; its seven nights ended on 11-20;
- the intended differences and the way back are listed above, so the release notes carry them.

The Ink TUI parity failures seen since 11-18 were checked against this change: the teammate scenario's extra request (#18027) comes from the harness's 30 s gate expiring under load, and the missing record in the retry scenario (#16947) most likely from the suite quitting before the last record is written; neither shows the kernel and the shared loop behaving differently.

Of #17540's review: the schema-default pin and the capability ledger are fixed here, and main already dropped the 20-run clause from the event-bus design. The Web Shell still shows an unset switch as off; its sessions run on ACP, whose kernel stays off by default, so that is what they run.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With nothing set, the Ink TUI runs on the kernel: its debug log (`QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`) shows `[LOOP] ink kernel` and the `[EVENT_BUS]` marker, and `/about` reports `kernel`. With `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0`, or `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`, it shows `[LOOP] ink shared`.
- The config tests pin the kernel on by default for headless and the Ink TUI and off for every other surface, both ways back for each, each surface's loop path, and that the shared-loop default does not move with it.

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/components/SettingsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/opentui/dialogs-settings.test.ts src/ui/commands/config-command.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts
cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/i18n.test.ts client/settings.test.ts client/settings
```

Results: on main 6b926f9443, `npm run build` and the typechecks of core, the CLI and the Web Shell are clean; core config (1102), the CLI tests above (1460, 5 skipped: config, the Ink stream hook, both settings dialogs, `/config` and the daemon's settings route) and Web Shell i18n and settings (235) tests pass. With `default: false` restored on the setting, the new pin fails, as it should. The TUI parity suite runs the Ink TUI on the kernel in the nightly Linux kernel leg (26 tests, green every night from 11-14 to 11-22 apart from the two nights above). Linux, Node 22.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: no visible change in the common case; the differences are listed above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, no sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every Ink TUI session moves to the kernel at once. The kernel wraps the same round and batch steps as the procedural path; a regression attributed to it restarts the Ink TUI's wait, and either switch above brings the procedural path back.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other surfaces' kernel defaults; removing the Ink TUI's legacy loop (step 5) and the procedural path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the cancellation cap above; `experimental.eventBusAgentLoop: false` now also keeps the Ink TUI on the procedural path.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #17045 (the Ink TUI's step 4). Replaces #17540.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Ink TUI 现在默认在事件总线内核上运行共享 agent loop。切回方式：设置 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`，或设 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0`。内核上用 Esc 取消的回合在 10 秒内收尾：届时仍未结束的回合以取消结束，迟到的工具结果被丢弃。这是 #17045 中 Ink TUI 的第 4 步：内核开关按入口默认值表中的 `ink` 一项改为开启，与 headless（#18154）并列。Ink TUI 已经默认运行在共享 loop 上（#17362）；本 PR 把这个 loop 从过程式路径移到内核上。ACP、OpenTUI 和子代理保持过程式路径，共享 loop 的默认值都不变。本 PR 取代 11-18 关闭的 #17540，并带上了它评审中要求的修改。

设置说明、设置参考文档、VS Code schema、Web Shell 的中文和俄文说明，以及设计文档（包括能力台账）现在写明 headless 和 Ink TUI 默认使用内核。一个设置测试现在固定了这个设置实际发布的定义：没有默认值，第一次切换写入 `true`；恢复 `false` 默认值会让它失败。

### 有意差异

内核运行的模型轮和工具批与过程式路径相同；事件总线设计的等价测试和 TUI 对拍套件比较两者。Ink TUI 的回合在内核上运行时有以下有意差异：

- 回合被取消（Esc）时，内核发布 `loop.cancelled`，给回合 10 秒收尾；届时仍未结束的回合以取消结束、不带工具结果，迟到的工具进度和结果被丢弃，而过程式路径会无上限地等待每个 handler；
- 调试日志为内核上的每一轮打上标记（`[EVENT_BUS]`），`/about` 和 `/bug` 报告 loop 路径为 `kernel`。

### 如何切回

下面任意一种方式都能让 Ink TUI 回到共享 loop 的过程式路径：

- 设置 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }`（这会对所有入口关闭内核）；
- 环境变量 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0`（只关 Ink TUI），或 `=0`（关闭所有入口）。

`"experimental": { "unifiedAgentLoop": false }` 仍会让 Ink TUI 完全离开共享 loop。过程式路径保留到每个入口的内核默认开启都满 14 天。

## 为什么需要

#17045 一次为一个入口开启内核；Ink TUI 原定 12-02，在 headless 之后。第 4 步的条件都已满足：

- Ink TUI 已默认运行在共享 loop 上（#17362），headless 的内核默认开启已先合入（#18154）；
- Ink TUI 的第 3 步（#17160）和 #17145（经由事件总线的取消和有界收尾）已于 11-13 合入；
- 两个设置都开启、跑集成测试（包括 Ink TUI 的）的 Linux 组从 11-14 到 11-22 每晚通过，只有两晚 #17045 不计入：11-17 只失败在一个与 loop 无关、在 main 上关闭开关时也以同样方式失败的测试上；11-23 所有组都失败了，包括强制关闭的那组，原因是 CI 的模型 key 被拒绝；它的 7 晚在 11-20 已满；
- 有意差异和切回方式已在上面列出，release notes 会带上它们。

11-18 以来出现过的 Ink TUI 对拍失败都对照本改动看过：teammate 场景多出的请求（#18027）来自测试装置在高负载下 30 秒等待超时；重试场景缺少的记录（#16947）最可能是测试在最后一条记录写入之前就退出了；两者都没有显示内核与共享 loop 的行为不同。

#17540 的评审意见中：schema 默认值的固定和能力台账在本 PR 中修复，event-bus 设计中"连续 20 次"的条件已由 main 删除。Web Shell 仍把未设置的开关显示为关闭；它的会话运行在 ACP 上，而 ACP 的内核仍默认关闭，所以显示的就是它们实际运行的路径。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 什么都不设置时，Ink TUI 运行在内核上：调试日志（`QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE=1`）显示 `[LOOP] ink kernel` 和 `[EVENT_BUS]` 标记，`/about` 报告 `kernel`。设 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_EVENT_BUS_AGENT_LOOP=ink=0` 或 `"experimental": { "eventBusAgentLoop": false }` 时显示 `[LOOP] ink shared`。
- 配置测试固定 headless 和 Ink TUI 默认开启内核、其他入口关闭，每个入口的两种切回方式、各入口的 loop 路径，以及共享 loop 的默认值不随之变化。

结果：在 main 6b926f9443 上，`npm run build` 以及 core、CLI 和 Web Shell 的 typecheck 都无错误；core 配置测试（1102）、上面的 CLI 测试（1460，跳过 5：配置、Ink 流式 hook、两个设置对话框、`/config` 和 daemon 的设置路由）、Web Shell 的 i18n 和设置测试（235）通过。把这个设置的默认值改回 `false` 后，新加的固定会失败，符合预期。TUI 对拍套件在 nightly 的 Linux 内核组里让 Ink TUI 运行在内核上（26 个用例，11-14 到 11-22 除上面两晚外每晚通过）。Linux、Node 22。

### 前后对比

不适用：常见情况下没有可见变化；差异已在上面列出。

### 环境

Node 22，无沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：所有 Ink TUI 会话一起切到内核。内核包装的是与过程式路径相同的模型轮和工具批步骤；归因于内核的回归会让 Ink TUI 重新等待，上面任意一种开关都能切回过程式路径。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：其他入口的内核默认开启；删除 Ink TUI 的旧 loop（第 5 步）和过程式路径。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：上面的取消上限；`experimental.eventBusAgentLoop: false` 现在也会让 Ink TUI 保持过程式路径。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-11-11-event-bus-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

属于 #17045（Ink TUI 的第 4 步）。取代 #17540。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): pin public-children Shell parking and confirm S8a pre-start checks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR settles the pre-start checks for Stage 5 of #18149, the slice that lets a `run_shell_command` approval wait park before the Shell is dispatched. It also pins the Shell parking that turned out to ship already, and records both results in the coverage design. No production code changes.

**Pre-start checks.** The design asked one question before Stage 5 could be designed: does Shell execution have the same "prepare without dispatch, replay under the exact key" semantics that native file tools rely on after a cold recovery? If not, the Broker would need that work first and the stage would grow substantially. Two tests answer it, and the answer is better than the design assumed:

- **Broker.** A Shell reservation on the published-output path (Tool v3) is prepared without being dispatched. Preparing it again under the same key and reference returns the original reservation, still unstarted. Under that key, a different publication identity or payload digest is refused as an idempotency conflict. Once the execution has settled, the same key answers with its original settled record, and the Shell ran exactly once.
- **Harness.** On a Shell-profile Session with public child agents, a Shell approval wait already parks today. After the park, a cold load and an Allow, recovery re-prepares the Shell with the identity saved before the wait (the original call id, digests and publication identity) and runs it once.

The second result comes from the public child agents work in #15171. It built a Shell-before-dispatch continuation for public-children Sessions, and park eligibility has no Shell-specific term, so that topology already parks behind the existing switch, although no design has checked that path against G3. The design is amended accordingly:

- Stage 5 needs no Broker work.
- Its remaining scope is Shell-profile Sessions without public children, which still refuse with the Shell-profile reason.
- The continuation reader only recognizes a saved plan as a Shell plan when it carries the public-child model pin, so extending capture to other Sessions needs another way to recognize such plans. The G3 extension design has to settle this.
- The separate G3 extension design is still required before implementation.

**Decision 8 and its gate cases.** The design records how to treat the path that already parks. Public-children Shell waits keep parking, with no temporary refusal, because parking adds no recovery path that a Harness crash in the wait does not already take. Parking does make that path run for every idle Shell approval instead of only after a crash, so the verification plan now lists its cases, and they must pass before any deployment turns on Action parking, ahead of the rest of Stage 5. This PR adds those cases at the unit level:

- **Outcome matrix.** Allow, Deny, expiry and a mode change that allows on the user's behalf, each after a park and after the Harness dies in the wait, eight cases in all. Allow and the mode change re-prepare the saved reservation and run the Shell once, and the Turn completes. Deny prepares and runs nothing, and the Turn completes. Expiry prepares and runs nothing, marks the Action expired and settles the Turn cancelled, as G3 requires. Every case keeps the one original Action.
- **Background Shell.** The design left two possibilities open: the wait parks and resumes without a second process, or it refuses with a typed reason. It parks and resumes. After the Allow, every child-run record belongs to the one reserved execution, so no second process starts.

The real-process MySQL 8.4 case that the verification plan requires for each slice is still owed before the switch is turned on, and the design says so.

## Why it's needed

The coverage design requires every "to verify" conclusion to be confirmed by a test before its slice is designed and implemented, because a check can change the slice's scope. This one did. It removes the possible Broker work and narrows Stage 5. It also shows that one Shell topology already parks without any design review, so the cases that gate turning the switch on had to be written down and run now, not left to Stage 5's implementation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that:

- both language versions of the amended slice, decision 8 and the new verification entry have the same points and the same code locations, and that the cited lines match `main` at the commit named in the amendment;
- the Broker test checks the reservation state and the worker execution count after each prepare, that each changed identity is refused under the original key, and that the key answers the settled record after the single execution;
- each park case shows the wait really parked (a park certificate was stamped, no refusal was counted, and the Session left memory before the decision-delivery load), and each Harness-death case shows the replacement took the Turn over without any park;
- in the executing cases the single Shell prepare carries exactly the identity saved in the continuation, and in the others no Shell prepare or execution happens at all;
- the background case asserts that the saved input is a background Shell and that all child-run records share the one reserved execution.

The points that most deserve scrutiny:

- **Decision 8.** Should public-children Shell waits keep parking, with their missing cases gating the switch, rather than getting a temporary park-only refusal now? The continuation, its recovery and the Broker replay they rely on all predate this PR, and the tests here only pin the combination.
- **Test vehicle.** The Harness tests drive the model through a mock, which has to set the public-child model pin that the real model driver sets before every public-children request. Without the pin, the reader rejects the saved plan and the Session stays resident, failing safe. By code reading, production always sets the pin for these Sessions.
- **Background Shell after the Allow.** Once its process has started, the Session stays resident, as it should while a background process runs. The test closes the Session explicitly rather than waiting for it to suspend.

Local checks on Linux:

- All new tests pass, and they fail when the behavior they pin is broken. The Broker test fails when the Broker skips its same-request check for a reused key. Every executing Harness case fails when recovery re-prepares the Shell under a fresh call id. All nine Harness cases fail when capture refuses public-children Shell.
- The whole Broker service test class (216 tests) and the whole idle-suspension group (60 tests) pass, with no Checkstyle violations.
- TypeScript, ESLint and Prettier pass on the changed files.
- One unrelated idle-suspension test, the monitor wake resume after a Harness death, fails intermittently on its closing delete (409). It failed once in a group run and once in six solo runs on this branch, and passed four solo runs on the base. This change touches nothing it uses, and the last full group run passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation and tests only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only, no live deployment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the tests pin behavior that already ships behind the default-off Action parking switch, so turning that switch on in a deployment with public-children Shell Sessions parks their Shell approvals. This is consistent with the "park coverage never exceeds cold-recovery coverage" invariant, because their cold recovery already exists. Decision 8 keeps this behavior and makes its cases a precondition for turning the switch on. A deployment that needs the switch earlier would have to add a park-only refusal first.
- Not validated / out of scope: no production code is changed. The real-process MySQL 8.4 case for public-children Shell is still owed before the switch is turned on. Shell-profile Sessions without public children remain Stage 5's own implementation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design document: [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md) and [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149. References #18151 (coverage design), #18218 (S5 pre-start checks) and #15171 (public child agents).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落实 #18149 阶段 5 的开工前检查，阶段 5 这个切片要让 `run_shell_command` 的审批等待在 Shell 派发之前就能停靠。本 PR 还把已经上线了的那部分 Shell 停靠用测试固定下来，并把两方面的结论都记入覆盖设计。不改动生产代码。

**开工前检查。** 设计在阶段 5 开始设计之前提出了一个问题：Shell 执行是否和原生文件工具一样，具备冷恢复后所依赖的"prepare 不派发、按精确 key 重放"语义？如果没有，就需要先在 Broker 侧补齐，这一阶段的工作量会明显变大。两个测试回答了这个问题，结果比设计预想的更好：

- **Broker。** 走输出发布路径（Tool v3）的 Shell reservation 在 prepare 时不会派发。用同一个 key 和 reference 再次 prepare，返回原来的 reservation，仍未启动。在这个 key 下换了发布身份或 payload 摘要，会以幂等冲突拒绝。执行结算之后，同一个 key 返回它原来的已结算记录，Shell 恰好执行了一次。
- **Harness。** 在带 public child agent 的 Shell profile Session 上，Shell 审批等待今天已经能停靠。停靠、冷加载、Allow 之后，恢复过程用等待前保存的身份（原调用 id、摘要和发布身份）重新 prepare 这个 Shell，并只执行一次。

第二个结果来自 #15171 的 public child agent 工作。它为 public children Session 建立了派发前 Shell 的 continuation，而停靠资格里没有 Shell 专属的条件，所以这种拓扑在现有开关之后已经能停靠，尽管还没有设计按 G3 核对过这条路径。设计相应修订如下：

- 阶段 5 不需要 Broker 侧的工作。
- 剩下的范围是没有 public children 的 Shell profile Session，它们仍以 Shell profile 原因拒绝。
- continuation 的读取端只有在保存的计划带 public child 的 model pin 时，才把它识别为 Shell 计划，所以把捕获推广到其他 Session 时，需要另一种识别方式。这要由 G3 扩展设计来定。
- 实现前仍要先写单独的 G3 扩展设计。

**决策 8 及其门槛用例。** 设计记下了如何对待这条已经能停靠的路径。public children 的 Shell 等待继续停靠，不加临时拒绝，因为停靠没有引入 Harness 在等待中崩溃时本来就不会走的恢复路径。但停靠让这条路径从只在崩溃后才走，变成每个闲置的 Shell 审批都会走，所以验证计划现在列出了它的用例，这些用例必须在任何部署打开审批停靠之前通过，并且排在阶段 5 的其余部分之前。本 PR 在单元测试层面补上了这些用例：

- **结局矩阵。** Allow、Deny、到期，以及代用户放行的模式变更，每种都覆盖停靠之后和 Harness 在等待中死亡之后两种情况，共 8 个用例。Allow 和模式变更用保存的 reservation 重新 prepare，Shell 只执行一次，Turn 完成。Deny 不做任何 prepare、不执行，Turn 完成。到期不做任何 prepare、不执行，把 Action 标记为已到期，并按 G3 的要求把 Turn 结算为 cancelled。每个用例都只保留原来那一个 Action。
- **后台 Shell。** 设计原先留了两种可能：等待能停靠并恢复、不启动第二个进程；或者以带类型的原因拒绝。实际是能停靠并恢复。Allow 之后，所有 child-run 记录都属于预留的那一次执行，所以不会启动第二个进程。

验证计划要求每个切片都有的 MySQL 8.4 真实进程用例，在打开开关之前仍待补上，设计中已写明。

## 为什么需要

覆盖设计要求每个"待验证"结论都要在对应切片设计和实现之前用测试确认，因为检查结果可能改变切片的范围。这一项就改变了：它去掉了可能的 Broker 工作，收窄了阶段 5。它还表明有一种 Shell 拓扑在没有经过任何设计审查的情况下已经能停靠，所以作为开关前提的那些用例必须现在就写下来并跑通，而不能留到阶段 5 实现时再做。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

请确认：

- 修订后的切片、决策 8 和新增的验证条目在两个语言版本中要点相同、代码位置相同，并且引用的行号与修订中注明的 `main` 提交一致；
- Broker 测试在每次 prepare 之后检查 reservation 状态和 worker 执行次数，检查在原 key 下每种身份变更都被拒绝，并检查唯一一次执行之后该 key 返回已结算记录；
- 每个停靠用例都证明等待确实停靠了（打了停靠证书，没有计入拒绝，并且在决定投递的加载之前 Session 已离开内存），每个 Harness 死亡用例都证明是替代者接管了 Turn，过程中没有任何停靠；
- 在会执行的用例中，唯一一次 Shell prepare 携带的正是 continuation 中保存的身份；在其他用例中完全没有 Shell prepare 或执行；
- 后台用例断言保存的输入是后台 Shell，并且所有 child-run 记录都属于同一次预留的执行。

最值得仔细审查的几点：

- **决策 8。** public children 的 Shell 等待是否应该继续停靠，并以补齐缺失用例作为打开开关的前提，而不是现在就加一个停靠专属的临时拒绝？它依赖的 continuation、恢复路径和 Broker 重放都早于本 PR，这里的测试只是把它们的组合固定下来。
- **测试载体。** Harness 测试通过 mock 驱动 model，因此需要手动设置 public child 的 model pin，真实的 model driver 会在每次 public children 请求前设置它。没有这个 pin 时，读取端会拒绝保存的计划，Session 保持常驻，属于安全失败。按读代码判断，生产环境对这类 Session 总会设置这个 pin。
- **Allow 之后的后台 Shell。** 进程启动之后 Session 保持常驻，这在后台进程运行期间是应有的行为。测试显式关闭 Session，而不是等它挂起。

在 Linux 上的本地检查：

- 所有新测试都通过，并且在它们固定的行为被破坏时会失败。Broker 对复用的 key 跳过同请求检查时，Broker 测试失败。恢复用新的调用 id 重新 prepare Shell 时，每个会执行的 Harness 用例都失败。捕获拒绝 public children 的 Shell 时，9 个 Harness 用例全部失败。
- 整个 Broker service 测试类（216 个测试）和整个 idle-suspension 测试组（60 个测试）都通过，Checkstyle 没有违规。
- 改动文件的 TypeScript、ESLint 和 Prettier 检查都通过。
- idle-suspension 组里有一个无关测试，即 Harness 死亡后恢复 monitor wake 的用例，会在收尾的删除操作上偶发失败（409）。在本分支上它在一次整组运行中失败过一次，在六次单独运行中失败过一次；在基线上四次单独运行都通过。本改动不涉及它用到的任何东西，最后一次整组运行也通过了。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：只改了文档和测试。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试，没有实际部署。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：这些测试固定的是在默认关闭的审批停靠开关之后已经上线的行为，所以在有 public children Shell Session 的部署中打开这个开关，会让它们的 Shell 审批停靠。这符合"停靠覆盖面不超过冷恢复覆盖面"的不变量，因为它们的冷恢复已经存在。决策 8 保留这一行为，并把这些用例作为打开开关的前提。如果某个部署需要更早打开开关，就得先加一个停靠专属的拒绝条件。
- 未验证或范围外：不改动生产代码。public children Shell 的 MySQL 8.4 真实进程用例在打开开关之前仍待补上。没有 public children 的 Shell profile Session 仍归阶段 5 自己的实现。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.md) 和 [`docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md`](docs/design/2026-11-22-managed-action-parking-coverage.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149。参见 #18151（覆盖设计）、#18218（S5 开工前检查）和 #15171（public child agent）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep an Action-parked Session's MCP owner from reclamation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is slice S6a of Stage 4 in #18149: the control-plane guard that MCP Action parking (S6) needs before the Harness side can land. The parked-MCP reclamation job no longer reclaims the MCP owner of a Session whose seal parks a Turn waiting for an Action.

The job treats an owner as reclaimable when its Session's journal head is sealed. A seal that parks a Turn is also sealed, so after the idle window (30 minutes by default) the job would retire the parked Session's MCP connections. Its resumed Turn would then find a catalog that no longer matches the one its saved continuation pins, and could never resume. The reclaimable predicate now also requires the seal to carry no park certificate. Writer acquisition already clears that certificate, so once the parked Turn resumes and its Session later idles without a park, reclamation applies to it as before.

The predicate is the single read behind every reclamation decision, so the same rule covers all three: the idle sweep, the expedited pass that storage maintenance requests, and the Broker's recheck just before it retires an owner.

## Why it's needed

S6 lets an approval wait on an MCP Session park, keeping its MCP connections and catalog through Phase 2 MCP parking. That only works if the retained catalog is still there when the Turn resumes. The coverage design (§4.6, corrected by #18186) assigns this predicate to S6. It ships first, on its own, because it is Java-only and inert today: nothing writes a park certificate for an MCP Session until the Harness side of S6 lands, and both `qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled` and `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.mcp-parking.enabled` stay off by default.

One choice goes beyond the design's text, which names only the idle sweep. Storage maintenance also skips an Action-parked owner, instead of reclaiming it on request. A resident Session waiting for the same approval holds its MCP owner and blocks maintenance in the same way, so parking does not change what maintenance waits for. Reclaiming the owner would instead turn a wait that could have resumed into one that never can.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A Session head sealed two hours ago that carries a park certificate does not report as sealed to the reclamation job; one sealed 45 minutes ago without a certificate still does.
- The existing reclamation-predicate cases (candidate listing, paging, storage lookup, sealed duration, active and missing heads) now also run against MySQL through a new MySQL integration subclass.
- The reclamation job's own cases are unchanged and still pass: it only consumes the predicate.

Locally green on macOS, in one focused Maven run (`-Pmysql-integration`) against a disposable MySQL 8.4.2:

- `JdbcParkedMcpOwnersTest` (H2): 7 cases, including the new one.
- `ParkedMcpReclamationJobTest`: 6 cases, unchanged.
- `JdbcParkedMcpOwnersMySqlIT` (MySQL 8.4.2): 7 cases.
- Checkstyle, both executions: 0 violations.
- SpotBugs was skipped locally and is left to CI, together with the complete H2 suite and the full MySQL and Hosted profiles. Acceptance is pending those CI gates.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — control-plane predicate, no user-visible change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Focused Maven run of the selected unit and MySQL integration classes plus both Checkstyle executions, against a disposable local MySQL 8.4.2 (CI uses 8.4.6; macOS has no native-AIO flag). SpotBugs and the complete H2/MySQL profiles are left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: storage maintenance on a storage that holds an Action-parked MCP owner now waits until that Turn wakes (its decision, cancellation or expiry), exactly as it would for the same wait kept resident.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Harness side of S6 (capturing and resuming MCP waits), which will land together with S5 Hooks; the full MySQL and Hosted profiles, which run in CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema change.

## Linked Issues

Part of #18149. Implements the reclamation guard scheduled by #18186.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

这是 #18149 阶段 4 的 S6a 切片：MCP 审批停靠（S6）在 Harness 侧上线之前必须先有的控制面守卫。停靠 MCP 回收作业不再回收"seal 正停靠着一个等待 Action 的 Turn"的 Session 的 MCP owner。

回收作业把 journal head 处于 sealed 状态的 Session 的 owner 视为可回收。停靠了 Turn 的 seal 也是 sealed，所以过了空闲窗口（默认 30 分钟），作业会撤掉这个停靠 Session 的 MCP 连接。恢复后的 Turn 会发现目录已和保存的 continuation 固定的目录不一致，再也无法恢复。现在"可回收"的判断还要求 seal 不带停靠证书。获取 writer 时本来就会清除这个证书，所以停靠的 Turn 恢复之后，如果它的 Session 之后又在没有停靠的情况下空闲，回收照旧适用。

这个判断是所有回收决定读取的同一个谓词，所以同一条规则覆盖三处：空闲扫描、存储维护请求的加急回收，以及 Broker 撤掉 owner 之前的复查。

## 为什么需要

S6 让 MCP Session 上的审批等待可以停靠，并通过第二阶段的 MCP parking 保留其 MCP 连接和目录。这只有在 Turn 恢复时保留的目录还在才行得通。覆盖面设计（§4.6，由 #18186 修正）把这个谓词划给了 S6。它先单独上线，因为它只改 Java，而且现在不产生任何效果：在 S6 的 Harness 侧上线前，不会有任何东西为 MCP Session 写停靠证书；`qwen.managed-agent.action-parking.enabled` 和 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.mcp-parking.enabled` 也都默认关闭。

有一处选择超出了设计原文（原文只提到空闲扫描）：存储维护同样跳过审批停靠中的 owner，而不是按请求回收它。同一个审批若保持常驻，Session 也会持有它的 MCP owner，同样挡住维护，所以停靠不会改变维护要等待的东西。反过来，回收这个 owner 会把一个本可恢复的等待变成永远无法恢复。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 两小时前 seal、带停靠证书的 Session head，不会被回收作业视为 sealed；45 分钟前 seal、不带证书的仍然会。
- 原有的回收谓词用例（候选列表、分页、按存储查找、sealed 时长、active 与缺失的 head）现在通过新增的 MySQL 集成子类，也在 MySQL 上运行。
- 回收作业自身的用例没有改动，照样通过：它只消费这个谓词。

本地（macOS）在一次性的 MySQL 8.4.2 上，用一次聚焦的 Maven 运行（`-Pmysql-integration`）全部通过：

- `JdbcParkedMcpOwnersTest`（H2）：7 个用例，含新增的一个。
- `ParkedMcpReclamationJobTest`：6 个用例，未改动。
- `JdbcParkedMcpOwnersMySqlIT`（MySQL 8.4.2）：7 个用例。
- Checkstyle 两次执行：0 个违规。
- SpotBugs 在本地跳过，和完整的 H2 套件、完整的 MySQL 与 Hosted profile 一起留给 CI；这些 CI 门禁通过之前，验收仍待定。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：控制面谓词，没有用户可见的变化。

### 环境

在一次性的本地 MySQL 8.4.2 上做的聚焦 Maven 运行，包含选定的单元测试类、MySQL 集成测试类和两次 Checkstyle（CI 用 8.4.6；macOS 没有 native-AIO 参数）。SpotBugs 和完整的 H2/MySQL profile 留给 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：存放审批停靠 MCP owner 的存储上的维护，现在要等那个 Turn 醒来（决定、取消或到期），和同一个等待保持常驻时完全一样。
- 未验证 / 范围外：S6 的 Harness 侧（捕获并恢复 MCP 等待），将与 S5 Hooks 一起上线；完整的 MySQL 和 Hosted profile 在 CI 中运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有 schema 变化。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #18149。实现 #18186 排定的回收守卫。

</details>

prs.title: fix: enforce Read deny rules on grep and glob results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fixes read permission enforcement for search results by applying the same deny/ask path filtering to the default `RipGrepTool`, fallback `GrepTool`, and `GlobTool` before truncation and result formatting.

## Why it's needed

The default configured ripgrep tool could still return paths covered by read permission rules, while the legacy grep/glob paths filtered them. A read rule with `ask` also needs to be excluded from unattended search results because returning the content would bypass the read confirmation. Permission filtering now happens once per distinct search-result file, and glob retains truncation context even when the collected entries are all excluded.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a read deny rule and search for a matching file.
2. Configure a read ask rule and verify the path is not returned as a readable search result.
3. Verify truncation and result counts are computed after filtering.
4. Run the targeted ripgrep, grep, and glob tests.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the default `RipGrepTool` could return denied/ask-protected paths, and glob could report a capped scan as a confident “No files found” after permission filtering.
- After: filtering runs before counts, truncation, and output generation; ripgrep and grep permission decisions are cached per file; glob reports a truncated scan when all collected entries are denied.
- Targeted ripgrep test: `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code-core exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/tools/ripGrep.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` — 81 passed, 1 skipped.
- Targeted glob test: new “reports truncation when every collected entry is denied” regression passed; the file suite had 61 passed and 13 Windows symlink-permission failures unrelated to this change.

### Tested on

| OS | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 11 | ✅ Targeted tests passed; symlink-only failures are blocked by the worker's Windows symlink privilege |

## Risk & Scope

Low-to-medium risk. Search results may now omit paths that require read approval, matching the permission contract. Changes are limited to ripgrep/grep/glob filtering, shared read-rule evaluation, truncation messaging, and regression coverage.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15129

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

修复默认 `RipGrepTool`、备用 `GrepTool` 与 `GlobTool` 未执行读权限过滤的问题，并覆盖 deny/ask 规则，确保搜索结果不会绕过读取确认；同时保留 glob 截断提示，并缓存 ripgrep/grep 的按文件权限判断。

</details>

## AI Disclosure

This PR was prepared with AI assistance. The author reviewed the implementation, tests, and permission-scope impact.

prs.title: fix(agents): keep A2A tasks recoverable after transcript read errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session-based A2A requests return the existing retryable JSON-RPC error `-32012` when a filesystem error prevents reply lookup in an active or archived transcript. The failing observation saves no task result. Once reads recover, the same task can report `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with its original reply.

## Why it's needed

A transient read error could make a recorded reply appear absent and cause a completed task to be permanently saved as `TASK_STATE_FAILED`. A permissions check can still succeed when the actual read fails. The linked issue reproduces this with injected `EIO`. [Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738), [earlier proposal and review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`, run `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`. The regression cases inject a stream read failure in each transcript location. Check that `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, and a replay of `SendMessage` return `-32012` with no internal path details and no saved task result. After restoring the stream, poll the same task with `GetTask` and check that it returns and saves `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. The cases also check the oversized archive and unexpected-error paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The local JSON-RPC daemon probe used the same recorded-reply fixtures for both versions. On installed Qwen Code 0.27.3, polling under `EIO` returned and saved `TASK_STATE_FAILED` for both transcript locations. Polling after recovery returned the same state. In the fixed bundle, polling under the same fault returned `-32012` and the task mappings contained no result. The next poll returned and saved `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. Healthy, missing-transcript, and mismatched-reply controls produced the expected results on both versions.

Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint and Prettier checks, and the focused CLI and core suites passed. The suites ran 22 CLI tests and 391 core tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0 arm64 and Node 22.18.0 for the fixed bundle. The probe used a local `serve` daemon with experimental agent collaboration enabled and synthetic on-disk fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- An unreadable active transcript takes precedence over the archived copy because the archive may hold a stale reply. The session loaders use strict reads by opt-in, with A2A as the sole caller that enables them.
- Previously saved failures, malformed reply records, and concurrent archive restoration are outside the fix. The existing cancellation decision and receipt behavior still depend on observing the task.
- The fix uses the existing task schema, storage format, and JSON-RPC code. It requires no data migration.

[Design document (Simplified Chinese)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13738

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

基于会话的 A2A 请求在活动或归档 transcript 因文件系统错误而无法查找回复时，返回现有的可重试 JSON-RPC 错误 `-32012`。本次失败的观测不会保存任务结果。读取恢复后，同一个任务可以返回 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。

## Why it's needed

瞬时读取错误可能让已记录的回复看起来缺失，导致已经完成的任务被永久保存为 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。即使实际读取失败，权限检查仍可能通过。关联 issue 使用注入的 `EIO` 复现了这个问题。[Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738)、[早期方案及评审](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797)。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

在 `packages/cli` 运行 `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`。回归用例分别在两处 transcript 注入流读取故障。确认 `GetTask`、`ListTasks`、`CancelTask` 和同请求重发的 `SendMessage` 返回 `-32012`，响应不包含内部路径，任务也没有保存结果。恢复读取后，通过 `GetTask` 查询同一个任务，确认返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。用例也检查归档超出大小限制和未预期错误的处理路径。

### Evidence (Before & After)

本地 JSON-RPC daemon 探针对两个版本使用了相同的已记录回复 fixture。使用已安装的 Qwen Code 0.27.3 时，两处 transcript 在 `EIO` 期间的查询都返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。读取恢复后查询仍返回相同状态。使用修复后的 bundle，在相同故障下查询返回 `-32012`，任务映射没有保存结果。下一次查询返回并保存了 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。正常 transcript、文件缺失以及回复属于其他 run 的对照在两个版本上均符合预期。

构建、打包、类型检查、定向 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查，以及 CLI 和 core 定向测试均通过。两套测试分别运行了 22 项和 391 项。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

修复后的 bundle 使用 macOS 27.0 arm64 和 Node 22.18.0。探针在启用实验性 Agent 协作的本地 `serve` daemon 中运行，使用合成的磁盘 fixture。

## Risk & Scope

- 活动 transcript 无法读取时优先报告该故障，因为归档副本里的回复可能已过时。加载器以显式启用的方式使用严格读取，只有 A2A 调用方启用。
- 之前已保存的失败、损坏的回复记录和并发归档还原超出本次修复范围。现有的取消决策和回执仍依赖于观测任务。
- 修复沿用现有任务数据结构、存储格式和 JSON-RPC 错误码，无需数据迁移。

[中文设计文档](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

#13738

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): create session transcripts with owner-only permissions
prs.body:
## What this changes

`ChatRecordingService.ensureConversationFile()` created the session transcript (`<session>.jsonl`) without an explicit mode, so Node applied `0o666 & ~umask` and left the log world-readable (0644) under the common 022 umask — even though transcripts persist tool output verbatim and can embed credentials.

- Create the transcript with `mode: 0o600`.
- Tighten an existing transcript in place (`chmodSync 0o600`) so sessions resumed from logs written by earlier versions are not left world-readable. Follows the session-start profiler's existing open+fchmod pattern; best-effort on filesystems without POSIX chmod semantics.

Secret redaction in the write path (the other half of #18165) is intentionally out of scope to keep this change atomic.

## Why

Fixes #18165 — discussed with @qqqys there.

## How to verify

- `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/core test src/services/chatRecordingService.test.ts` — 206 passed, incl. two new cases asserting `mode: 0o600` on creation and `chmodSync(path, 0o600)` on a pre-existing transcript.
- ESLint / Prettier / `tsc --noEmit` clean on the touched files.

## Scope

- `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts` (fix)
- `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.test.ts` (tests)

prs.title: test(managed-agent): wait for the resumed wake Turn to free the Session before closing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two existing monitor-wake recovery cases ("resumes a monitor wake approval after its Harness dies in the wait" and "retries a wake approval continuation read that a Store fault failed") close the Session at the end. They closed it as soon as the journal showed the resumed Turn settled. The Turn's run, however, still releases its Runtime after that settle, and only then frees the Session's active slot, which the close requires. When the release lands late, the close answers `409 hosted_turn_active` and the case fails. The cases now wait until the Session reports no active prompt before closing. Production code does not change.

## Why it's needed

The cases failed intermittently in full runs of the Hosted Harness Session test file, where the event loop is busy late in the file. The failure was found while verifying #18224, and the fix was meant to ship as its second commit, but #18224 merged before that commit reached it. The race does not depend on that change: the same code path exists before it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Make the Runtime release in the shared helper take 400 ms. Without this change, both cases fail every time with `409 hosted_turn_active` on the close; with it, both pass.
- Without the injected delay, both cases pass.

Locally on Linux, on `main` at `ea5b0467ca`: both checks above, plus ESLint and Prettier on the changed file.

One more case in the same file follows the same pattern ("settles a monitor wake that died in its approval wait so its continuation can run"). Its continuation Turn executes no tool, so it has no Runtime release after its settle, and it has not failed in any run; it is left unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Harness test fixture only.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** none in production; the two cases now wait up to five seconds for the Session to go idle before closing.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** other tests in the file that close a Session right after a journal settle and have not been seen to fail.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #18224. Part of #18149.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

两个已有的 monitor-wake 恢复用例（"resumes a monitor wake approval after its Harness dies in the wait" 和 "retries a wake approval continuation read that a Store fault failed"）在最后会关闭 Session。它们原来在 journal 显示恢复的 Turn 已结算后就立即关闭。但 Turn 的运行在结算之后还要释放 Runtime，然后才腾出 Session 的活动位，而关闭需要这个活动位已空出。释放来得晚时，关闭会返回 `409 hosted_turn_active`，用例失败。现在这两个用例会先等 Session 报告没有活动 prompt 再关闭。生产代码不变。

## 为什么需要

在完整运行 Hosted Harness Session 测试文件时，这两个用例会间歇失败，因为文件后段事件循环比较忙。这个问题是在验证 #18224 时发现的，修复原本作为它的第二个提交一起合入，但 #18224 在那个提交同步到 PR 之前就合并了。这个竞态与那次改动无关：改动之前就存在同样的代码路径。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 让共享辅助函数中的 Runtime 释放耗时 400 毫秒。没有本改动时，两个用例每次都在关闭时以 `409 hosted_turn_active` 失败；有本改动时，两个用例都通过。
- 不注入延迟时，两个用例都通过。

本地 Linux，基于 `main` 的 `ea5b0467ca`：上面两项检查，以及改动文件的 ESLint 与 Prettier。

同一文件中还有一个用例是同样的模式（"settles a monitor wake that died in its approval wait so its continuation can run"）。它的 continuation Turn 不执行任何工具，所以结算之后没有 Runtime 释放，也从未在任何一次运行中失败，因此保持不变。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用——只改测试。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

只使用 Harness 测试夹具。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** 生产代码没有风险；这两个用例现在会在关闭前最多等待五秒，直到 Session 空闲。
- **未验证或不在范围内：** 文件中其他在 journal 结算后立即关闭 Session、但未曾观察到失败的测试。
- **破坏性变更或迁移说明：** 无。

## 关联 Issue

#18224 的后续。属于 #18149。

</details>

prs.title: fix(deps): clear the current high-and-critical prod audit findings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clears every high-and-critical finding currently failing the nightly Security Checks gate (`pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high`): bumps the directly declared packages (simple-git 3→4.1, shell-quote, sharp, markdown-it in both majors in use), lifts the msteams channel's `@microsoft/agents-*` to the upstream release that already carries the fixed zod and msal-node, and adds three workspace overrides for transitive-only findings (proxy-addr, follow-redirects, and the shell-quote copies pinned by ink's react-devtools-core chain).

## Why it's needed

The Security Checks workflow has been red on main for over a week on a batch of advisories published against the locked tree (simple-git's November CVE set, proxy-addr IP spoofing, shell-quote command injection, follow-redirects credential handling, sharp's librsvg, markdown-it quadratic complexity, and the zod/msal-node copies entering through `@microsoft/agents-*@1.9.1`). The behavioral adaptation has two halves, both in v4's environment guard. It throws when a task environment names a guarded `GIT_*` variable without an explicit opt-in, and the extension git client deliberately sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT` (plus the inline credential trio when authenticating), so those are named in `allowEnvironment`. It also deletes any guarded key a client did not name from the inherited environment — not only ones a task env sets — so the guarded loader now allowlists the transport credentials `gitEnv()` restores (`GIT_SSH_COMMAND`, `GIT_SSH`, `GIT_ASKPASS`, `SSH_ASKPASS`); without that, a client that returns before `.env()` lost the operator's SSH identity and an SSH-sourced install failed `Permission denied (publickey)`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` should exit 0 (remaining findings: 1 low, 6 moderate — below the gate). The behavior-sensitive surface is the extension git client: its unit tests exercise the restricted-environment client against simple-git's guard, including the credentialed paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — dependency and guard-configuration change, no UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

Local verification: `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` exits 0; `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass; targeted vitest runs all pass — packages/core git suites (`extension-git-client`, `github`, `load-simple-git`, `gitUtils`, `enter-worktree`, `agent`: 649 tests), shell parse/quote suites (784 tests), msteams channel suite (65 tests), and the notices generator test. Both `NOTICES.txt` files were regenerated with the repo's script.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: simple-git 3→4 is a major; the breaking changes (default export removed, abbreviated long options rejected, ambient GIT_* env filtered) were each checked against this repo's usage — all git access goes through the guarded loader, which already uses the named export. The msteams agents minor bump is upstream's own fix carrier. The pnpm minimumReleaseAge gate accepted every pinned version at install time.
- Not validated / out of scope: 1 low and 6 moderate findings remain below the gate; the broader Snyk-driven remediation program is tracked separately in #17099.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none expected. The two allowlists only name keys a client already wants to keep in its child environment — they do not inject values, so a client that scrubs to `gitEnv()` stays scrubbed, and the loader's guard, config blocklist and unsafe-option policy are untouched.

## Linked Issues

Refs #17099 (the standing security-upgrade tracker). Refs #16434.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

清空当前导致 nightly Security Checks 门禁（`pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high`）失败的全部 high/critical 发现：升级直接声明的包（simple-git 3→4.1、shell-quote、sharp、两个主线的 markdown-it），把 msteams 频道的 `@microsoft/agents-*` 升到上游已携带修复版 zod 和 msal-node 的版本，并为纯传递路径的发现加了三条 workspace override（proxy-addr、follow-redirects，以及 ink 的 react-devtools-core 链锁住的 shell-quote 副本）。

## 为什么需要

Security Checks 在 main 上已经红了一周多，原因是针对锁定依赖树新发布的一批 advisory（simple-git 十一月 CVE 组、proxy-addr IP 欺骗、shell-quote 命令注入、follow-redirects 凭据处理、sharp 的 librsvg、markdown-it 二次复杂度，以及经 `@microsoft/agents-*@1.9.1` 进入的 zod/msal-node）。唯一的行为适配：simple-git v4 对显式设置受保护 `GIT_*` 环境变量的任务会抛错，除非显式 opt-in；extension git client 有意设置 `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`/`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT`（认证时另有内联凭据三件套），现在通过 `allowEnvironment` 显式声明。

## 评审验证

`corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high` 应退出 0（剩余 1 low / 6 moderate，低于门禁线）。行为敏感面是 extension git client：其单测覆盖了受限环境客户端在 simple-git 守卫下的行为，包括带凭据路径。

本地验证：audit 退出 0；`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 通过；packages/core 的 git 相关套件（649 个测试）、shell parse/quote 套件（784 个）、msteams 频道套件（65 个）、notices 生成器测试全部通过；两个 `NOTICES.txt` 均用仓库脚本重新生成。守卫适配的补充用例：`load-simple-git`（8）、`extension-git-client`（29）、`github`（157）、`git-worktree-marker`（35）、`gitWorktreeService.env-passthrough.integ`（3），在真实 4.x 客户端上验证两条 allowlist；`packages/core` 的 `tsc --noEmit` 干净。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：simple-git 3→4 是大版本；其 breaking change（默认导出移除、缩写长选项拒绝、过滤环境 GIT_* 变量）已逐一对照本仓库用法——所有 git 访问都走受守护的 loader，且已使用命名导出。msteams agents 的次版本升级是上游自己的修复载体。所有锁定版本都通过了 pnpm 的 minimumReleaseAge 门。
- 范围外：剩余 1 low / 6 moderate 低于门禁线；更广泛的 Snyk 驱动治理在 #17099 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更：无预期。两份 allowlist 只“点名”客户端本来就希望保留在子环境里的键，不会注入值：清洗到 `gitEnv()` 的客户端保持清洗，loader 的守护、配置黑名单与 unsafe 策略均未改动。

</details>
